units.verbatim_book_heading: PART III: MENOLOGION :: On the 25th day: Our Venerable Mother Euphrosyne of Alexandria. At Vespers: The singing according to custom. Troparion, Tone 8:*[^224]
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *At the Praises: Stichera of the saint, Tone 8: "O marvelous wonder", doubling the 1st; Glory, in the same Tone: "O evangelist John"; Both now, Theotokion; Great Doxology. Dismissal. And after the prayer is sung the sticheron samoglasen, candles preceding, the priest comes and censes the icon of the saint, and so the holy oil is given to the brethren from the lamp of the saint. If there be an igumen-priest, he anoints the brethren, dipping two fingers in the oil; and thus is the complete dismissal.*

units.verbatim_book_heading: PART III: MENOLOGION :: On the 25th day: Our Venerable Mother Euphrosyne of Alexandria. At Vespers: The singing according to custom. Troparion, Tone 8:*[^224]
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *It is fitting to know that thus we celebrate on all feasts on which there is an All-Night Vigil. At the Liturgy: From the canons, Ode 3 and 6; Prokeimenon, Tone 8: "Their sound is gone out into all the earth" [LXX Ps. 18:5]; Verse: "The heavens declare the glory of God" [LXX Ps. 18:2]. The Epistle from the Catholic Epistle of John: "Brethren, no man hath seen God at any time..." [1 Jn. 4:12–19, pericope 73]. Alleluia: "The heavens shall confess Thy wonders, O Lord" [LXX Ps. 88:6]; Verse: "God is glorified in the council of the saints" [LXX Ps. 88:8]. The Gospel on the Sunday after the Exaltation, pericope 67, from John: "At that time, there stood by the cross of Jesus..." [Jn. 19:25–27; 21:24–25]. Communion verse: "Their sound is gone out into all the earth, and their words unto the ends of the world" [LXX Ps. 18:5].*

units.verbatim_book_heading: PART III: MENOLOGION :: On the 25th day: Our Venerable Mother Euphrosyne of Alexandria. At Vespers: The singing according to custom. Troparion, Tone 8:*[^224]
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *At the Aposticha, of the feast; Glory, Tone 6: "O venerable father, from thy youth..."; Both now, Theotokion. At the Liturgy: Prokeimenon, Tone 7: "The saints shall boast in glory, and they shall rejoice upon their beds" [LXX Ps. 149:5]; Verse: "Sing unto the Lord a new song, His praise is in the church of the saints" [LXX Ps. 149:1]. The Epistle: pericope 213 [Gal. 5:22–6:2]: "Brethren, the fruit of the Spirit...". Alleluia, Tone 6: "Blessed is the man that fears the Lord, he shall delight exceedingly in His commandments" [LXX Ps. 111:1]; Verse: "His seed shall be mighty upon the earth" [LXX Ps. 111:2]. The Gospel from Matthew, Thursday of the 3rd week: "The Lord said: All things are delivered unto Me of My Father..." [Mt. 11:27–30]. Communion verse: "In everlasting remembrance shall the righteous be" [LXX Ps. 111:6].*

units.verbatim_book_heading: PART III: MENOLOGION :: At the Aposticha of the Octoechos: Glory, of the saint, Tone 6; Both now, Theotokion. And at the Liturgy: The sequence of yesterday unchanged.*[^230]
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *On the 1st day: The Protection of the Most Holy Theotokos, and the Holy Apostle Ananias, and our Venerable Father Romanus the Melodist. We celebrate all day. All-Night Vigil, if the igumen wills. At Vespers: "Blessed is the man". At "Lord, I have cried", we sing 10 stichera: of the Theotokos, 3 prosomoia on 4; and of the Apostle, 3; and of Romanus, 3; Glory, of the Apostle; Both now, of the Protection. Entrance; prokeimenon of the day; and 3 readings of the Theotokos. Ectenia. At the Litiya, stichera of the Protection which are [appointed].*

units.slavonic_diplomatic: Ѡ тебѣ ѡ҃че романе · и҆ꙁвѣстьно спасенноую бысть ѡ҃браꙁъ , приємъ бо кр҃стъ въслѣ довалъ еси хр҃тоу · твора и́ оу҆чаше · еже пре ꙁирати плътъ · мимоходитъ бо · приле жати же доуши ве щии бессм҃ртнѣи · тѣ мь съ а́г҃глы радоуетсѧ д҃хъ твои :~ і ны покровоу · Д н҃ь благовѣрнии людье ·
units.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* In thee, O father Romanus, was preserved with certainty that which is according to the image; for taking up the cross, thou didst follow Christ, and by thy deeds didst teach us to overlook the flesh, for it passes away, and to care for the soul, a thing immortal; therefore, thy spirit rejoices with the angels!

In thee, O father Romanus, was preserved with certainty that which is according to the image; for taking up the cross, thou didst follow Christ, and by thy deeds didst teach us to overlook the flesh, for it passes away, and to care for the soul, a thing immortal; therefore, thy spirit rejoices with the angels!

units.english_cohort_translation: *Exapostilarion of the Theotokos, and of the Apostle. At the Praises: of the Protection, 3 prosomoia on 4, Tone 8; Glory, Both now: samoglasen of the Protection; Great Doxology. After the Trisagion, Troparion of the Protection; ectenia, dismissal. At the Liturgy: from the canons, Ode 3 of the Protection on 4, and of the Apostle Ode 6 on 4; Prokeimenon, canticle of the Theotokos: "My soul doth magnify the Lord" [Lk. 1:46]; Verse: "For He hath regarded the lowliness of His handmaiden" [Lk. 1:48]. Of the Apostle: "Into all the earth is their sound gone out" [LXX Ps. 18:5]. The Epistle of the Protection: "Brethren, the first tabernacle had..." units.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion:* Having passed through the heavenly gates in the spirit, and having been instructed by him that ascended unto the third heaven, O Dionysius, thou didst enrich all understanding with ineffable mysteries, and didst illumine them that sat in the darkness of ignorance; therefore we cry unto thee: Rejoice, O father of the whole world!

cohort_provenance.verbatim_source:
*Kontakion:*  
Having passed through the heavenly gates in the spirit, and having been instructed by him that ascended unto the third heaven, O Dionysius, thou didst enrich all understanding with ineffable mysteries, and didst illumine them that sat in the darkness of ignorance; therefore we cry unto thee: Rejoice, O father of the whole world!

units.verbatim_book_heading: PART III: MENOLOGION :: At Matins: Canon of the Octoechos, and of the saint on 6. Kontakion after Ode 6, Tone 8, Podoben: "To Thee, the Champion Leader" (Взбранной воеводе)
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *At the Aposticha of the Octoechos: Glory, of the saint, samoglasen; Both now, Theotokion. At the Liturgy: Prokeimenon, Tone 7: "The saints shall boast in glory, and they shall rejoice upon their beds" [LXX Ps. 149:5]; Verse: "Sing unto the Lord a new song, His praise is in the church of the saints" [LXX Ps. 149:1]. The Epistle from the Acts: on Monday of the 6th week [after Pascha], from the half [Acts 17:16–34, pericope 40]. Alleluia, Tone 2: "Thy priests, O Lord, shall clothe themselves with righteousness" [LXX Ps. 131:9]. Gospel from Matthew, Friday of the 5th week [pericope 55, Mt. 13:44–54]. Communion verse: "In everlasting remembrance shall the righteous be" [LXX Ps. 111:6].*

units.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion:* As an unshakable pillar, O Hierotheus, thou wast not terrified by the threats of the enemy, but didst destroy the fortress of delusion, appearing as a precious stone, O father; therefore the Master, seeing thee as His servant, crowns thee with His life-originating right hand: entreat Him for all of us!

units.verbatim_book_heading: PART III: MENOLOGION :: At Matins: Canon of the Octoechos, and of the saint on 6. Kontakion after Ode 6, Tone 8, Podoben: "To Thee, the Champion Leader" (Взбранной воеводе)
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *At the Praises: 4 samoglasny stichera: one of Tone 1: "Thou followedst..."; and 2 of Tone 4: "Unto divine understanding", "With the net of depth"; Glory, Tone 6: "A good weapon"; Both now, Theotokion. At the Liturgy: from the canons, Ode 3 and 6; Prokeimenon, Tone 8: "Their sound is gone out into all the earth" [LXX Ps. 18:5]; Verse: "The heavens declare the glory of God" [LXX Ps. 18:2]. The Epistle: 3rd Sunday [1 Cor. 4:9–16, pericope 131]. Alleluia: "The heavens shall confess Thy wonders, O Lord" [LXX Ps. 88:6]. Gospel from John: the Matins Gospel [Jn. 20:19–31, pericope 65]. Communion verse: "Into all the earth is their sound gone out" [LXX Ps. 18:5].*

units.verbatim_book_heading: PART III: MENOLOGION :: At Matins: Canon of the Octoechos, and of the saints on 6. After Ode 6, Kontakion, Tone 2, Podoben: "Seeking the Things on High" (Вышних ища)
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *At the Praises: 4 samoglasny stichera, Tone 8 and Tone 3; Glory, Tone 2; Both now, Theotokion. At the Aposticha: Glory, of the saints; Both now, Theotokion. At the Liturgy: Prokeimenon: "Unto the saints that are in His earth, the Lord hath been marvelous in all His will in them" [LXX Ps. 15:3]; Verse: "I foresaw the Lord always before my face, for He is on my right hand, that I may not be shaken" [LXX Ps. 15:8]. The Epistle: 20th Sunday [Eph. 4:1–7, pericope 224]; of the saints, pericope 220 [Eph. 6:10–17]. Alleluia: "Behold now, what is so good or what is so pleasant as for brethren to dwell together in unity?" [LXX Ps. 132:1]. Gospel from Luke: Tuesday of the 20th week [Lk. 12:42–48, pericope 68]. Communion verse: "In everlasting remembrance shall the righteous be" [LXX Ps. 111:6].*

units.slavonic_diplomatic: в ъс҃ · с тыꙗ г҃ · с л҃ г л҃ д҃ · И́ де же оу҆мно жисѧ · и́ нн҃ѣ б҃ · н а стїхѡ · и́ т ро · Ѡ тебѣ м ати с е̄ · к҃е · н а оу҆рни · к анѡ · ѡ̈ · с тыа н а д҃ · п о ѕ · п ѣ к ҃о г л҃а в҃ · Т ѣло свое по щеніель и́стонивши · неѡ҃усыпанныими мо литвами · ѕижителꙗ мл҃ꙗше грѣха ради своего да пріе́мьше съвръшено е прощеніе ·
units.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion:* Having wasted thy body with fasting, with sleepless prayers thou didst entreat the Creator for the sake of thy sin, that having received complete forgiveness, thou mightest obtain remission, having shown forth repentance!

units.slavonic_diplomatic: *Кондакъ:* Оу́дицею ловѧжьѧ · рыбы оу́ловилъ єси словесныя · и си принеслъ єси начаткы бг҃оу нашему · и въ х҃вы раны въжделѣ ѡблектисѧ · подобникъ стрⷭ҇тнемь єго показасѧ · тѣмь съшєдшесѧ почитаємь · ап҃ле іакове · въсепразденьственоуютвою памѧть · и съгласно въпїемь · моли х҃а бг҃а ѡ вьсѣхъ насъ :~
units.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion:* O angler who catchest fish, thou didst catch spiritual fish, and broughtest these first-fruits unto our God; and desiring to be clothed in the wounds of Christ, thou wast shown forth as an imitator of His Sufferings; therefore, having come together, we honor, O Apostle James, thy most festive memory, and cry out with one accord: "Entreat Christ God for all of us!"

units.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion:* Let us honor the noble martyrs and brother and sister according to the flesh, the wise Eulampius and Eulampia; for they put to shame the crafty scheming of the lawless by the power of the Cross; therefore they were revealed as the glory and together the praise of martyrs!

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: подобает ведати ко в придущую нелю по
units.slavonic_diplomatic: *Подобаєть вѣдати ꙗко въ придѫщѫю нелю · по памати ст҃го ап҃ла съвръшаємь памѧⷮ ст҃ы ѡц҃ь · ꙁ҃ · го · збора въселенскаго · иже в никеи · съшєдшесѧ · в҃ · є · на проклѧтыꙗ · и безбожноисповѣдникы · и хрⷭ҇тоненавистныꙗ и хрⷭ҇тьꙗнооу́корныꙗ · иконоборца чⷭ҇тныи ѡц҃ь наши · и съпострадавши дне съ ними · єпⷭ҇пы · послѣдꙋємь въслѣдованіе · ꙁ҃ · го · съ...*
units.english_cohort_translation: *It is fitting to know that on the coming Sunday following the memory of the holy apostle, we celebrate the memory of the holy Fathers of the Seventh Ecumenical Council, who assembled in Nicaea for the second time, against the accursed and godless-confessing, Christ-hating and Christian-reproaching iconoclasts, our venerable fathers, and the bishops who suffered together with them. We follow the sequence of the Seventh... ...Council together with the Resurrection [hymns of the Octoechos].*[^243]

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: скровище многоценно владыка и крин нескипающ
units.slavonic_diplomatic: *Кондакъ:* Скровище многоцѣнно · владыка и кринъ нескипающь · пото́кы цѣлѣа соу́щнымь на землн подаєть мощи ваша · недоугы оу́бо ѡцѣщающа · и стр҃ти различчныꙗ · блгⷣть же дароующа дш҃амь притѣчно · тѣмь съгласно ваше любовію мч҃нци бж҃твьнїи съвръшаємь тръжество :~
units.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion:* As a most precious treasure from the Master and an unfading lily, your relics pour forth streams of healings unto them that are upon the earth, cleansing infirmities and various passions, and granting grace abundantly unto souls; therefore with love we celebrate with one accord your solemnity, O divine martyrs!

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: стяжавшю застоупницу соущу во беда блгочьстно въспоим
units.slavonic_diplomatic: *Кондакъ:* Стѧжавшю застоупницѫ соущѫ во бѣда · бл҃гочьстно въспоимь · пѧткоу ст҃ѫꙗ · тако житие ѡ́ставльше и приꙗтованєтлѣемое в вѣкы · сего ради славоу ѡ́брѣте чюдесы · и бл҃гⷣть бж҃иимь веленїемь :~
units.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion:* Having acquired her as an intercessor in afflictions, let us piously hymn the holy Paraskeva; for having forsaken this life, she received that which is incorruptible unto the ages; therefore she found glory in miracles and grace by the divine commandment!

units.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion:* *After Ode 6, Kontakion [of the Martyrs Nazarius and companions], Tone 2:* Having appeared as radiant luminaries, O divine martyrs, ye illumine creation with brilliance, dispersing the deep darkness of diseases, and praying always unceasingly unto Christ the Only God for all of us!

units.slavonic_incipit: Волненїи множество небл҃жно преходѧ бесплътныꙗ врагы
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: волнении множество неблжно преходя бесплътны врагы строу ми слъз
units.slavonic_diplomatic: *Кондакъ:* Волненїи множество небл҃жно преходѧ бесплътныꙗ врагы строуꙗми слъзь твоихъ · крѣпко погрузилъ єси бг҃омоудре єѵѳимїе прпⷣбне и чюде даръ прїꙗлъ моли непрестано ѡ вьсѣхъ :~
units.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion:* *Kontakion [of St. Euthymius], Tone 2:*[^246] Passing blamelessly through the multitude of tempests, by the streams of thy tears thou didst drown the bodiless enemies, O God-wise Euthymius, venerable one, and having received the gift of miracles, entreat unceasingly for all of us!

units.slavonic_diplomatic: *Тропарь:* Постьническы прѣиспытавсѧ на горѣ · мысленыꙗ врагы ѡ́плъченїа · въсѣ ѡ́роужьн погоубилъ еси въсебл҃жне крⷭ҇тныи дн · а бїе же ко страсти мѫжыскы съвлечесѧ · оу́бивъ къ дро... ...нима мечемь вѣры · и ѡбоюдꙋ вѣнчися ѡ[т] бг҃а прпⷣбнемч҃нче андрѣю ѡ́тче нашъ :~

units.slavonic_diplomatic: С҃того ап҃ла · и еѵ҃листа лоукы · празнꙿ ве́ днь · и҃і · вечерь · ст҃ры · на ѕ҃ · сла́ гла́ и҃ · Ап҃ле хв҃ь · и нынѣ · бц҃ю · на стиховнѣ · ѡ́ · сла́ гла́ ѕ҃ · въсемѫдре · і ны б҃ тро́ гл҃ є҃ ·

units.verbatim_book_heading: PART III: MENOLOGION :: At Matins: Canon of the saint on 6. After Ode 6, Kontakion, Tone 2: "A firm..."
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *At the Praises: 4 prosomoia on 4, Tone 4, with the verse: "Into all the earth is their sound gone out" [LXX Ps. 18:5]; Glory, Tone 8: "Come, all creation..."; Both now, Theotokion. At the Aposticha: Glory, Tone 4: "Ye earthly assemblies having come together..."; Both now, Theotokion. At the Liturgy: From the canon, Ode 3 and 6; Prokeimenon, Tone 4: "Into all the earth is their sound gone out" [LXX Ps. 18:5]; Verse: "The heavens declare the glory of God" [LXX Ps. 18:2]. units.slavonic_diplomatic: С҃тго прр҃ка · иѡила · и ст҃го мч҃ника · оу́ара · ѳ҃і · и ст҃го сщ҃енномч҃нка · садофа · и с нимь · р҃ · к҃ · и · и҃ · мѫчени́к при сапори цр҃и · в персѣ · Егда же моучиль ст҃лъ хв҃ы тыи садофь · тогда рече, к броуюкоу мо́емоу · ꙗко хр҃тїане, имѧть зъвзѧти лющн моꙗ · н иже аще призоветь бг҃а · имене мо́его ради · сп҃сенїе ѡ́...
units.english_cohort_translation: *On the 19th day: The Holy Prophet Joel, and the Holy Martyr Varus, and the Holy Hieromartyr Sadoth, and with him 128 martyrs under King Sapor in Persia. When the holy hierarch of Christ, Sadoth, was being tortured, then he said unto that god-fighting one: "The Christians shall take my relics, and whosoever shall call upon God for the sake of my name, shall find salvation..."*

units.slavonic_incipit: В лїню реченїю, оу́сердно къ подобыствѣ
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: в линю речению оусердно к подобыстве последова
units.slavonic_diplomatic: *Кондакъ:* В лїню реченїю, оу́сердно къ подобыствѣ послѣдова · ꙗко оу́бо пастырь добрыи · дш҃ѫ свою положилъ єси за хв҃ы ѡ́вца · сщ҃енномч҃нче садофе · молититꙗ мнѡгострадалне · моли пастырельначалника х҃а · и на причести деснаго ѡ́вець стоꙗнїа · давъпїемъ ти · радоуисѧ сщ҃енныи ѡ́ч҃е садофе · иже за х҃а кровь свою излиавыи :~
units.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion:* *Kontakion of Sadoth, Tone 4:* Zealously following in imitation of the Master's teaching, as a good shepherd thou laidest down thy life for the sheep of Christ, O hieromartyr Sadoth; we pray thee, O much-suffering one: entreat Christ the Chief Shepherd, and number us also among the sheep standing on His right hand, that we may cry unto thee: Rejoice, O holy father Sadoth, who didst pour out thy blood for Christ!

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: аггльскому житию поревновав прпбне и вься земна
units.slavonic_diplomatic: *Кондакъ:* Аг҃гльскомꙋ житїю поревновавь прпⷣбне · и вьсѧ земнаꙗ ѡ́ставивь · и къ х҃оу прите... кль еси · и того заповѣдьми огражаема · и явися стлъпъ непоколѣблемын · вражии нападеніи · тѣмь зовем ти радуися ѡ́че іѡанне · свѣтило пресвѣтлое :~
units.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion:* *Kontakion of John, Tone 8:* Having emulated the life of the angels, O venerable one, and forsaken all earthly things, thou hast run unto Christ thou didst run [unto Christ], and being sheltered by His commandments, thou wast shown forth as an unshakable pillar against the attacks of the enemy; therefore we cry unto thee: Rejoice, O father John, most radiant luminary![^250]
units.slavonic_text: *Кондакъ:* Аг҃гльскомꙋ житїю поревновавь прпⷣбне · и вьсѧ земнаꙗ ѡ́ставивь · и къ х҃оу прите... кль еси · и того заповѣдьми огражаема · и явися стлъпъ непоколѣблемын · вражии нападеніи · тѣмь зовем ти радуися ѡ́че іѡанне · свѣтило пресвѣтлое :~
units.english_text: *Kontakion:* *Kontakion of John, Tone 8:* Having emulated the life of the angels, O venerable one, and forsaken all earthly things, thou hast run unto Christ thou didst run [unto Christ], and being sheltered by His commandments, thou wast shown forth as an unshakable pillar against the attacks of the enemy; therefore we cry unto thee: Rejoice, O father John, most radiant luminary![^250]

units.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion:* Gathering together spiritually, let us praise Artemius, the pious and crown-bearing one, who took up victories over the enemies, the disciple of grace and bountiful giver of miracles; for he prays unto the Lord for all of us!

units.slavonic_diplomatic: в к҃в д · С҃тго и равна ап҃ло · аверкіа велика еппа іерпольскаго чютворца · и стых з҃ отро ·
units.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion:* As a never-setting luminary of the spiritual Sun, gathering today in hymns and songs, we praise thee; for thou hast shone forth upon them that sit in the darkness of ignorance, raising all unto the heavenly height, O Hilarion; therefore we cry: Rejoice, O father, foundation of ascetics!

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: иже во ефесе ве стры ие
units.slavonic_diplomatic: иже во ефесѣ · ве · стры іе на ѕ҃ сл г҃ ѕ · і н б на стн ѡ · тро правило вѣрѣ · сл дѣищни тво на оу҃ кано на д · іе на ѕ · и отроко на д · по г҃ пѣ ко҃ отроко г҃ д · Оу́дививыи на земли стыꙗ твоꙗ · прежде вътораго своего · и страшнаго пришествіꙗ преславныимь въстаніемь ·
units.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion:* Thou Who didst marvelously show forth Thy holy ones upon earth before Thy second and awesome coming, by their most glorious rising of the children, O Christ, revealing the resurrection unto them that were ignorant thereof, showing their garments and bodies incorrupt, and having persuaded the king to cry aloud in truth: Truly I have known the resurrection of the dead![^252]

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *On the 23rd day: Memory of the Holy Apostle James, Brother of the Lord according to the flesh. We celebrate all day. At Vespers: Stichera on 6; Glory, Tone 6: "Martyrdom by blood..."; Both now, Theotokion. At the Aposticha: of the Octoechos; Glory, Tone 8: "Of the first..."; Both now, Theotokion. Troparion, Tone 2: "As the Lord's disciple, O righteous one, thou hast received the Gospel; as a... ...master thou hast unwritten boldness; as the Brother of God, unto Whom it is fitting to pray; as a pillar, pray thou unto Christ God that our souls may be saved!"*[^253]

cohort_provenance.verbatim_source:
*Kontakion:*  
As a most noble disciple, and divine hierarch, and one who was the successor of the Lord and His Brother according to the flesh, thy venerable church, proclaiming thy labors, is glorified, and sings praises unto the Lover of mankind!

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *At the Praises: Stichera on 4; Glory, Tone 1; Both now, Theotokion. At the Aposticha: of the Octoechos; Glory, of the saint. At the Liturgy: From the canon of the Octoechos [or Apostle], Ode 3 and 6; Prokeimenon: "Into all the earth is their sound gone out" [LXX Ps. 18:5]; Verse: "The heavens declare the glory of God" [LXX Ps. 18:2]. The Apostle: 20th Sunday [Gal. 1:11–19]. Alleluia: "The heavens shall confess Thy wonders, O Lord" [LXX Ps. 88:6]. Gospel from Matthew: Friday of the 6th week: "At that time, Jesus came into His own country..." [Mt. 13:54–58], ending: "into all that land".*

units.slavonic_diplomatic: Подвизавши добрѣ ѿ младенства маркь кыꙗне съ мъждрым мартирьемь · ѿстѫпни ка аріа низложиста · нескврънно съблю овѣрїе · павлови въслѣдова вше добром[у] оуч҃ителю · тѣм же съ нимь ѡ брѣтосте животъ · ꙗко поборници тр҃ци іꙁ бранніи :~ на лургіи про гла д҃ · дивень б҃ъ · а҃пль · не по бгоꙗвленьи · аллуа въ зваша правенїи · єѵлїе ѡ лу · по вкра · а҃ ·
units.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion:* Having striven valiantly from infancy, O Marcian with wise Martyrius, ye cast down the apostate Arius, preserving the Orthodox faith undefiled following Paul the good teacher; therefore with him ye have found life, as chosen champions of the Trinity![^255]
units.slavonic_text: Подвизавши добрѣ ѿ младенства маркь кыꙗне съ мъждрым мартирьемь · ѿстѫпни ка аріа низложиста · нескврънно съблю овѣрїе · павлови въслѣдова вше добром[у] оуч҃ителю · тѣм же съ нимь ѡ брѣтосте животъ · ꙗко поборници тр҃ци іꙁ бранніи :~ на лургіи про гла д҃ · дивень б҃ъ · а҃пль · не по бгоꙗвленьи · аллуа въ зваша правенїи · єѵлїе ѡ лу · по вкра · а҃ ·
units.english_text: *Kontakion:* Having striven valiantly from infancy, O Marcian with wise Martyrius, ye cast down the apostate Arius, preserving the Orthodox faith undefiled following Paul the good teacher; therefore with him ye have found life, as chosen champions of the Trinity![^255]

slavonic_provenance.verbatim_source:
Подвизавши добрѣ ѿ младенства маркь
кыꙗне съ мъждрым мартирьемь · ѿстѫпни
ка аріа низложиста · нескврънно съблю

=== LEAF p206 ===

овѣрїе · павлови въслѣдова
вше добром[у] оуч҃ителю · тѣм же съ нимь ѡ
брѣтосте животъ · ꙗко поборници тр҃ци іꙁ
бранніи :~ на лургіи про гла д҃ · дивень
б҃ъ · а҃пль · не по бгоꙗвленьи · аллуа въ
зваша правенїи · єѵлїе ѡ лу · по вкра · а҃ ·

cohort_provenance.verbatim_source:

Having striven valiantly from infancy, O Marcian with wise Martyrius, ye cast down the apostate Arius, preserving the Orthodox faith undefiled...

=== LEAF p206 ===

...following Paul the good teacher; therefore with him ye have found life, as chosen champions of the Trinity![^255]

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *On the 26th day: The Holy Great and Glorious Martyr of Christ Demetrius. We celebrate all day. At Vespers: Stichera of the saint on 6; Glory, Tone 6: "Today [the solemnity of the passion-bearer] summons [us]"; Both now, Theotokion. At the Aposticha: Samoglasny of the Earthquake, at "Lord, I have cried", Tone 6: "The earth shook...", "Awesome art Thou, O Lord...", "And now in Thy wrath..."; then they say: "Looking upon the earth, He makes it tremble..." [LXX Ps. 103:32]; Glory, Tone 3: "Thou hast, O divine [Demetrius]..."; Both now, Theotokion. Troparion, Tone 3:*

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: призв ис кв рауите стго великаго
units.slavonic_diplomatic: призвꙗ іс҃ · к҃в рауите · С҃тго великаго и славнаго · мч҃ка хва димитріа · празниуем ве днь · ве · стры гт на ѕ҃ · сл гл҃ ѕ · днь съзывае · і ны б҃ на стн са гл҃ны трѫсоу г҃в и гл҃ ѕ · землꙗ потрꙗсеся · страшенъ еси г҃и · и нине в гит ꙗже согрѣшен · т҃же · гл҃мл ·
units.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* A great helper in dangers hath the universe found thee, O passion-bearer, who vanquishest the heathen; for as thou didst cast down the pride of Lyaeus, and didst strengthen Nestor at the tribunal, so, O holy Demetrius, entreat Christ God to grant unto us great mercy!

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: тен на земли вися насаженыи ко древо
units.slavonic_diplomatic: тен на земли ꙗвися · насаженыи ꙗко дрѣво на водѣ въздьржаніа · насладивсꙗ тече ніемь слъзъ твоихъ · сквръноу ѡ́мываꙗ сего ради ꙗвися приꙗтелище бж҃твьнаго аврамье дх҃а :~ по ѕ҃ · пѣ ко с҃тыꙗ гл҃ г҃ ·
units.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion:* In the flesh as one bodiless thou wast revealed upon the earth, planted like a tree by the waters of abstinence, flourishing by the flow of thy tears, washing away defilement; therefore thou wast shown forth, O Abramius, as a dwelling of the Divine Spirit!

тен на земли ꙗвися · насаженыи ꙗко дрѣво
на водѣ въздьржаніа · насладивсꙗ тече

сего ради ꙗвися приꙗтелище бж҃твьнаго
аврамье дх҃а :~ по ѕ҃ · пѣ ко с҃тыꙗ гл҃ г҃ ·

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: девьства водами очистивши тело моу ченичьскыми крьвьми
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Дѣвьства водами ѡчистивши тѣло · моу ченичьскыми крьвьми анастасіе вѣньча вши тꙗ · соущимъ въ ноужи медѫгъ сп҃се ніе · пристоупающимъ ѿ ср҃дца бж҃твьную блг҃ть хс҃ источаꙗ · и жизнь приснотекоу щѫꙗ :~
units.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion:* *After Ode 6, Kontakion of the saint, Tone 3:* Having purified thy body with the waters of virginity, and crowned thyself with the blood of martyrdom, O Anastasia, thou pourest forth Christ's divine grace and ever-flowing life as salvation from the affliction of diseases unto them that approach from the heart!
units.slavonic_text: Дѣвьства водами ѡчистивши тѣло · моу ченичьскыми крьвьми анастасіе вѣньча вши тꙗ · соущимъ въ ноужи медѫгъ сп҃се ніе · пристоупающимъ ѿ ср҃дца бж҃твьную блг҃ть хс҃ источаꙗ · и жизнь приснотекоу щѫꙗ :~
units.english_text: *Kontakion:* *After Ode 6, Kontakion of the saint, Tone 3:* Having purified thy body with the waters of virginity, and crowned thyself with the blood of martyrdom, O Anastasia, thou pourest forth Christ's divine grace and ever-flowing life as salvation from the affliction of diseases unto them that approach from the heart!

slavonic_provenance.verbatim_source:
Дѣвьства водами ѡчистивши тѣло · моу
ченичьскыми крьвьми анастасіе вѣньча
вши тꙗ · соущимъ въ ноужи медѫгъ сп҃се
ніе · пристоупающимъ ѿ ср҃дца бж҃твьную
блг҃ть хс҃ источаꙗ · и жизнь приснотекоу
щѫꙗ :~ С҃тыхь мч҃нкъ зиновьа · и зино
вьи · аллуа · тро мч҃нци твои · ко҃ гл҃а и҃

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: истине светели и блгочст провени кы
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Истинѣ свѣтели · и бл҃гочстьꙗ провѣни кы · двоицю достоино ными пѣми · зиновьꙗ кѹпно · и тою юж новью · въкоупѣ пожившѫю · и того ради дч҃ньꙗ вѣнець приемльши нетлѣнныи :~
units.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion:* The beacons of truth and heralds of piety the pair let us worthily praise with songs: Zenobius together with the like-minded Zenobia, who lived together, and therefore received the incorruptible crown of martyrdom![^258]
units.slavonic_text: Истинѣ свѣтели · и бл҃гочстьꙗ провѣни кы · двоицю достоино ными пѣми · зиновьꙗ кѹпно · и тою юж новью · въкоупѣ пожившѫю · и того ради дч҃ньꙗ вѣнець приемльши нетлѣнныи :~
units.english_text: *Kontakion:* The beacons of truth and heralds of piety the pair let us worthily praise with songs: Zenobius together with the like-minded Zenobia, who lived together, and therefore received the incorruptible crown of martyrdom![^258]

slavonic_provenance.verbatim_source:
Истинѣ свѣтели · и бл҃гочстьꙗ провѣни

=== LEAF p209 ===

кы · двоицю достоино
ными пѣми · зиновьꙗ кѹпно · и тою юж
новью · въкоупѣ пожившѫю · и того ради
дч҃ньꙗ вѣнець приемльши нетлѣнныи :~

cohort_provenance.verbatim_source:
*Kontakion:*  
The beacons of truth and heralds of piety...

=== LEAF p209 ===

...the pair let us worthily praise with songs: Zenobius together with the like-minded Zenobia, who lived together, and therefore received the incorruptible crown of martyrdom![^258]

units.verbatim_book_heading: PART III: MENOLOGION :: At Matins: Canon of the Octoechos, and of the saints on 6. After Ode 6, Kontakion, Tone 2, Podoben: "The Firm" (Твердыя)
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *At the Praises: Stichera of the saints on 4; Glory, Tone 4: "A fountain [of healings]..."; Both now, Theotokion. At the Aposticha: of the Octoechos; Glory, Tone 8; Both now, Theotokion. At the Liturgy: From the canon, Ode 3 and 6; Prokeimenon: "Unto the saints that are in His earth" [LXX Ps. 15:3]; Verse: "I foresaw the Lord..." [LXX Ps. 15:8]. The Apostle to the Corinthians: "Brethren, ye are the body of Christ..." [1 Cor. 12:27–13:8, pericope 153]. Alleluia, Tone 2: "Behold now, what is so good or what is so delightful..." [LXX Ps. 132:1]. Gospel: "At that time, Jesus called His twelve disciples..." [Mt. 10:1–8, pericope 34], ending: "...".*

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: страстотръпци гни блжена же земл напи вшая
units.slavonic_diplomatic: С҃трастотръпци гн҃и · бл҃жена ꙗже землꙗ напи вшая кръви ваша · с҃ти и хранилища прїємь ше тѣлеса ваша · на сѫдищи бо врага ѡбли чисте · и х҃а съ дръзновеніемь проповѣда сте · того ꙗко бл҃га молите сп҃сти молимъвы д҃ша наша :~ на оу҃трни к҃аны · ѡ҃ · на ѕ҃ · по ѕ҃ · пѣ ко҃ гл҃а в҃ · Бл҃гочъстивыꙗ и б҃о носныꙗ мч҃нкы на землѣ оставльше всꙗ ческаꙗ · и прїꙗтыхъ въ наслаженіе бл҃гы твоихъ покоꙗ · акендина · и пигасьꙗ · анє мподиста · съ нимиже и афѳоніа · и елпи дифора · єдинь бо єси бл҃гооувѣтливы :~
units.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* O passion-bearers of the Lord, blessed is the earth that drank your blood, and holy are the dwellings that received your bodies; for at the tribunal ye exposed the enemy, and proclaimed Christ with boldness; Him, as He is good, pray to save our souls, we beseech you![^260]
units.slavonic_text: С҃трастотръпци гн҃и · бл҃жена ꙗже землꙗ напи вшая кръви ваша · с҃ти и хранилища прїємь ше тѣлеса ваша · на сѫдищи бо врага ѡбли чисте · и х҃а съ дръзновеніемь проповѣда сте · того ꙗко бл҃га молите сп҃сти молимъвы д҃ша наша :~ на оу҃трни к҃аны · ѡ҃ · на ѕ҃ · по ѕ҃ · пѣ ко҃ гл҃а в҃ · Бл҃гочъстивыꙗ и б҃о носныꙗ мч҃нкы на землѣ оставльше всꙗ ческаꙗ · и прїꙗтыхъ въ наслаженіе бл҃гы твоихъ покоꙗ · акендина · и пигасьꙗ · анє мподиста · съ нимиже и афѳоніа · и елпи дифора · єдинь бо єси бл҃гооувѣтливы :~
units.english_text: *Troparion:* O passion-bearers of the Lord, blessed is the earth that drank your blood, and holy are the dwellings that received your bodies; for at the tribunal ye exposed the enemy, and proclaimed Christ with boldness; Him, as He is good, pray to save our souls, we beseech you![^260]

slavonic_provenance.verbatim_source:
С҃трастотръпци гн҃и · бл҃жена ꙗже землꙗ напи
вшая кръви ваша · с҃ти и хранилища прїємь
ше тѣлеса ваша · на сѫдищи бо врага ѡбли
чисте · и х҃а съ дръзновеніемь проповѣда
сте · того ꙗко бл҃га молите сп҃сти молимъвы
д҃ша наша :~ на оу҃трни к҃аны · ѡ҃ · на ѕ҃ · по
ѕ҃ · пѣ ко҃ гл҃а в҃ · Бл҃гочъстивыꙗ и б҃о
носныꙗ мч҃нкы на землѣ оставльше всꙗ
ческаꙗ · и прїꙗтыхъ въ наслаженіе бл҃гы
твоихъ покоꙗ · акендина · и пигасьꙗ · анє
мподиста · съ нимиже и афѳоніа · и елпи
дифора · єдинь бо єси бл҃гооувѣтливы :~

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: съвор архаггла михаила и прочих бе сплътны
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Съворъ архаг҃гла михаила · и прочихъ бе сплътны · празнуемь ве днь · ве блжнь мѫжь · стры на ѕ҃ · сла гл҃а а҃ · разѫ мныхь силъ · выхоⷣ про днекны · и чтеа г҃ · а є · ѿ іесоуса навгина · изыдоша снове іилеви · в҃ є · ѿ пррⷣка исаиа · тако гл҃еть г҃ь въсꙗ землꙗ въпїеть · г҃ є · ѿ пррⷣка иса тако гл҃ть г҃ь · да говѣеть ксѣка плъть ѿ лица на стн ѡ҃ · сла гл҃а в҃ · пр҃те съ гл҃ ль · і ны б҃ тро с҃е ѕ҃ на оу҃р каны ѡ҃ · и аг҃гло на ѕ҃ ·
units.english_cohort_translation: *On the 8th day: Synaxis of the Archangel Michael and the Other Bodiless Powers. We celebrate all day. At Vespers: "Blessed is the...* man" [Ps. 1]. Stichera on 6; Glory, Tone 1: "Of the bodiless hosts..."; Entrance; Prokeimenon of the day; and three readings: 1st, from Joshua the son of Nun: "The children of Israel went out..." [Josh. 5:13–15]; 2nd, from the Prophet Isaiah: "Thus says the Lord: All the earth cries out..." [Isa. 14:7–20]; 3rd, from the Prophet Isaiah [or Zechariah]: "Thus says the Lord: Let all flesh keep silence before the face [of the Lord]..." [Zech. 2:13 / Hab. 2:20]. At the Aposticha: of the Octoechos; Glory, Tone 2: "Rejoice with us..."; Both now, Theotokion. Troparion is said 6 times. At Matins: Canons of the Octoechos, and of the angels on 6. After Ode 6, Kontakion, Tone 4, is said 6 times. At the Praises: and of the Archangel on 4; then Verse: "Who makes His angels spirits" [LXX Ps. 103:4]; is sung the Idiomelon, Tone 6: "Thy angels, O Christ..."; Glory, Tone 5: "Wherever [Thy grace] overshadows..."; Both now, Theotokion. Great Doxology. Troparion of the Archangel. Dismissal. At the Liturgy: The sequence is said 6 times.[^265]

units.english_cohort_translation: *On the 11th day: The Holy Martyrs Minas, Victor, and Vincent; and the Holy Martyr Stephanis; and our Venerable Father Theodore the Studite. At Vespers: Stichera of the holy martyrs, 3; and of holy Theodore, 3; Glory, Tone 6:...* again unto us..."; Both now, Theotokion. At the Aposticha: of the Octoechos; then Verse: "God is marvelous in His saints" [LXX Ps. 67:36]; and is sung the Idiomelon of the saints, Tone 2: "Come, [lovers of the martyrs]..."; Glory, of Theodore, Tone 6: "Venerable father, from [thy youth]..."; Both now, Theotokion. Troparion: "Thy martyrs, O Lord..."; Glory: "Of Orthodoxy [the guide]..."; Both now, Theotokion. At Matins: Canon of the Octoechos, and of the two saints. After Ode 3, Kontakion [of St. Minas], Tone 4:[^267]

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: пакы нам и ны бо на стн
units.slavonic_diplomatic: пакы намь · і ны б҃о на стн ѡ҃ · та с҃ диве нь б҃ъ · и поетсꙗ · сл҃глн҃ь с҃ти гл҃ в҃ · при дѣте столпцю · сл҃а ѳеѡ́рѫ гл҃ ѕ҃ · прѣ подобне ѡ́ч҃е измла · і н҃ б҃ тро муч҃нци тво и г҃и · сл҃ правовѣрію · ѡ́ · а҃і · на оу҃ ка ѡ҃ і с҃ два · по г҃ · пѣ ко҃ гл҃ д҃ · В ѫинство ѡ́ста виль єси временноє · и нетлѣннаго тꙗ ꙗви цр҃твіꙗ наслѣдника х҃ съвѣншь · мино иже муч҃нко нетлѣнныимь вѣнець по ѕ҃ пѣ ѳеѡ́рѫ ко҃ г҃ в҃ вышн Постьническое равноаг҃глское житіє твое · страдалчьскыими оукрасилъ єси стртⷣми · и аг҃глоѡ́селникы ꙗвися ѳеѡ́ре съ нимиже х҃а б҃а м҃ли непрестан ѡ всѣхь на :~ на стн ѡ҃ та с҃ты · с҃тын же сѫ на зем и поетсꙗ · сл҃глн҃ь · гл҃ а҃ · бл҃жныства хва гл҃а в҃ · придѣте вѣрнїи · і ны б҃ѡ · на лу҃ тоургіи · с҃лоу · єꙗже хощеши · прпⷣбны ли ·

на :~ на стн ѡ҃ та с҃ты · с҃тын же сѫ на зем

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: и ны б о на стн о
units.slavonic_diplomatic: і ны б҃ ѡ҃ · на стн ѡ҃ · сла и҃нокы дн҃сь · і ны б҃ · тро гл҃а и҃ · Въ тръпѣнии своемь стꙗ жаль єси мьздоу свою ѡ́ч҃е прпⷣбне · въ мл҃и тва непрестанно тръпѣвы · нищїꙗ възлю билъ єси · и сихъ напиталъ єси · нѫ молисꙗ х҃оу б҃оу ѡ́ч҃е іѡанне бл҃жне · да сп҃сеть д҃ша наша :~ сл҃а слъзъ твоихъ · с҃е г҃ · на оу҃р ка ѡ҃ на ѕ҃ · и с҃ты два · по г҃ · пѣ ко҃ ни лоу · гл҃а в҃ · Чистотою дшевьною бж҃твьно въѡ́роуживъсꙗ · и непрестанную мл҃твѫ ꙗко копіе въ роучь имвы · крѣпко съсеклъ єси бѣсовьскаꙗ ниле ополченїꙗ · чюдотво рче ѡ́ч҃е нашь · непрестано молꙗ ѡ всѣхь нас :~ по ѕ҃ · пѣ кѡ҃ ѡ́ іѡаннѣ · гл҃а в҃ ·
units.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* In thy patience thou didst acquire thy reward, O venerable father, persevering unceasingly in prayers, loving the poor, and feeding them; but entreat Christ God, O blessed father John, that He may save our souls!

[Lk. 6:17–23], ending: "...".

units.verbatim_book_heading: PART III: MENOLOGION :: At Matins: Canons of the Octoechos, and of the saint. After Ode 6, Kontakion, Tone 8, Podoben: "To Thee, Champion Leader" (Взбранной воеводѣ)
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *On the 13th day: In memory of our Father among the Saints John Chrysostom, Patriarch of Constantinople. We celebrate all day, with an All-Night Vigil sung if the Abbot wills. At Vespers: "Blessed is the man" [Ps. 1]; Stichera on 8; Glory, Tone 6: "Venerable father, thrice-blessed..."; Both now, Theotokion of the Octoechos, Tone 1: "Who will not bless thee...". Entrance; Prokeimenon of the day; and three readings. At the Aposticha: Idiomela, 3; and verses, Tone 4: "My mouth shall speak [wisdom]" [LXX Ps. 48:4], "The mouth of the righteous [shall meditate wisdom]" [LXX Ps. 36:30]; Glory, Tone 6: "O golden-voiced trumpet..."; Both now, Theotokion: "O Theotokos, Thou art the true vine...". Troparion, Tone 8:*

units.slavonic_diplomatic: Ѿ оу́стъ твоихъ ꙗко злато блг҃ть въсиꙗ вши · вселенѫ ю просвѣти · несребролюбьꙗ мирови сокровище снискавъ · высотоу намь съмиреномоудрїа показалъ еси · но твоими словесы наказуꙗ · ѡ́тче іѡ́анне златооу́ сте · моли же словоу х҃оу б҃оу · сп҃тисꙗ д҃шамь нашимъ :~ на оу҃рни · ѡ́ бычнѡе стїхословіє ·
units.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Grace having shone forth from thy mouth like gold, it enlightened the universe, [gathering] treasures not of covetousness *...to the world treasures of non-covetousness hast thou gathered; the height of humility hast thou shown unto us, but instructing us by thy words, O father John Chrysostom, entreat Christ God the Word that our souls may be saved![^270]*

units.slavonic_diplomatic: И детсꙗ с҃тое масло · ѿ кандила с҃таго · поє мыимь самогласникомь · на лѵ҃тоургии ѡ́ ка҃ пѣ г҃ · и ѕ҃ · пр҃о гла а҃ · оу́ста моꙗ възгл҃ать · с҃ти · оу́ слышите вси · а҃пль к҃ ев тако намь подобаеть · а҃ллуа · г҃ в҃ ·
units.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion:* *Thy disciple and friend, and imitator of Thy Passion, the divinely inspired Philip, preached Thee as God unto the universe; by his prayers, preserve Thy Church and all Thy city from lawless nations, for the sake of the Theotokos, O Thou Who art plenteous in mercy!*

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *It is proper to know: that in this holy fast we keep three days in the week: Monday, Wednesday, [and] Friday, [abstaining] from wine and from olive oil and from fish, unless somewhere there be the commemoration of a great saint; the Hours do we sing at that time.[^272] It is proper to know: during the Nativity Fast we sing the Liturgy late, the customary [service] together with the Ninth Hour, and thus we eat once a day, whether [the day be with] Troparion or with Alleluia, except on the days of: the Apostle and Evangelist Matthew, the Entry [of the Theotokos], the Apostle Clement, Andrew, Barbara, Sabbas, Nicholas, the Conception [of Saint Anne], the Three Youths, [and] Ignatius the God-Bearer; for on those days, if it be on Monday, Tuesday, [or] on Thursday, we eat fish... ...twice a day; but on Wednesday and Friday we eat twice, only we do not eat fish. It is also to be known: if the beginning of this holy fast be on a Saturday or on a Sunday, on those days is sung the troparion [and] kontakion of the holy confessors; but on other days, [instead of God is the Lord], Alleluia [is sung], on account of the entrance and beginning of the fast.[^273]*

units.verbatim_book_heading: PART III: MENOLOGION :: At Matins: Canon of the Octoechos, and of the saints on 6. After Ode 3, Kontakion, Tone 2
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *It is proper to know: if the beginning of this holy fast be on the five [week]days in the week, concerning the other Saturdays and Sundays it is as has been said. At Vespers: from the beginning of the singing make no prostrations; at "Lord, I have cried": 14 [stichera], the Prosomoion in the Octoechos, with the saints inserted; Glory of the saints: "Edessa gladdens..."; Both now, Theotokion. In place of the Prokeimenon: Alleluia; "Vouchsafe, O Lord", and 3 prostrations. At the Aposticha: of the Octoechos; Glory... Both now, Theotokion; "Now lettest Thou depart", and after the Trisagion, 3 prostrations... ...and "Our Father"; Troparion: "O Theotokos and Virgin, rejoice...", with a prostration; Glory: "O Baptist of Christ...", a prostration; Both now: "O physician...", and "Beneath thy tenderness of heart...", without a prostration. "Lord, have mercy" (40); Prayer: "And, O all-good King..."; "Lord, have mercy" (3); Glory... Both now: "More honorable than the Cherubim...", "In the Name of the Lord bless, father." According to the customary manner [of Vespers] we make 3 great prostrations, saying the Prayer: "O Lord and Master of my life...". Dismissal.[^275]*

units.english_cohort_translation: *Great Compline: from "When I cried" with two choirs; Trisagion; Troparia: "Enlighten mine eyes..."; do not exclaim: "Send from the highest..."; Supplicatory Canon to the Theotokos; Trisagion; 3 prostrations; after "Our Father", the troparia of the day; "Lord, have mercy" (40); Prayer: "O undefiled, pure..."; and we make 15 great prostrations, and the Prayer: "O Lord and Master of my life..."; Trisagion, and 3 prostrations, and the rest. This typikon [is observed] on the first day only; on the other days, Compline at the beginning is with prostrations, even as in the Fast of the Holy Apostles, simply without singing. Midnight Office... ...with prostrations, according to the rule of the Great Fast; likewise also Matins with prostrations, and at the end of Matins 15 great prostrations.*

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: и вис коупец предоблии бататьство в сприемл
units.slavonic_diplomatic: и ꙗвисꙗ коупець предоблїи · бататьство въ сприємль съвыше премѫдрости · тѣмже проповѣдалъ єси истинное слово · и лѣни выхь въздвиглъ єси д҃ша написавь часоу дныи :~ на стн · ѡ҃ · та ст҃и · въ всю зем лю · и гл҃етсꙗ самогл҃нь · гл҃а и҃ · въскли кнемь · сл҃а гл҃а в҃ · і ны б҃ ѡ҃ · на лѵ҃тоургі ·
units.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion:* *Cast off the tax-collector's yoke, thou didst unite thyself unto the yoke of righteousness, and wast shown forth as a most valiant merchant, receiving the wealth of wisdom from on high; therefore thou didst preach the true word, and didst arouse the souls of the slothful, having written of the hour of judgment!*

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: про в въс земл стн
units.slavonic_diplomatic: пр҃о · въ въсꙗ землꙗ · с҃тн · н б҃а повѣда ють · а҃пль · к҃е · і҃ · а҃ллуна · исповѣдꙗт нб҃са · єѵлїе · ѡ м҃а · сѫбота · д҃ · к҃ѣ · въ въсꙗ землꙗ · Иже въ с҃ты ѡц҃а нашихъ григорьꙗ чюдотворца · в҃ерь · стры · на ѕ҃ · сл҃а · гл҃а ѕ҃ · глоубиноу бг҃о · і ны · б҃ ѡ́ на стн · ѡ҃ · сл҃а гл҃а ѕ҃ · скорость бж҃їꙗ ·
units.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* *Vigilant in prayers, persevering in the working of miracles, thou didst acquire achievements worthy of thy name; but pray thou unto Christ God, O father Gregory, to enlighten our souls, lest we ever sleep unto death!*

units.slavonic_diplomatic: чюдесь дѣꙗніемь прилежа · тезоименит на стꙗжа исправленьꙗ · нѫ м҃ли ся х҃оу б҃оу ѡ́ч҃е григорїе · просвѣтити д҃ша наша · да некогда оу́снемь въ съмръть :~ на оу҃рн ·
units.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion:* *Having received the operation of many miracles, by fearful signs thou didst terrify demons, and chasedst away afflictions from men, O all-wise Gregory; and art named wonderworker, receiving thy title from thy deeds!*

units.verbatim_book_heading: PART III: MENOLOGION :: At Matins: Canons of the Octoechos, and of the saint on 6. After Ode 6, Kontakion, Tone 2
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *On the 21st day: The Entry into the Temple of our Most Holy Lady the Theotokos. We celebrate all day, singing an All-Night Vigil, and Small Vespers... ...Stichera of the feast, 3, Tone 1, on 4: "O marvelous wonder"; Glory... Both now, of the feast. At the Aposticha: of the feast, 3, Tone 2, Podoben: "O House of Ephratha" (Доме Евфратовъ); and we say the verses: "The virgins shall be brought unto the King after her" [LXX Ps. 44:15]; "They shall be brought in gladness and rejoicing" [LXX Ps. 44:16]; Glory... Both now, what they wish. Troparion, Tone 4:*

units.verbatim_book_heading: PART III: MENOLOGION :: At Matins: Canons of the Octoechos, and of the saint on 6. After Ode 6, Kontakion, Tone 2
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *At Great Vespers: "Blessed is the man". Stichera on 8: we sing 3, Tone 1: "O marvelous wonder", the first twice; and other 3, Tone 4, Podoben: "As Noble" (Яко добля), the first twice; Glory... Both now, Tone 8: "After Thy birth...". Entrance; 3 Paremias of the feast. At the Litiya, Idiomela of the feast; Glory... Both now, Tone 2: "All ye earth-born...". At the Aposticha we sing 3, Tone 5; and we say the verses even as at Small Vespers; Glory... Both now, Tone 6: "Today the assemblies of the faithful..."; blessing of the loaves.[^280]*

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *The Troparion of the feast is said thrice, Tone 4: "Today is the prelude of the good will..."; and the homily of the feast is read. At Matins: the customary psalmody [Kathisma], and the other prayers; Sessional hymns of the feast; Songs of Ascents [Anabathmoi] of Tone 4. Prokeimenon, Tone 4: "Hear, O daughter" [LXX Ps. 44:11]; Verse: "My heart hath poured forth a good word" [LXX Ps. 44:2]. Let every breath. Gospel from Luke [Lk. 1:39–49, 56]; after the Gospel, Psalm 50; Sticheron of the feast. Two canons, Tone 4 of George, and Tone 1; the heirmoi twice, and the troparia on 12; Katavasia: "Christ is born", both choirs together. After Ode 3, Hypakoe of the feast. After Ode 6, Kontakion of the feast, Tone 4, Podoben: "Thou Who Wast Lifted Up upon the Cross" (Вознесыйся):*

units.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion:* *The most pure temple of the Savior, the most precious bridal chamber and Virgin, the sacred treasury of the glory of God, today is brought into the house of the Lord, bringing in with her the grace which is in the Divine Spirit; whom the angels of God hymn: for she is the heavenly tabernacle!*

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *At Ode 9: we do not sing "More honorable". At the Praises: Stichera of the feast, 3, Tone 1, on 4; Glory... Both now, Tone 2: "Today into the temple she enters..."; Great Doxology; Troparion of the feast; litany; dismissal; and holy oil is given unto the brethren. At the Liturgy: from the canon, Ode 3 and 6, troparia of the feast; Kontakion of the feast; Prokeimenon; after Ode 9, the refrains: "Magnify, O my soul...".[^281]*

units.english_cohort_translation: *Verse: "For He hath regarded the low estate of His handmaiden" [LXX Ps. 44 / Lk. 1:48]. The Apostle: to the Hebrews [Heb. 9:1–7]: "Brethren, the first tabernacle had ordinances..."; Alleluia, Tone 8: "Hear, O daughter" [LXX Ps. 44:11]; Verse: "The virgins shall be brought unto the King" [LXX Ps. 44:15]. Gospel: [Luke, lesson] 54 [Lk. 10:38–42, 11:27–28]. Communion verse: "I will take the cup of salvation" [LXX Ps. 115:4]. And we enter into the refectory, and eat fish, and drink wine. And be it known: that this present feast is celebrated for 5 days, and its Apodosis is on the 25th day.*

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *On the 22nd day: The Holy Apostle Philemon and those with him [Archippus, Onesimus, and Apphia]. At Vespers: we do not chant the Kathisma on account of the labor of the All-Night Vigil. Stichera: 3 of the feast, and of the saint 3; Glory... Both now, of the feast. At the Aposticha: all of the feast. Troparion: "O holy Apostles..."; Glory... Both now, of the feast. At Matins: Troparion of the feast twice; Glory, of the saint; Both now, of the feast; Sessional hymns of the feast; and Canon of the feast on 8, and of the saint on 4; and other canons we do not chant until the Apodosis of the feast. After Ode 3, Kontakion of the saint, Tone 2:*

At Vespers: we do not chant the Kathisma on account of the labor of the All-Night Vigil. Stichera: 3 of the feast, and of the saint 3; Glory... Both now, of the feast. At the Aposticha: all of the feast. Troparion: "O holy Apostles..."; Glory... Both now, of the feast. At Matins: Troparion of the feast twice; Glory, of the saint; Both now, of the feast; Sessional hymns of the feast; and Canon of the feast on 8, and of the saint on 4; and other canons we do not chant until the Apodosis of the feast. After Ode 3, Kontakion of the saint, Tone 2:*

units.verbatim_book_heading: PART III: MENOLOGION :: At Matins: Canons of the Octoechos, and of the saint on 6. After Ode 6, Kontakion, Tone 2
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *On the 25th day: Our Father among the Saints Clement, Pope of Rome, and Peter of Alexandria. On that day the feast of the Most Holy Theotokos is given leave [Apodosis of the Entry]. At Vespers: the customary psalmody [Kathisma]; Stichera: 3 of the feast: "O marvelous wonder", and of St. Clement 3; Glory... Both now, "After Thy birth...". At the Aposticha: we sing 3 of the feast, and of St. Peter 1; Glory, Tone 4: "By the hand of God..."; Both now, of the feast: "Today the assemblies of the faithful...". Troparion: "O God of our fathers..."; Glory... Both now, of the feast. Litany; dismissal. At Matins: Troparion of the feast twice; Glory, of the saints; Both now, of the feast. At the Kathismata: Sessional hymns of the feast; Canons: of the feast on 8, and of the saints two canons on 6. After Ode 3, Kontakion of Saint Clement, Tone 2:*

units.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion:* *Kontakion of Saint Peter, Tone 3:* *By Orthodox precepts having enlightened the Church, for which thou didst suffer, O divinely-blessed father, driving away the apostate Arius; therefore celebrating thy most pure memory, we cry aloud in orthodox manner: Rejoice, O Peter, rock of the faith!*

At the Praises: Stichera of the saints on 4; Glory... Both now, of the feast, Tone 2: "Today into the church she is led..."; Great Doxology; Troparion of the feast; litany; dismissal; and the First Hour. At the Liturgy: of the feast, from both sides Ode 9 with the heirmos on 8; Troparion of the feast; Glory... Both now, Kontakion of the feast. units.verbatim_book_heading: PART III: MENOLOGION :: At the Aposticha of the Octoechos; Glory: "The multitude of monks..."; Both now, Theotokion. At the Liturgy: The sequence is written on the 28th.[^288]
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *On the 5th day: Our Venerable and God-bearing Father Sabbas the Sanctified; we celebrate until midday, an All-night Vigil. If the Hegumen wills: At Vespers: "Blessed is the man"; stichera on 8 (3 of Tone 5: "Venerable father..."); Glory, Tone 6: "That which is according to the image..."; Both now, Theotokion 1 of the tone: "Who would not bless thee..."; daily Prokeimenon; 3 Readings common to venerable fathers. At the Aposticha: Idiomela, 3, Tone 5; verses: "Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of His venerable ones" [LXX Ps. 115:6]; "Blessed is the man that fears the Lord" [LXX Ps. 111:1]; Glory: "The multitude of monks..."; Both now, Theotokion. Troparion, Tone 8: "With the streams of thy tears..."; Sessional hymn 3. At Matins: customary Kathisma psalmody, and the other prayers; Sessional hymns of the saint; Songs of Ascents of Tone 4, Antiphon 1; Prokeimenon: "Precious in the sight of the Lord..."; Verse: "What shall I render unto the Lord..." [LXX Ps. 115:3]; "Let every breath praise the Lord"; Gospel from Matthew, 3rd pericope of the week: "The Lord said: All things are delivered unto Me of My Father..." [Mt. 11:27–30]; Psalm 50; sticheron of the saint... ...Canon of the Octoechos on 6, and of the saint on 8. After Ode 6, Kontakion, Tone 8:*

units.verbatim_book_heading: PART III: MENOLOGION :: At the Aposticha of the Octoechos; Glory: "The multitude of monks..."; Both now, Theotokion. At the Liturgy: The sequence is written on the 28th.[^288]
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *On the 5th day: Our Venerable and God-bearing Father Sabbas the Sanctified; we celebrate until midday, an All-night Vigil. If the Hegumen wills: At Vespers: "Blessed is the man"; stichera on 8 (3 of Tone 5: "Venerable father..."); Glory, Tone 6: "That which is according to the image..."; Both now, Theotokion 1 of the tone: "Who would not bless thee..."; daily Prokeimenon; 3 Readings common to venerable fathers. At the Aposticha: Idiomela, 3, Tone 5; verses: "Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of His venerable ones" [LXX Ps. 115:6]; "Blessed is the man that fears the Lord" [LXX Ps. 111:1]; Glory: "The multitude of monks..."; Both now, Theotokion. Troparion, Tone 8: "With the streams of thy tears..."; Sessional hymn 3. At Matins: customary Kathisma psalmody, and the other prayers; Sessional hymns of the saint; Songs of Ascents of Tone 4, Antiphon 1; Prokeimenon: "Precious in the sight of the Lord..."; Verse: "What shall I render unto the Lord..." [LXX Ps. 115:3]; "Let every breath praise the Lord"; Gospel from Matthew, 3rd pericope of the week: "The Lord said: All things are delivered unto Me of My Father..." [Mt. 11:27–30]; Psalm 50; sticheron of the saint... ...Canon of the Octoechos on 6, and of the saint on 8. After Ode 6, Kontakion, Tone 8:*

units.slavonic_diplomatic: Дн҃ь неплодьствнаꙗ съѫзы · разрѣшаю тсѧ їѡакыма и а҃нноу оуслышавъ паче на дежа родити еѧ ꙗвѣ · грѧдеть бо ѡтро ковица · из неꙗже самь роди сѧ неѡписа нныи · зелень бывь · и аг҃гломь повелѣ въ пити еи · радоуисѧ ѡбрадованнаꙗ гь с то бою :~ сл҃а сщ҃енью ꙗко вышнаа · се г҃і ·
units.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* *Today the bonds of barrenness are loosed, for having heard Joachim and Anne, beyond hope she clearly conceives: for the Maiden goes forth, from Whom He Who is uncircumscribed was Himself born, becoming a mortal, and commanded the Angel to cry unto her: Rejoice, O thou full of grace, the Lord is with thee!*

units.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion:* *The sweet-singing voice of thy words, O Hermogenes, having drawn up Menas from the depth of perdition, appointed him as a director unto life; from whence also Eugraphus, rejoicing, cuts down the emperor's flatterers, for a glorious crown, and with diligence pray marvelously that all who sing of thee with love may be saved!*

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: главоу и и прилежно моли дивно
units.slavonic_diplomatic: ꙗ главоу · и и прилежно моли дивно · сп҃сти сѧ всѣмь любовїю поющимъ тѧ :~ на лѵ тоургіи · про[кименъ] Ст҃ымь иже сѫ[ть] · ст҃и Прѣ[д]зрѣ[хъ]
units.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion:* *As a star of great radiance, having mounted upon the pillar, O blessed one, thou didst enlighten the world by thy venerable deeds, and the darkness of deceit hast thou driven away, O father; therefore we pray thee even now: Shine into the hearts of thy servants the unwaning light of understanding!*

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *At the Aposticha of the Octoechos: Glory, Tone 4: "Venerable father, hierarch..."; Both now, Theotokion. At the Divine Liturgy: Prokeimenon: "Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of His venerable one" [LXX Ps. 115:6]; Verse: "What shall I render unto the Lord for all that He hath rendered unto me?" [LXX Ps. 115:3]; the Apostle: see the 6th of this month [Heb. 13:17–21]; Alleluia: "Thy priests shall be clothed with righteousness" [LXX Ps. 131:9]; Gospel from Luke, on Friday of the 20th week: "At that time, Jesus stood in a plain..." [Lk. 6:17–23]; Communion verse: "In everlasting remembrance shall the righteous be" [LXX Ps. 111:6].[^299]*

units.verbatim_book_heading: PART III: MENOLOGION :: At Matins: Canons of the Octoechos and of the saints on 6. After Ode 6, Kontakion, Tone 4
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *On the 13th day: The Holy Martyrs Eustratius, Auxentius, Eugene, Mardarius, and Orestes, and our Venerable Father Arsenius of Mount Latros. At Vespers: Stichera of the saints on 6; Glory, Tone 6: "Come, ye lovers of the martyrs..."; Both now, Theotokion. At the Aposticha of the Octoechos: Glory, Tone 5: "Ye martyrs..."; Both now, Theotokion. Troparion: "Thy martyrs, O Lord...", and "With the streams of Thy tears..."; see the 13th. At Matins: Canon of the Octoechos, and of the saints on 6. After Ode 6, Kontakion, Tone 2... ...who fought well on earth, and in the heavens were gloriously crowned, the fivefold company of defenders and deliverers of the faithful, among whom Eustratius shone forth as the sun among the stars; let us honor them with hymns and faith, as they pray diligently for us all!*

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *Sunday of the Holy Forefathers. We celebrate an All-Night Vigil, and the office of the saint whose commemoration happens to fall on that Sunday is set aside; it is sung on Friday at Compline; but the resurrectional hymns and those of the holy Forefathers are sung. On Saturday, at Small Vespers: ...resurrectional [stichera] and to the Theotokos as usual. At Great Vespers: after the customary psalm, "Blessed is the man"; at "Lord, I have cried," we sing 10 stichera: 3 resurrectional, 4 Anatolian, and of the holy Forefathers 3 on Tone 8: "He who in Eden's paradise..."; Glory, Tone 8: "The fathers before the Law..."; Both now, the 1st Theotokion of the current tone. At the Entrance, stichera of the saint of whom the monastery is named, as usual. At the Aposticha: resurrectional sticheron from the Alphabet; Glory, Tone 3: the composition of the Forefathers; Both now, Theotokion to the same tone from the Alphabet. At the blessing of the loaves: Troparion "O Virgin Theotokos" twice; Glory... Both now..., Tone 2, to the Fathers:*

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *...of the Forefathers. After the Kathismata: resurrectional sessional hymns with their Theotokia; "Blessed are the undefiled" [LXX Ps. 118]; Psalm, Tone...; and of the other prayers; Hymns of Ascents; Prokeimenon, Tone...; "Let every breath praise the Lord"; Resurrection Gospel; "Having beheld the resurrection of Christ..."; Psalm [50]; resurrectional sticheron. [Lk. 14:16–24]; Communion verse: "Praise ye the Lord from the heavens" [LXX Ps. 148:1].*

units.verbatim_book_heading: PART III: MENOLOGION :: At Matins: Canon of the Octoechos on 6, to Daniel on 4, and to the Children on 4. After Ode 3, Kontakion [of St. Daniel], Tone 3
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *...at Small Vespers: resurrectional [stichera] and to the Theotokos as usual. At Great Vespers: "Blessed is the man"; at "Lord, I have cried," we sing 10 stichera: 3 resurrectional, 1 Anatolian, 3 of the Forefeast, and 3 of the Fathers, Tone 8: "He who in Eden's paradise..."; Glory, Tone 6: "Daniel, a man of desires..."; Both now: "Prepare, O cave...". Entrance; Prokeimenon; 3 Readings, as on the 7th Sunday after Pascha. At the Litiya: Dogmatica of the current tone as usual; Glory, Tone 1: "Unto them that serve the stars..."; Both now, the same tone: "Hear, O heaven...". At the Aposticha: resurrectional sticheron and the Alphabet stichera; Glory, Tone 2: "Rejoice, ye honorable prophets..."; Both now: "Behold, the time is at hand...". Blessing of the loaves: Troparion "O Virgin Theotokos" twice, and "Great are the achievements of faith" once. Reading in the Epistles. At Matins: resurrectional troparion twice; Glory to the Children [Troparion of the Three Children and Daniel]; Both now, Theotokion of the same tone. After the Kathismata: resurrectional sessional hymns; "Blessed are the undefiled" [LXX Ps. 118] with their troparia; Psalm, Tone 8; and of the other prayers; Hymns of Ascents of the tone; "Let every breath praise the Lord"; Resurrection Gospel; "Having beheld the resurrection of Christ...[^307]"*

units.slavonic_diplomatic: престави сѧ · пресщ҃еныи , митрополитъ , петръ · всеꙗ роуси · въ г҃ · ча[съ] · нощи · в лѣ то , ҂ѕ҃ · тысеща · ѡ҃ · л҃д · пасъ цр҃ковь бж҃їю лѣтъ · и҃і · и мц҃ь · ѕ҃ · и положень бы[сть] · въ гра дѣ москвѣ · въ цр҃кви оуспеньꙗ стыꙗ бца ·
units.english_cohort_translation: *On the 20th day: The Holy Hieromartyr Ignatius the God-Bearer. We begin the Forefeast of the Nativity of Christ. On that day reposed the Most Consecrated Metropolitan Peter of All Rus', at the 3rd hour of the night, in the year 6834 [1326 AD]; he pastured the Church of God for 18 years and 6 months, and was laid to rest in the city of Moscow, in the Church of the Dormition of the Holy Theotokos.[^309]*

units.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* *Make ready, O Bethlehem: Eden is opened unto all! Adorn thyself, O Ephratha, for the Tree of Life hath blossomed forth from the Virgin in the cave! units.verbatim_section_rubric: *It is fitting to know: Thus is the order until the Canon of the Nativity of Christ; the Octoechos is not sung until the Baptism [Theophany] is completed; this is from the 20th day of the month of December until the 14th of January, on which the Feast of Theophany is leave-taken. units.slavonic_stem_tier2: мари дьвъчревоносащи безсеменно роже ство наста
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Марїꙗ · дьвъчревоносащи безсѣменно роже ство · наста же времѧ ржⷭ҇тва и мѣсто не бѣ ѡбители · но ꙗко красна палата вертепъ цр҃ци показа · Хс҃ ражаетсѧ прежде падшии въскрⷭ҇си ти ѡбразъ :~
units.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion:* *Fleeing fair-seemingly the nobility of rank, adorned in a bridegroom-like manner, thou wast united in dove-like likeness from the Virgin, showing thyself crown-bearing unto virgins, O sacredly-robed one, who in truth didst love the nobility of divine glory!*
units.slavonic_text: Марїꙗ · дьвъчревоносащи безсѣменно роже ство · наста же времѧ ржⷭ҇тва и мѣсто не бѣ ѡбители · но ꙗко красна палата вертепъ цр҃ци показа · Хс҃ ражаетсѧ прежде падшии въскрⷭ҇си ти ѡбразъ :~
units.english_text: *Kontakion:* *Fleeing fair-seemingly the nobility of rank, adorned in a bridegroom-like manner, thou wast united in dove-like likeness from the Virgin, showing thyself crown-bearing unto virgins, O sacredly-robed one, who in truth didst love the nobility of divine glory!*

ѡбители · но ꙗко красна палата вертепъ цр҃ци

units.slavonic_diplomatic: ликъ · а҃ · гл҃еть · сти[хъ] · Гн҃ оуслышахъ слоу
units.english_cohort_translation: *The deacon: the Great Litany; and after "Let us pray to the Lord", the priest exclaims; and the singers of one side begin the Troparion, Tone 8: "Bethlehem, make ready...". After this, the other side sings the same Troparion. And again the 1st choir says the verse: "Lord, I have heard Thy report, and was afraid" [LXX Hab. 3:2]; and they sing the Troparion, Tone 3; and now the Prophecy. Immediately the other choir says the verse: "God shall come from Teman" [LXX Hab. 3:3]; they sing the same Troparion, and now the Prophecy. Then the 1st choir with a higher voice...[^316]*

Immediately the other choir says the verse: "God shall come from Teman" [LXX Hab. 3:3]; they sing the same Troparion, and now the Prophecy. Then the 1st choir with a higher voice...[^316]*

units.english_cohort_translation: *The deacon: the Great Litany; the priest exclaims. And the 1st choir begins the Troparion, Tone 1: "Come, ye faithful, let us behold where Christ is born..."; then the 2nd choir, that Troparion. And immediately the choir says the verse: "The kings of Tharsis and the isles shall offer gifts" [LXX Ps. 71:10]; and they sing the Troparion, Tone 4: "Hear, O heaven, and give ear, O earth..."; then the 2nd choir: the verse: "And all families of the nations shall worship before Him" [LXX Ps. 21:28]; and they sing the same Troparion.[^319]*

units.english_cohort_translation: *The deacon: the litany, and fulfills the prayers; and the priest exclaims. And we say the Troparion: "She was enrolled..."; then: "Quickly go before...". The Trisagion; after "Our Father", the priest: "For Thine is the kingdom". And we say the Kontakion: "Today the Virgin..."; "Lord, have mercy" (12 times); and the priest: "God be gracious unto us...". And we stand a little, praying in ourselves secretly. The priest: "Blessed is our God!"; and we say: the Trisagion; after "Our Father", the priest: "For Thine is the kingdom"; "Lord, have mercy" (12 times); "O come, let us worship" (3 times).*

units.english_cohort_translation: *The deacon: the Great Litany; and the priest exclaims. And the 1st choir begins, Tone 1: "When Joseph..."; and the second choir, the same Troparion. Then the 1st choir says the verse: "Give the king Thy judgments, O God" [LXX Ps. 71:2]; and they sing the Troparion, Tone 6: "Today He is born..."; and immediately the 2nd choir says the verse: "He shall come down like rain upon the fleece" [LXX Ps. 71:6]; and they sing that Troparion. Then the 1st choir: Glory, Tone 8: "O lawgivers..."; Both now, the same, both choirs together.*

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: млтвы по възгла и глит тро
units.slavonic_diplomatic: мл҃твы · по҃ възгла · и҆ гл҃ить тро҃ списа ся · та҃ не преданъ же бѧ · трⷭ҇тое по ѿче нш҃ь по҃ ꙗ҆ко твое црⷭ҇тво · гл҃имь ко҃ дв҃а днь ·~ гн҃ помїлоуи в҃і · та҃ ѱл҃ѡ рв҃ · бл҃ви дш҃е мо ꙗ г҃а и҆ вса въноубрь · і҆ нь · рд҃е · хвали дше моꙗ г҃а · бл҃жна просто · помѣни ны г҃и · лїкъ нбⷭ҇ныи · ѡ҆слаби ѡ҆стави · та҃ ко҃ дв҃а днь · гн҃ помїлоуи · м҃ · и҆ съвръшеныи ѿ поу · ѡ҃ .ѳ҃., мже, часѣ знаменаеть къ великое · и҆ збираем[ся], въ цр҃ковь · ѡ҆блачи тсѧ, по҃ · въ всѧ ризы · и҆ начинаєдь вече рню · бл҃вникшоу їє́рєоу · гл҃имь цр҃ю нбⷭ҇ны трⷭ҇тое по ѿче нш҃ь · по҃ ꙗ҆ко твое црⷭ҇тво · гн҃ помїлоуи в҃і · прїте поклонимся · г҃, ѱл҃ѡ рг҃ · бл҃ви дш҃е моꙗ г҃а · сл҃а і҆ нн҃ѣ а҆ллилуиа ·
units.english_cohort_translation: *At about the 9th or 10th hour, he strikes the semantron for the Great [Service], and we gather into church. The priest vests in all his vestments, and begins Vespers: the priest having blessed, we say: "O Heavenly King"; the Trisagion; after "Our Father", the priest: "For Thine is the kingdom"; "Lord, have mercy" (12 times); "O come, let us worship" (3 times); Psalm 103: "Bless the Lord, O my soul" [LXX Ps. 103:1]; Glory... Both now... Alleluia (3 times).*

units.english_cohort_translation: *At the 10th hour of the day, he strikes the semantron; we sing Vespers according to the previously written order. If the Eve is on Saturday: "Blessed is the man" [Kathisma 1]. After the paremias: on Saturday and Sunday before the Apostle: "Holy God" is not sung, but after the paremias there is the Little Litany; the priest exclaims; and there is said: Prokeimenon, Tone 4: "The Lord said unto Me: Thou art My Son"; Verse: "Ask of Me" [LXX Ps. 2:7, 8]. units.slavonic_stem_tier2: и ермоси по едином у оба лика въкупе
units.slavonic_diplomatic: и҆ є҆рмоси по є҆дином[у] · ѡ҆ба лика въкѫпѣ · по г҃ · пѣ · ѵ҆пакои · гла҃ и҃ · Начатокъ ꙗ҆зыкъ н҃бо ти принесе · лежѧщоумоу младенцю въ ꙗ҆сле · звѣздою волхвы призвавъ · ꙗ҆же стра шаше нескыпетры прⷭ҇тлъ · н҃ ж послѣднею ни щетою · что бо хѫжьше вертьпа · что же смирєнѣє пелень · въ ни же въсїꙗ бж҃твное бг҃атество твое · г҃и слава тебѣ :~ и҆ чтѐе · въ бг҃ословѣ · х҃с ражаетсѧ · по ѕ҃ · пѣ кн҃ ·
units.english_cohort_translation: *Hypakoe:* *The firstfruits of the Gentiles heaven brought unto Thee, lying an infant in the manger, calling the Magi by a star; whom neither sceptres nor thrones terrified, but the lowest poverty: for what is poorer than a cave, and what is humbler than swaddling clothes, in which shined forth the divine riches of Thy Divinity? O Lord, glory to Thee!*

units.english_cohort_translation: *Glory, Both now; Kontakion: "The Virgin today..." [gives birth to the Transcendent in essence]. In place of the Trisagion: "As many as have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ, Alleluia" [Gal. 3:27]. Prokeimenon, Tone 8: "Let all the earth worship Thee, and sing unto Thee" [LXX Ps. 65:4]; Verse: "Sing unto the Lord a new song" [LXX Ps. 95:1]. Apostle to the Galatians: "Brethren, when the fulness of time was come..." [Gal. 4:4–7]. Alleluia, Tone 1: "The heavens shall confess Thy wonders, O Lord" [LXX Ps. 88:6]; Verse: "Day unto day pours forth speech" [LXX Ps. 18:3]. Gospel from Matthew: "When Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea..." [Mt. 2:1–12]. Communion verse: "The Lord hath sent redemption unto His people" [LXX Ps. 110:9]. And entering into the refectory, there is consolation for the brethren on this day.*

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *On the 26th day: The Synaxis of the Holy Theotokos; and of the holy Joseph the Betrothed; and of the holy hieromartyr Euthymius. His service is sung at Compline and at Matins. Troparion of the feast, 3 times. Two Kathismata; Sessional hymns of the feast. Two canons of the feast: they sing the first to 6, the heirmoi twice; the other with the heirmos to 6; Katavasia: "Christ is born...". And we do not say the [Biblical] Odes, even until the Apodosis of the feast of the Holy Theophany. After Ode 3, Kontakion of the feast. After Ode 6, Kontakion, Tone 6, Idiomelon:...[^331]*

Great Doxology; troparion of the feast; litany; dismissal.*

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *At the Liturgy: The Beatitudes of the feast, Odes 3 and 6. Kontakion: "He who was born before the morning star...". Prokeimenon, the Song of the Theotokos: "My soul doth magnify the Lord" [Lk. 1:46]; Verse: "For He hath regarded the lowliness of His handmaiden" [Lk. 1:48]. Apostle: "Brethren, both He that sanctifies and they who are sanctified are all of one..." [Heb. 2:11–18]. Alleluia, Tone 8: "Arise, O Lord, into Thy rest" [LXX Ps. 131:8]. Gospel from Matthew: "When the wise men were departed..." [Mt. 2:13–23]. Communion verse: "The Lord hath sent redemption unto His people" [LXX Ps. 110:9].*

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *On Saturday, at Little Vespers: from the Octoechos, Resurrection and Theotokion according to custom; but the service of the saints which is in the [Menaion] is sung when the superior of the church desires it. At Great Vespers: "Blessed is the man" [Kathisma 1]. On "Lord, I have cried", we sing 3 Resurrection stichera; and of the feast, 4, Tone 2: "Come, let us rejoice..."; and of the saints, 3, Tone 1, Podoben: "Thou who bearest flesh..."; Glory, Tone 6: "Rejoicing, we celebrate [the memory]..."; Both now, Theotokion of the current tone. Entrance according to custom. At the Aposticha: Resurrection sticheron, and the Alphabetical stichera; Glory, Tone 6: "Jerusalem, rejoice..."; Both now, of the feast. Blessing of the loaves; Troparion, Tone 2: "Rejoice, O Virgin Theotokos..." twice, and of the saints once (Ра́дꙋйсѧ живоно́сный Крⷭ҇те):*

units.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion:* *As a radiant star shining from Edessa unto us, O blessed one, thou hast attained, and with virtues hast thundered forth, a guide unto monks and many, O venerable one; and therefore thou hast enlightened the reigning imperial city; therefore we cry unto thee: Rejoice, O all-blessed father!*

*As a radiant star shining from Edessa unto us, O blessed one, thou hast attained, and with virtues hast thundered forth, a guide unto monks and many, O venerable one; and therefore thou hast enlightened the reigning imperial city; therefore we cry unto thee: Rejoice, O all-blessed father!*

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *...After Ode 6: Kontakion of the feast. At the Praises: Idiomelon stichera of the saints, Tone 1, twice; and another, Tone 2; and of the saint; Glory, Tone 6: "O venerable father..."; Both now, of the feast. At the Divine Liturgy: From the Canons: of the feast, Ode 3; and of the Innocents, Ode 6. Prokeimenon: "Praise, O ye servants, the Lord" [LXX Ps. 112:1]. Apostle: "Brethren, both He that sanctifies and they who are sanctified are all of one..." [Heb. 2:11–18], of the 26th day. Alleluia: "Their blood have they shed like water" [LXX Ps. 78:3]. Gospel in order: "When the wise men were departed..." [Mt. 2:13–23]. Communion verse: "Rejoice in the Lord, O ye righteous" [LXX Ps. 32:1].*

units.verbatim_book_heading: PART III: MENOLOGION :: The rest: the Divine Liturgy of the Great Basil. Communion verse: "Praise the Lord" [LXX Ps. 148:1]
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *"Come, let us rejoice in the Lord...", on 6. Glory, Both now: "When Augustus reigned alone upon earth...". At the Aposticha: of the feast, with its own verses. Glory, Both now: "Rejoice, O Jerusalem!". Troparion of the feast. At Matins: Troparion of the feast, 3 times; Sessional hymns of the feast. Canons: two of the feast: the first, that is, to 8; and the second, that is, to 6; Katavasia: "Christ is born...", both choirs together. After Ode 3, Sessional hymn of the feast. After Ode 6, Kontakion of the feast and Ikos. At Ode 9: we do not sing "More honorable"; Exapostilarion of the feast, twice. At the Praises: Idiomela, Tone 4: "Rejoice, ye righteous...", on 4. Glory, Both now, Tone 6: "When the time...". Great Doxology; Troparion of the feast; litany; dismissal; customary departure; and the First Hour.*

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *At Ode 9: we do not sing "More honorable"; Exapostilarion of the feast. At the Praises: Prosomoion, 3, and of the saint, Tone 5, on 4; Glory, Tone 6: "Grace was poured out..."; Both now: "Descending unto the human race...". Be it known: If this feast happen to fall on a Sunday, an All-Night Vigil takes place; but on other days there is no All-Night Vigil.*

coordinates.section: At Vespers: Stichera: 3 of the Forefeast, Tone 4; 3 of the saint, Tone 8; Glory, Both now, Tone 6: "He goes unto the Jordan...". At the Aposticha: Idiomela, 3 of the Forefeast: "Coming unto the witness..."; another, Tone 2: "Again Jesus..."; another, Tone 3. And they say verses: "Therefore will I remember Thee from the land of Jordan..." [LXX Ps. 41:7]; "The waters saw Thee, O God, the waters saw Thee" [LXX Ps. 76:17]. And they say these verses at Vespers, and at Matins, even unto the Eve of the Enlightenment [Theophany]. Glory, Both now, Tone 3: "Come, all ye faithful...". Troparion, Tone 4

units.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* *Prepare thyself, O Zebulun, and adorn thyself, O Naphtali! O Jordan river, stand; receive with leaping the Master coming to be baptized! Rejoice, O Adam with the first mother; hide not yourselves as in paradise of old; for seeing you naked He hath appeared, that He may clothe you in your primal vesture: Christ hath appeared...[^342]*

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *...Liturgy: From the canons: of the Forefeast, Ode 3 on 4; to the martyr, Ode 6 on 4. Prokeimenon: "The righteous shall rejoice in the Lord" [LXX Ps. 63:11]; Verse: "Hear my voice, O God" [LXX Ps. 63:2]. Epistle to Timothy: "Child Timothy, by the putting on of hands..." [2 Tim. 1:3–9]. Alleluia: "The righteous man shall flourish like a palm tree" [LXX Ps. 91:13]. Gospel from Matthew: "At that time, the Lord said: Behold, I send you forth as sheep in the midst of wolves..." [Mt. 10:16–22]. Communion verse: "In everlasting memory shall the righteous be" [LXX Ps. 111:6].*

units.slavonic_diplomatic: г҃ · жды · канонъ · прѣпразнествоу · на ѕ҃ · и҆ ст҃ыхь · на д҃ · по г҃ · пѣсни · тѣ҃ :~
units.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* *The river Jordan once turned back before the mantle of Elisha, when Elijah was taken up; and the waters were divided hither and thither, and the watery way became dry land unto him, as a true type of baptism, whereby we traverse the flux of transient life: Christ hath appeared at the Jordan to sanctify the waters!*

units.english_cohort_translation: *...And at the beginning of the first hour [of the day], the klepalo is struck, and we assemble into church and sing two Hours: the First and the Third. The Priest and Deacon vest in their vestments, and the Priest says: "Blessed is our God...". And we say: "Heavenly King...", Trisagion; after "Our Father...", Priest: "For Thine is the kingdom..."; "Lord, have mercy" 12 times; "Come, let us worship..." 3 times. First Hour: Psalm 5: "Give ear to my words, O Lord" [LXX Ps. 5:2]; Psalm 22: "The Lord shepherds me" [LXX Ps. 22:1]; Psalm 26: "The Lord is my light and my savior" [LXX Ps. 26:1]. Glory, Both now; Alleluia 3 times. The Deacon says the Great Litany; after the exclamation, the First Choir begins: Troparion, Tone 8: "Today the nature of the waters..."; and the other choir, the same troparion. Then the first choir says the verse: "Therefore will I remember Thee from the land of Jordan..." [LXX Ps. 41:7], and they sing: Troparion, Tone 8: "As man didst Thou come to the river, O Christ King...". After that, the second choir says the verse: "The waters saw Thee, O God, the waters saw Thee" [LXX Ps. 76:17], and they sing the same troparion: "As man didst Thou come...". Then the first choir: Glory, Tone 8, Idiomelon; Both now, the same, both choirs together. The Deacon says the Little Litany: "Again and again..."; the Priest...[^347]*

units.english_cohort_translation: *...exclaims; and there is said: Prokeimenon: "The Lord thundered from heaven" [LXX Ps. 17:14]; Verse: "I will love Thee, O Lord, my strength" [LXX Ps. 17:2]. After that, the Prophecy of Isaiah: "Thus says the Lord: The wilderness and the solitary place shall be glad..." [Isa. 35:1–10]; the lection written for the Blessing of the Waters. Epistle from the Acts: In those days... [Acts 13:25–32]. Deacon: "Wisdom, upright, let us hear the Holy Gospel"; "At that time, Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee to be baptized by John in the Jordan..." [Mt. 3:13–17]. Deacon says the Litany: "Let us complete our prayer..."; the Priest exclaims; and there is said: Troparion: "The river Jordan once turned back..."; then: "Order my steps in Thy word..." [LXX Ps. 118:133]; Trisagion; after "Our Father...", Priest: "For Thine is the kingdom..."; Kontakion: "In the streams of Jordan..."; "Lord, have mercy" 40 times; Priest: "God be gracious unto us, and bless us..."; and with prayer to the All-Holy [Trinity]. Again the Priest says: "Blessed is our God...". And we say: Trisagion; after "Our Father...", Priest: "For Thine is the kingdom..."; "Lord, have mercy" 12 times; "Come, let us worship..." 3 times. Psalm 28: "Bring unto the Lord, O ye sons of God" [LXX Ps. 28:1]; Psalm 41: "As the hart pants after the fountains of water" [LXX Ps. 41:2]; Psalm 50: "Have mercy upon me, O God" [LXX Ps. 50:3]...[^348]*
