Troparion, Tone 4 :: At Matins: Troparion of the Forefeast, 3 times; Canon of the Forefeast to 6; and of the saints to 4. After Ode 3, Sessional hymns of the saints. After Ode 6, Kontakion: "In the streams of Jordan...". After Ode 9, Exapostilarion. At the Praises and at the Aposticha: all of the Forefeast. Troparion; litany; dismissal; First Hour; and we do not combine [these Hours with Matins]...

units.english_cohort_translation: *...Alleluia 3 times. The Deacon says the Great Litany; after the exclamation, the First Choir begins: Troparion, Tone 8: "The right hand of the Forerunner..."; and the other choir, the same troparion. And immediately the first choir says the verse: "Therefore will I remember Thee from the land of Jordan..." [LXX Ps. 41:7]; Troparion, Tone 4: "Our God is a Trinity..."; then the second choir says the verse: "The waters saw Thee, O God, the waters saw Thee" [LXX Ps. 76:17], and they sing the same troparion: "Our God is a Trinity...". After that, the first choir: Glory, Tone 5: "Coming in the flesh unto the Jordan, O Lord..."; Both now, the same, both choirs together. The Deacon says the Little Litany; after the exclamation, they sing: Prokeimenon: "The waters saw Thee, O God, the waters saw Thee" [LXX Ps. 76:17]; Verse: "Give ear to my words, O Lord" [LXX Ps. 5:2]. After that, the Prophecy of Isaiah: "Thus says the Lord: Wash you, make you clean; put away the evil of your doings from before Mine eyes..." [Isa. 1:16–20]. Epistle from the Acts, appointed for Friday of the 6th week: "When the Apostles were..." [Acts 19:1–8]. Gospel from Mark, appointed for the Sunday before the Enlightenment: "The beginning of the Gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God..." [Mk. 1:1–8]. Litany: "Let us complete our prayer..."; the Priest exclaims; and we say: Troparion: "The river Jordan once turned back..."; then: "Blessed be the Lord God..." [LXX Ps. 67:20]; Trisagion; after "Our Father...", Priest: "For Thine is the kingdom..."; Kontakion: "In the streams of Jordan..."; "Lord, have mercy" 12 times; Dismissal...[^349]*

units.english_cohort_translation: *At the 4th hour of the day, the semantron signals: 2 strokes; and at the strokes the Priest and Deacon vest in all their sacred vestments. We sing two Hours together. The Priest having blessed, they say: "Heavenly King...", Trisagion; after "Our Father...", Priest: "For Thine is the kingdom..."; "Lord, have mercy" 12 times; "Come, let us worship..." 3 times.*

units.english_cohort_translation: *Great Litany; the Priest exclaims; and the First Choir begins: Troparion, Tone 8: "Thus says the Lord unto John..."; and the other choir, the same troparion. Then the first choir says the verse: "Therefore will I remember Thee from the land of Jordan..." [LXX Ps. 41:7], and they sing: Troparion, Tone 6: "Today the prophetic scripture is fulfilled...". And immediately the First Choir: Glory, Tone 5: "What turnest thou back, O Jordan..."; Both now, the same, both choirs together. The Deacon says the Little Litany; the Priest exclaims; and they say: Prokeimenon, Tone 4: "The voice of the Lord is upon the waters" [LXX Ps. 28:3]; Verse: "Bring unto the Lord, O ye sons of God" [LXX Ps. 28:1]. Prophecy of Isaiah: "Thus says the Lord: Ho, everyone that thirsts..." [Isa. 55:1–13]...[^350]*

units.english_cohort_translation: *...thirsts, come ye to the waters...". Epistle of Great Saturday: ["Brethren, so many of us as were baptized into Jesus Christ were baptized into His death..." [Rom. 6:3–11]]. Gospel from Matthew: "At that time, comes Jesus [from Galilee to Jordan unto John]..."; the end: "...in Whom I am well pleased" [Mt. 3:13–17], appointed for the Liturgy on the feast day. Litany and Supplication Prayers. We say the Troparion: "The river Jordan once turned back..."; then: "Let Thy tender mercies speedily prevent us, O Lord" [LXX Ps. 78:8]; Trisagion; after "Our Father...", Priest: "For Thine is the kingdom..."; Kontakion: "In the streams of Jordan..."; "Lord, have mercy" 12 times; Priest: "God be gracious unto us, and bless us...". And having made a little pause, as daylight appears [or while waiting a short space], again the Priest says: "Blessed is our God...". And we say: Trisagion; after "Our Father...", Priest: "For Thine is the kingdom..."; "Lord, have mercy" 12 times; "Come, let us worship..." 3 times.*

units.verbatim_book_heading: PART III: MENOLOGION :: At Vespers: Stichera of the Forefeast and of the saints together; Glory, Both now, of the Forefeast. At the Aposticha: all of the feast. Troparion, Tone 4
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *...and they sing the same troparion. Then the First Choir: Glory, Tone 5: "Thy hand which touched the immaculate head of the Master..."; Both now, the same, both choirs together. The Deacon says the Little Litany; the Priest exclaims; and they say: Prokeimenon: "The Lord is my light and my savior" [LXX Ps. 26:1]; Verse: "The Lord is the defender of my life" [LXX Ps. 26:1]. Prophecy of Isaiah (the 13th, evening lection): "Thus says the Lord: In an acceptable time have I heard thee..." [Isa. 49:8–15]. Epistle to Titus: "Child Titus, the grace of God that brings salvation hath appeared..." [Titus 2:11–14; 3:4–7], appointed for the Liturgy on the feast day. Gospel from Luke: "Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar..." [Lk. 3:1–18]. At Vespers: Litany and Supplication Prayers; exclamation; and there is said the Troparion: "The river Jordan once turned back...". Then: "Deliver us not up utterly, for Thy holy name's sake..." [Dan. 3:34]; Trisagion; after "Our Father...", Priest: "For Thine is the kingdom..."; Kontakion: "In the streams of Jordan..."; "Lord, have mercy" 12 times. Then also the Typika: Psalm 102: "Bless the Lord, O my soul" [LXX Ps. 102:1]; Psalm 145: "Praise the Lord, O my soul" [LXX Ps. 145:1]; the Beatitudes we recite simply from the book; and the present prayer: "Pardon, remit, forgive, O God, our transgressions..."; Kontakion: "In the streams of Jordan..."; "Lord, have mercy" 40 times; Dismissal.*

units.verbatim_book_heading: PART III: MENOLOGION :: At Vespers: Stichera of the Forefeast and of the saints together; Glory, Both now, of the Forefeast. At the Aposticha: all of the feast. Troparion, Tone 4
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *...the Priest and Deacon, and Vespers takes place. The Priest having blessed, they say: "Heavenly King...", Trisagion; after "Our Father...", Priest: "For Thine is the kingdom..."; "Lord, have mercy" 12 times; "Come, let us worship..." 3 times. Psalm 103: "Bless the Lord, O my soul" [LXX Ps. 103:1]; Glory, Both now: Alleluia 3 times; Great Litany; exclamation. At "Lord, I have cried", exclamation 2. The Priest performs the Proskomide, and the Deacon censes. And we sing 8 stichera: 4 festal idiomela, twice; and to our hierarch, 3; Glory, Both now, Tone 2: "Thou bowedst Thy head unto the Forerunner...". Entrance with the Gospel. Prokeimenon of the day. Lections of the feast, according to their order. After the completion of the lections, Little Litany. The Priest recites the prayers of the Trisagion; exclamation: "For holy art Thou, [O our God]..."; and they sing: "Holy God". Then Prokeimenon, Tone 3: "The Lord is my light and my savior" [LXX Ps. 26:1]; Verse: "The Lord is the defender of my life" [LXX Ps. 26:1]. Epistle to the Corinthians: "Brethren, though I be free from all men..." [1 Cor. 9:19]. Alleluia, Tone 6: "My heart hath poured forth a good word" [LXX Ps. 44:2]. Gospel from Luke: "Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar..." [Lk. 3:1–18]. And the rest of the Divine Liturgy of Basil the Great, according to its order. At the conclusion of the Liturgy, [the Priest] places the Holy Cross with the dish upon his head...[^353]*

units.english_cohort_translation: *...with the dish upon his head, and goes down to the vessel where it is customary to bless water, preceded by candles and censers, chanting 3 troparia, Tone 8: "The voice of the Lord is upon the waters..."; and they sing 3 troparia out of the 12: "Today the nature of the waters is sanctified...", then: "Thus says the Lord unto John...". After this, the Deacon: "Wisdom!". Three lections for the water. Immediately, Prokeimenon: "The Lord is my light and my savior" [LXX Ps. 26:1]; Verse: "The Lord is the defender of my life" [LXX Ps. 26:1]. Epistle to the Corinthians: "Brethren, I would not have you ignorant [how that all our fathers were under the cloud...]" [1 Cor. 10:1–4]. Alleluia, Tone 4: "The voice of the Lord is upon the waters" [LXX Ps. 28:3]; Verse: "Bring unto the Lord, O ye sons of God" [LXX Ps. 28:1]. Gospel from Mark: "At that time, Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized of John in Jordan..." [Mk. 1:9–11]. After this, the Deacon says the Great Litany and the other petitions appointed for the consecration. While the litany is being said by the Deacon, the Priest recites the prayer secretly: "O Lord [Jesus Christ, Only-begotten Son...]"; at that same time, he does not exclaim, nor does he say "Amen" to himself. But when the Deacon says: "...Through the holy purity...", the Priest says aloud the great prayer: "Great art Thou, O Lord...". But if there be no deacon, the Priest recites the secret prayer: "O Lord, the Only-begotten...", while...[^354]*

units.slavonic_diplomatic: чьтоуть . парміи . д а бꙋде готовы сътво рити . великою . мл҃о . и по ѡктенѣ абые . начи наеть великою . мл҃о . велен еси г̃и . и по скон чаньи . мл҃о гл̃ть іереи . миръ всѣмь . дьіако главы ваша . по҃ . мл҃о . в тан . приклони г̃и оухо твое . та̃ кꙋзекр̃ть . и възгла̃ть . ꙗко ты еси с҃тыни наша . бл̃гвнвь водꙋ чт̃ны крⷪ҇тѡ̃ . прамо погрꙋзить . крⷪ҇ть въ водѣ .
units.english_cohort_translation: *...they read the Prophecies, that he may be ready to say the great prayer. And immediately after the litany, he begins the great prayer: "Great art Thou, O Lord, [and marvelous are Thy works...]". And at the conclusion of the prayer, the Priest says: "Peace be unto all". units.verbatim_section_rubric: *...the Priest and Deacon, and Vespers takes place. The Priest having blessed, they say: "Heavenly King...", Trisagion; after "Our Father...", Priest: "For Thine is the kingdom..."; "Lord, have mercy" 12 times; "Come, let us worship..." 3 times. Psalm 103: "Bless the Lord, O my soul" [LXX Ps. 103:1]; Glory, Both now: Alleluia 3 times; Great Litany; exclamation. At "Lord, I have cried", exclamation 2. The Priest performs the Proskomide, and the Deacon censes. And we sing 8 stichera: 4 festal idiomela, twice; and to our hierarch, 3; Glory, Both now, Tone 2: "Thou bowedst Thy head unto the Forerunner...". Entrance with the Gospel. Prokeimenon of the day. Lections of the feast, according to their order. After the completion of the lections, Little Litany. The Priest recites the prayers of the Trisagion; exclamation: "For holy art Thou, [O our God]..."; and they sing: "Holy God". Then Prokeimenon, Tone 3: "The Lord is my light and my savior" [LXX Ps. 26:1]; Verse: "The Lord is the defender of my life" [LXX Ps. 26:1]. Epistle to the Corinthians: "Brethren, though I be free from all men..." [1 Cor. 9:19]. Alleluia, Tone 6: "My heart hath poured forth a good word" [LXX Ps. 44:2]. Gospel from Luke: "Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar..." [Lk. 3:1–18]. And the rest of the Divine Liturgy of Basil the Great, according to its order. At the conclusion of the Liturgy, [the Priest] places the Holy Cross with the dish upon his head...[^353]*

units.english_cohort_translation: *Be it known: If the Eve of Theophany happen to fall on a Saturday or on a Sunday, there is no fast: the [penitential] troparia are not sung, nor are they sung on Friday... And on Saturday and Sunday, the Divine Liturgy of John Chrysostom takes place according to custom. After the dismissal of the Liturgy, they eat bread in church, and drink a cup [of wine]. But the Divine Liturgy of Basil the Great is completed on the feast day itself.*

Be it known also: If the Feast of the Holy Theophany happen to fall on a Sunday, of the Resurrection...[^357]*

units.verbatim_book_heading: PART III: MENOLOGION :: At Vespers: Stichera of the Forefeast and of the saints together; Glory, Both now, of the Forefeast. At the Aposticha: all of the feast. Troparion, Tone 4
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *At the 2nd hour of the night, the great semantron is struck, and we assemble into church. We sing Compline. After "Glory to God in the highest...", we sing 5 festal idiomela stichera, Tone 4; Glory, Tone 8: "O Lord, wishing to fulfill..."; Both now: "Today creation...". And after the customary prayers, we enter into the church, singing 3 idiomela, Tone 2: "In the river Jordan..."; [Verse]: "The waters saw Thee, O God..."; [Sticheron]: "Today Christ..."; and we say the verse: "The sea saw and fled" [LXX Ps. 113:3]; [Verse]: "What ailed thee, O thou sea, that thou fleddest?" [LXX Ps. 113:5]; Glory, Both now, Tone 6: "He that clothes Himself with light as with a garment...". Blessing of the loaves; Troparion of the feast, 3 times; then festal Sessional hymns...[^358]*

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: года ти выи те празникову сте
units.slavonic_diplomatic: года̃ ти выи . тѣ празниковꙋ . сте̃ д҃ ѻ . гла̃ про̃ гла̃ д҃ . море видѣвь . с҃ . что ти е̃ мо ре да по . вьсѣко ды . еѵ̃ліе . ѿ ма̃ . ѱ̃лѡ н҃ . стра празнно . канѡ̃ два гла̃ в҃ . г̃на коꙁмы . и г̃на іѡа̃ . ірм̃ь . подв҃і . тр҃о по д҃ . и пакы ірм̃ь по единож . ѡ ба лика вку̃ по г҃ . пѣ ѵпакои . гла̃ и҃ . егда ꙗвленіе мь твоимь просвѣтилъ еси всячьскаꙗ , то гда сланое се невѣрьствіе море бѣжа . іѡрда нь долꙋ текавъ възврати ся . на нбо къзнося на . на высотꙋ бж҃твныи ꙁаповѣдіи твоихь съблюди х҃е бж҃е . мл҃твами бц҃а помилꙋина :~
units.english_cohort_translation: *Hypakoe:* *After Ode 3, Hypakoe, Tone 8:* *When by Thy manifestation Thou enlightenedst all things, then this salty sea of unbelief fled, and Jordan flowing downward turned back, exalting us unto heaven: keep us upon the height of Thy divine commandments, O Christ God, through the prayers of the Mother of God, and have mercy upon us!*

units.english_cohort_translation: *And after the dismissal, the Priest being vested in priestly vestments, and carrying in his hands upon a dish the precious Wood [the Honorable Cross], with censer and candles going before, we process forth, chanting the Troparion: "The voice of the Lord is upon the waters..." [LXX Ps. 28:3], 3 times, out of the 12. And coming unto the water springs, and having stood there according to their order, the Deacon begins: "Bless, Master." [Priest:] "Blessed is the kingdom of the Father, and of the Son, [and of the Holy Spirit, now and ever, and unto ages of ages]". Deacon: Great Litany for the consecration. And the Priest says the secret prayer: "O Lord [Jesus Christ], Only-begotten Son...". When the Deacon says: "...Unto all the saints..." [or "...with all the saints..."], the Priest exclaims. Deacon: "Wisdom!". And they read 3 lections over the water. But when there is no deacon, the Priest says the litany himself; and the secret prayer he recites while they read the Prophecies. And after the Prophecies, there is said: Prokeimenon: "The Lord is my light and my savior" [LXX Ps. 26:1]; Verse: "The Lord is the defender... ...of my life" [LXX Ps. 26:1]. Epistle to the Corinthians: "Brethren, I would not that ye should be ignorant..." [1 Cor. 10:1–4]. Alleluia: "The voice of the Lord is upon the waters" [LXX Ps. 28:3]; Verse: "Bring unto the Lord, O ye sons of God" [LXX Ps. 28:1]. Gospel from Mark: "At that time, Jesus came [from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized of John in Jordan]..." [Mk. 1:9–11]. After this, the Priest begins the great prayer: "We glorify Thee, O Master...". And at the conclusion, the Priest says: "Peace be unto all." Deacon: "[Bow] your heads [unto the Lord]". Priest: secret prayer: "Incline Thine ear, O Lord...". Then, taking the Cross from the dish, he exclaims: "For Thou art our sanctification...". And having blessed the waters crosswise with the precious Cross, he immerses the Cross straight down into the water, chanting: "When Thou wast baptized in the Jordan, O Lord..." [Troparion of the feast]. And at the sprinkling of the sanctified water, we sing the troparion thrice. And returning unto the church, we sing: Glory, Both now: "The manifestation of the Trinity..."; Both now, Tone 6: "Let us praise, ye faithful...". After this, they kiss the precious Wood [the Cross]. Then: Litany: "Have mercy on us, O God..."; dismissal; and the First Hour.*

units.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion: "When Thou wast baptized in the Jordan, O Lord...".* *Entrance: "Blessed is He that comes in the name of the Lord; God is the Lord, and hath appeared unto us" [LXX Ps. 117:26–27]. Troparion: "When Thou wast baptized in the Jordan...". Glory, Both now, Kontakion of the feast. Instead of the Trisagion: "As many of you as have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ. Alleluia" [Gal. 3:27]. Prokeimenon, Tone 4: "Blessed is He that comes in the name of the Lord" [LXX Ps. 117:26]; Verse: "O give thanks unto the Lord, for He is good" [LXX Ps. 117:1]. Epistle to Titus: [Titus 2:11–14; 3:4–7]. Alleluia, Tone 4: "Bring unto the Lord, O ye sons of God" [LXX Ps. 28:1]; Verse: "The voice of the Lord is upon the waters" [LXX Ps. 28:3]. Gospel from Matthew: "At that time, comes Jesus [from Galilee to Jordan unto John]..." [Mt. 3:13–17]. Kinonikon: "The grace of God that brings salvation hath appeared unto all men" [Titus 2:11]. And there is consolation for the brethren, eating fish and oil.*

units.verbatim_book_heading: PART III: MENOLOGION :: At Vespers: Stichera of the Forefeast and of the saints together; Glory, Both now, of the Forefeast. At the Aposticha: all of the feast. Troparion, Tone 4
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *At Vespers: we do not chant the Kathisma. Stichera: 3 of the feast, 3 of the Forerunner; Glory, Tone 6: "The bodily luminary..."; Both now, Tone 6: "God the Word appeared...". Entrance. Great Prokeimenon, Tone 7: "Our God is in heaven and on earth: He hath done whatsoever He pleased" [LXX Ps. 113:11]; Verses: 1. "In the exodus of Israel out of Egypt..." [LXX Ps. 113:1]; 2. "The sea saw and fled..." [LXX Ps. 113:3]; 3. "What ailed thee, O thou sea, that thou fleddest?..." [LXX Ps. 113:5]. But if it be Saturday [evening]: "The Lord reigns..." [LXX Ps. 92:1]. At the Aposticha: Prosomoia, 3, Tone 4: "When they beheld Thee coming..."; Verses: [1. "The Lord reigns..." or "Therefore will I remember Thee..."]; 2. "The sea saw and fled"; 3. "What ailed thee, O thou sea...". Glory, Tone 4: "As a lover of the Spirit..."; Both now: of the feast, the same Tone. Troparion of the Forerunner, Tone 2: "The memory of the righteous is celebrated with hymns of praise, but the Lord's witness is sufficient for thee, O Forerunner..."; Glory, Both now, of the feast. At Matins: Troparion of the feast, twice; Glory, of the Forerunner; Both now, of the feast. After the Kathisma: Sessional hymns of the feast. Canons: of the feast to 6, and of the Forerunner to 6. After Ode 3, Hypakoe and Kontakion of the feast. After Ode 6, Kontakion, Tone 6:*

"The sea saw and fled..." [LXX Ps. 113:3]; 3. "What ailed thee, O thou sea, that thou fleddest?..." [LXX Ps. 113:5]. But if it be Saturday [evening]: "The Lord reigns..." [LXX Ps. 92:1]. At the Aposticha: Prosomoia, 3, Tone 4: "When they beheld Thee coming..."; Verses: [1. "The Lord reigns..." or "Therefore will I remember Thee..."]; 2. "The sea saw and fled"; 3. "What ailed thee, O thou sea...". Glory, Tone 4: "As a lover of the Spirit..."; Both now: of the feast, the same Tone. Troparion of the Forerunner, Tone 2: "The memory of the righteous is celebrated with hymns of praise, but the Lord's witness is sufficient for thee, O Forerunner..."; Glory, Both now, of the feast. At Matins: Troparion of the feast, twice; Glory, of the Forerunner; Both now, of the feast. After the Kathisma: Sessional hymns of the feast. Canons: of the feast to 6, and of the Forerunner to 6. After Ode 3, Hypakoe and Kontakion of the feast. After Ode 6, Kontakion, Tone 6:*

units.english_cohort_translation: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 1, Podoben: "The angelic choir" (Ликъ ангельскій):* *Beholding with the eyes of the soul, O hierarch, thou wast revealed unto the world as a vigilant shepherd: by the rod of thy wisdom and by this thy fervent intercession, thou hast driven away all the ill-believing like wolves; keep the flock unharmed, O most wise Gregory!*

units.verbatim_book_heading: PART III: MENOLOGION :: At Vespers: Stichera of the Forefeast and of the saints together; Glory, Both now, of the Forefeast. At the Aposticha: all of the feast. Troparion, Tone 4
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *After Ode 6: of the feast. At the Aposticha: all of the feast. At the Divine Liturgy: from the canons of the feast, Ode 3, and of the saint, Ode 6. Prokeimenon: "The saints shall be joyful in glory..." [LXX Ps. 149:5]... ...and they shall exult upon their beds [LXX Ps. 149:5]. Epistle to the Ephesians: "Brethren, unto every one of us is given grace..." [Eph. 4:7], appointed for the Sunday after Theophany. Alleluia: "Thy priests shall clothe themselves with righteousness..." [LXX Ps. 131:9]. Gospel from Matthew, November 23: "The Lord said: Ye are the light of the world..." [Mt. 5:14–19]. Kinonikon: "In everlasting memory [shall the righteous be]" [LXX Ps. 111:6].*

units.slavonic_diplomatic: пѣ̃ тро̃. гла а҃. ликь а̑ггль. Ѡ̑колды дшевнымы вьдѧ ст҃лю. бодръ пастырь ꙗвисѧ мирови. жеꙁломь премꙋдрости тво еѧ. и̑ теплымь прѣстательстводь си. всѧ ѡ̑гналь еси ꙁлославныѧ ꙗко волкы. невре димо съблюди стадо. григорье премꙋдре: — по ѕ҃. праꙁн̃. на сти. все праꙁн̃. на лур ѡни праꙁн. пѣ г҃. и̑ ст҃о ѕ҃. про̃. въсхва лѧтсѧ. а̑пл к ъ̑ефисеѡ̃. б҃рае, единому комоу н҃е по бо̃ꙗвлен. а̑ллуа. їерент вои.

units.verbatim_book_heading: PART III: MENOLOGION :: At Vespers: Stichera of the Forefeast and of the saints together; Glory, Both now, of the Forefeast. At the Aposticha: all of the feast. Troparion, Tone 4
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *At Vespers: "Blessed is the man..." [Kathisma 1]. Stichera of the saint, on 6, Tone 5: "O venerable father..."; Both now, of the feast. Entrance; Prokeimenon of the day; 3 Lections common to venerable fathers. At the Aposticha: of the feast; Glory: "The multitude of the monastics..."; Both now, of the feast. Troparion: "With the streams of thy tears..." [Tone 8]; Glory, Both now, of the feast. At Matins: Troparion of the feast, twice; Glory, of the saint; Both now, of the feast. After the Kathismata: Sessional hymns of the feast; and the Polyeleos. Sessional hymn of the saint of the same tone. Prokeimenon: "Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of His saints" [LXX Ps. 115:6]; Verse: "What shall I render unto the Lord for all that He hath rendered unto me?" [LXX Ps. 115:3]. Gospel from Luke, in memory of the 20th Sunday: "At that time, Jesus stood on a level place..." [Lk. 6:17–23]. Psalm 50 [LXX Ps. 50:3]; Sticheron of the saint. Canons: of the feast to 6, and of the saint to 6; Katavasia: "The depths of the sea...". After Ode 3, Kontakion of the saint, Tone 8:*

units.english_cohort_translation: *At the Divine Liturgy: from the canons of the feast to 6, and of the saint to 6. Prokeimenon: "Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of His saints" [LXX Ps. 115:6]; Verse: "What shall I render unto the Lord?" [LXX Ps. 115:3]. Epistle of the 15th Sunday [2 Cor. 4:6–15 or Gal. 5:22–6:2]. Alleluia: "Blessed is the man that fears the Lord" [LXX Ps. 111:1]; Verse: "His seed shall be mighty upon earth" [LXX Ps. 111:2]. Gospel from Matthew, Thursday of the 3rd Week [Mt. 11:27–30]: "The Lord said: All things [are delivered unto Me of My Father]...". Kinonikon: "In everlasting memory [shall the righteous be]" [LXX Ps. 111:6].*

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *At Matins: [Troparion of the feast] thrice. Two canons: one with its heirmos to 8, and the other with its heirmos to 6; Katavasia: "The depths of the sea...", both choirs together. After Ode 3, Sessional hymn of the feast. After Ode 6, Kontakion and Ikos. At Ode 9: we do not sing "More honorable". Festal Exapostilarion twice. At the Praises: festal [stichera], Tone 1: "Light of light...", on 4; Glory, Tone 6: "The streams of Jordan..."; Both now, Tone 2: "Today Christ [comes to Jordan]...". Great Doxology. Troparion of the feast; readings of the Tone; dismissal. Ordinary.*

units.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion, Tone 3, Podoben: "Today the Virgin" (Дѣва днесь):* *Gathering today, let us praise with hymns the unwaning luminary of the spiritual Sun: for thou hast shone forth upon those sitting in the darkness of ignorance, leading all up unto the divine height, O adornment of Thebes, venerable father Paul, and firm foundation of fasters!*

After Ode 6, Kontakion of John, Tone 2:* *Desiring to attain the things on high, O most wise one, and despising the beauty of things below, Thou didst disdain worldly glory, and unto Christ Who became poor Thou... ...having become poor, didst follow rejoicing, O father John: therefore praying fervently unto Him, cease not to intercede for us all!*

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *At the Aposticha: from the Octoechos; Glory: "The multitude of monastics..."; Both now, Theotokion. At the Divine Liturgy: from the canon of Paul of Thebes, Ode 3, and of John, Ode 6. Prokeimenon: "The saints shall be joyful in glory" [LXX Ps. 149:5]; Verse: "Sing unto the Lord a new song" [LXX Ps. 149:1]. Epistle: Saturday 27 [lection 27 / Eph. 6:10–17]. Alleluia: "Blessed is the man that fears the Lord" [LXX Ps. 111:1]; Verse: "His seed shall be mighty upon earth" [LXX Ps. 111:2]. Gospel from Matthew, Thursday of the 3rd Week: "The Lord said: All things are delivered unto Me [of My Father]..." [Mt. 11:27–30]. Kinonikon: "In everlasting memory [shall the righteous be]" [LXX Ps. 111:6].*

Gospel from Matthew, Thursday of the 3rd Week: "The Lord said: All things are delivered unto Me [of My Father]..." [Mt. 11:27–30]. Kinonikon: "In everlasting memory [shall the righteous be]" [LXX Ps. 111:6].*

Epistle from Acts: the 4th Saturday after Pascha [Acts 12:1–11]. Alleluia: "The heavens shall confess Thy wonders, O Lord" [LXX Ps. 88:6]. Gospel: the 11th Resurrectional [Jn. 21:15–25] of the Sunday. Kinonikon: "Their sound is gone out into all the earth" [LXX Ps. 18:5].*

units.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion, Tone 4:* *Zealous like Elijah, imitating the ways of the Baptist, by right paths thou didst follow, O father Antony: a desert dweller, and thou didst establish the universe by thy prayers; pray unto Christ God that our souls may be saved!*

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *Glory, Both now, Theotokion. At Great Vespers: "Blessed is the man..." [Kathisma 1]. On "Lord, I have cried": Prosomoia, 3, Tone 4, Podoben: "Called from on high" (Званному свыше), on 8; Glory, Tone 6: "According to the image..."; Both now, Dogmatikon Theotokion: "Who would not bless thee...?". Entrance; Prokeimenon; 3 Lections common to venerable monastics. At the Litiya: Idiomela, 3, of the saint, Tone 2; Glory, Tone 5: "O venerable father..."; Both now, Theotokion: "Sing, O ye people...". At the Aposticha: Prosomoia, 3; Glory of the saint, Tone 8: "The multitude of monastics..."; Both now, Theotokion. Blessing of loaves: "Rejoice, O Virgin Theotokos..." twice, and of the saint once: "Zealous like Elijah...", and reading of the holy... ...from the Life of the saint. At Matins: Troparion of the saint; Glory, Both now, Theotokion. 3 Kathismata; Sessional hymns of the saint; and the Polyeleos. Sessional hymn of the 4th Tone. Prokeimenon: "Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of His saints" [LXX Ps. 115:6]; Verse: "What shall I render unto the Lord for all that He hath rendered unto me?" [LXX Ps. 115:3]. "Let every breath praise the Lord" [LXX Ps. 150:6]. Gospel from Luke, in memory of the 2nd Sunday [Lk. 6:17–23]. Psalm 50 [LXX Ps. 50:3]; Sticheron of the saint. Canon of the Mother of God: "Holding fast amidst many [temptations]...", with the heirmos to 6, and of the saint to 8. After Ode 3, Sessional hymn; Glory, Both now, Theotokion. After Ode 6, Kontakion of the saint, Tone 2, Podoben: "Seeking the highest" (Въ вышнихъ ищя):*

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *At the Divine Liturgy: from the canon of the saint, Odes 3 and 6. Prokeimenon: "The righteous shall rejoice in the Lord" [LXX Ps. 63:11]; Verse: "Hear, O God, my voice" [LXX Ps. 63:2]. Epistle: lection 213 [Gal. 5:22–6:2]. Alleluia: "Blessed is the man that fears the Lord" [LXX Ps. 111:1]; Verse: "His seed shall be mighty upon earth" [LXX Ps. 111:2]. Gospel... ...from Matthew, Thursday of the 3rd Week: "The Lord said: All things [are delivered unto Me of My Father]..." [Mt. 11:27–30]. Kinonikon: "In everlasting memory [shall the righteous be]" [LXX Ps. 111:6]. If the commemoration of Antony the Great fall on a Sunday, search in the Rubric of the Tone.*

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *At the Praises: from the Octoechos of the Tone... Verse: "Thy priests shall clothe themselves with righteousness" [LXX Ps. 131:9]. And there is sung the Sticheron, Tone 3: "Greater than..."; Glory, Tone 3: "Great achievements..."; Both now, Theotokion. At the Divine Liturgy: from the Octoechos, and from the canon, Ode 3 of Saint Athanasius [and Ode 6 of Cyril]. Prokeimenon: "The saints shall be joyful in glory" [LXX Ps. 149:5]. Epistle: December 6 [lection 334 / Heb. 13:17–21]. Alleluia: "Thy priests shall clothe themselves with righteousness" [LXX Ps. 131:9]. Gospel: November 23: "The Lord said: Ye are the light of the world..." [Mt. 5:14–19]. Kinonikon: "Rejoice in the Lord, O ye righteous" [LXX Ps. 32:1].*

units.slavonic_diplomatic: и̑ ст҃о на ѕ҃. по ѕ̃ кѡ̃ гл̃а д҃. Б л̃женоую жи ꙁнь скончавь въ жити̑и. съ дѣтичьскыми ликы въꙁелли кроткы. достоиновъдво рѧешисѧ бг҃оносе макарїе. и̑ къ поустынꙗ же ꙗко въ грады въселѧꙗ. бл҃гть приꙗлъ еси ѡ̃ бг҃а чюдесе. тѣм же тѧ почитаемь: — на ст̃и. ѡ̑. сла̃ гл̃а д҃. просвѣтиша добра і нн҃ѣ бг҃о. на лїтоургїи. въ, ѡ̑. и̑ ѡ̃ кано̃.
units.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion, Tone 4:* *Having ended a blessed life in the flesh, with the choirs of martyrs thou wast counted among the meek, worthily taking up thy dwelling, O God-bearing Macarius; and inhabiting the wildernesses as if they were cities, thou hast received the grace of wonders from God: therefore we honor Thee!*

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: инокы мно и н бго тро гла д
units.slavonic_diplomatic: и̑нокы мно̃. і н̃ бг҃о. тро̃ гл̃а д҃. В есели сѧ поустыни не ражающая. и̑ бл҃годоушь ствꙋи неболѣвшаꙗ. ꙗко оу̑множи чада твоꙗ. мѫжь желанїи дх҃овныхъ. бл҃гочь стїемь насадивъ. въꙁдръжаніемь въспи тавь. въ добродѣтели съвръшеніе того мл̃твами х҃е бе оу̑мири жн̃кѡть нашь: — сла̃ і нн҃ѣ бг҃о. на оутрн. г҃. катнелиѣ. и̑ мно гомл̃тивыи. сѣ̃ ст҃о. сѣ̃е д҃ го, гл̃са. про̃ чт̃на прѣ гд̃ь. стн. что въꙁда. въсѣко ды.
units.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion, Tone 4:* *Be glad, O barren desert that bearest not, and take good courage, thou that travailest not; for the man of spiritual desires hath multiplied thy children, planting them in piety and rearing them in temperance unto the perfection of virtues: by his prayers, O Christ God, give peace unto our life!*

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *Glory, Both now, Theotokion. At Matins: 3 Kathismata; and the Polyeleos; Sessional hymns of the saint; Sessional hymn of the 4th Tone. Prokeimenon: "Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of His saints" [LXX Ps. 115:6]; Verse: "What shall I render unto the Lord for all that He hath rendered unto me?" [LXX Ps. 115:3]. "Let every breath praise the Lord" [LXX Ps. 150:6]. Gospel from Luke, in memory of the 2nd Sunday [Lk. 6:17–23]. Psalm 50 [LXX Ps. 50:3]; Sticheron of the saint. Canon of the Mother of God with its heirmos to 6, Tone 8: "Holding fast amidst many [temptations]...", and of the saint to 8. After Ode 3, Sessional hymn of the saint. After Ode 6, Kontakion, Tone 8: "In thy precious nativity the creation found joy, and in the divine..."*[^379]

units.slavonic_diplomatic: ст҃ы. два. по ѕ҃. пѣ ко. гла д҃. Бж҃твь наго оу҆ч҃нка. и съоу҆зьника павлова. тимоѳ ѳѣꙗ вѣрніи въспоимъ въси. съ нимъ почи тающа мѫдраго анастасьꙗ. просиѧвша го ѿ персиды ꙗко же звѣзда. и ѿгонѧща дꙋ шевныꙗ нашѧ страсти и недꙋгы телесныꙗ.
units.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion, Tone 4:* *The divine disciple and fellow-prisoner of Paul, Timothy, let all of us faithful hymn, honoring with him the wise Anastasius, who shone forth from Persia as a star, and drives away our spiritual passions and bodily sicknesses!*

Epistle to Timothy: "Child Timothy, I thank God..." [2 Tim. 1:3–9]... ...[Prokeimenon: "My mouth shall speak wisdom" [LXX Ps. 48:4];] Verse: "Hear this, all ye nations" [LXX Ps. 48:2]. Gospel from John, Thursday of the 5th week after Pascha, from midday [Jn. 10:9–16]. Psalm 50 [LXX Ps. 50:3]; Sticheron of the saint. Canon in the Octoechos to 6, and of the saint to 6. After Ode 3, Sessional hymn of the saint; Glory, Both now, Theotokion. After Ode 6, Kontakion, Tone 3, Podoben: "Today the Virgin" (Дѣва днесь):*

units.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion, Tone 1, Podoben: "When Thou shalt come" (Егда прииде):* *Mystically the honorable Church was glad at the translation of thy precious relics; having hidden them like costly gold, unto those who praise thee unceasingly thou grantest by thy prayers the grace of healing, O John Chrysostom!*

units.verbatim_book_heading: PART III: MENOLOGION :: At Matins: Canon in the Octoechos, and of the saints two. After Ode 6, Kontakion, Tone 4
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *After Ode 6, Kontakion: "Thou didst receive divine grace from heaven...", as on [November] 13. After Ode 9, Exapostilarion. At the Praises: we sing 6 stichera: Prosomoia 3, Tone 4, and Idiomela 3, Tone 1: "Grace was poured out...", "The Church is glad..."; another, Tone 2: "Today the Church of Christ...", of Basil the Great; Glory, Tone 4: "O Chrysostom..."; Both now, Theotokion. Great Doxology. Troparion of the saint; litany; dismissal. And holy oil is given, taken from the vigil lamp of the saint. At the Divine Liturgy: service as on [November] 13.*

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *At the Aposticha: Glory, Tone 2: "Like a palm tree..."; Both now, Theotokion. At the Divine Liturgy: The Beatitudes in the Octoechos, and of the saint, Ode 6. Prokeimenon: "The righteous shall rejoice in the Lord" [LXX Ps. 63:11]; Verse: "Hear, O God, my voice" [LXX Ps. 63:2]. Epistle: Saturday 27 [Gal. 5:22–6:2]. Alleluia: "Blessed is the man that fears the Lord" [LXX Ps. 111:1]. Gospel from Matthew, Thursday of the 3rd Week: "The Lord said: All things are delivered unto Me of My Father..." [Mt. 11:27–30]. units.slavonic_incipit: Пр҃о. Въ въсѧ землꙗ. Сти. Нб҃са
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: про в въся земл сти нбса поведа ют
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Пр҃о. Въ въсѧ землꙗ. Сти. Нб҃са повѣда ють. Апл҃ь. Де҃ ѕ҃. Аллуа. Іереи твои. Еѵе ѿ Матѳ. Ноꙗб к҃г. Регь: Вы есте свѣ. Кн҃ Въ въсѧ землꙗ. Ст҃ыи чюдотворець, и бесре брьникъ. Кѵра, Іѡа. Ве. Ст҃ры. с҃. на ѕ҃. Сл҃ гл҃ и҃. Двоица мч҃нкъ. Ін҃ б҃. На сти. ѡ҃.
units.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion, Tone 3, Podoben: "Today the Virgin" (Дѣва днесь):* *Having received the gift of wonders from divine grace, O holy ones, ye work wonders unceasingly, cutting down all our passions as by surgery, invisibly and mightily, glorious Cyrus with John: for ye are divine physicians!*

units.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion of the Forefeast, Tone 1:* *Troparion: "Thy martyr..." Glory, and now, Tone 2: "Let the gate be opened...". Entrance. Prokeimenon of the day. 3 Lections: 1st from Exodus [Ex. 13:1–16]: "The Lord spoke unto Moses, saying: Sanctify unto Me every firstborn..."; 2nd from Isaiah, Thursday of the 2nd week of the Fast [Is. 6:1–12]: "In the year that King Uzziah died..."; 3rd from Ezekiel [Ez. 43:27–44:4]: "It came to pass in the thirtieth year...". At the Litiya... ...idiomela of the feast 2: Tone 1: "The Ancient of Days...", and another, the 2nd, Tone 5. Glory, Tone 5: "Search the Scriptures..."; Both now, of the same tone: "The Ancient of Days...".*

units.verbatim_book_heading: PART III: MENOLOGION :: At the Divine Liturgy: of the forefeast, Ode 3; and of the martyr, Ode 6.*[^390]
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *At Matins: Customary Kathisma psalmody, and the Polyeleos; Sessional hymns of the feast. Anabathmoi of the 4th Tone. Prokeimenon, Tone 4: "I will remember Thy name in every generation" [LXX Ps. 44:18]; Verse: "My heart hath poured forth a good word" [LXX Ps. 44:2]. "Let every breath praise the Lord" [LXX Ps. 150:6]. Gospel from Luke, as at the Divine Liturgy on the feast, from midday, which hath the beginning: "There was a man in Jerusalem..." [Lk. 2:25–32]. Psalm 50 [LXX Ps. 50:3]. Sticheron of the feast. Canon of the feast, as written here, Tone 3: the heirmos twice, and the troparia on 4; and again the heirmos by both choirs together. After Ode 3, Sessional hymn of the feast. After Ode 6, Kontakion of the feast, Tone 1, Idiomelon...*[^392]

units.slavonic_diplomatic: и роуцѣ блг҃слви сѵмѣѡнѣ. ꙗко подобаше. прѣ варивъ, и нн҃ѣ сп҃слъ еси насъ х҃е б҃е. нѡ оу҆ми ри въ бранехь житїе наше. но оу҆крѣпи кнѧ- зꙗ и҆же възлюбилъ еси едїне чл҃колꙋбь че: ~ На ѳ҃. чт҃нѣишю не стїхослови и даю тсѧ свѣщи бран. По ѳ҃. свѣ. празникꙋ.
units.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion of the Meeting, Tone 1, Idiomelon:* Thou Who didst sanctify the Virgin's womb by Thy birth, and didst bless the hands of Symeon, as was meet, having anticipated us, Thou hast now also saved us, O Christ God; but give peace to our life amidst wars, and strengthen the prince whom Thou hast loved, O Thou Who alone lovest mankind!

cohort_provenance.verbatim_source:
*Kontakion of the Meeting, Tone 1, Idiomelon:*  
Thou Who didst sanctify the Virgin's womb by Thy birth, and didst bless the hands of Symeon, as was meet, having anticipated us, Thou hast now also saved us, O Christ God; but give peace to our life amidst wars, and strengthen the prince whom Thou hast loved, O Thou Who alone lovest mankind!

units.english_cohort_translation: *At the Divine Liturgy: from the canons, Odes 3 and 6. Introit: "The Lord hath made known His salvation before the nations; He hath revealed His righteousness" [LXX Ps. 97:2]. Troparion of the feast; Glory, and now, Kontakion of the feast. Prokeimenon, Tone 3: The Song: "My soul doth magnify the Lord" [Lk. 1:46]; Verse: "For He hath regarded the lowliness of His handmaiden" [Lk. 1:48]. Epistle to the Hebrews [Heb. 7:7–17]: "Brethren, without all contradiction the less is blessed of the better...". Alleluia, Tone 8: "Now lettest Thou Thy servant depart..." [Lk. 2:29]; Verse... ...[Verse:] "A light to the revelation of the Gentiles" [Lk. 2:32]. Gospel from Luke [Lk. 2:22–40]: "At that time, the parents brought Jesus into Jerusalem to present Him to the Lord... and the rest." Divine Liturgy of Chrysostom. Kinonikon: "I will take the cup of salvation" [LXX Ps. 115:4].*

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: апл не д по аллуа свет въси пра
units.slavonic_diplomatic: А҆пл҃ь. н҃е. д҃ по. А҆ллꙋа. Свѣть въсиꙗ пра ведникоу. Еѵ҆лїе. ѿ Мꙋа. в҃ ре і. н҃е. регь горе вамь. Кн҃. В пама. Прп҃бнаго ѡ҆ц҃а на шего. Сидора пилꙋсїѡта. А҆ ще в н҃ѣ по. В ь коу празникꙋ. и ст҃мꙋ. А҆ ще в по. то дне вное. Кѡ҃ с҃тго. гл҃а д҃. Ꙗко велие сл҃нце цр҃кви. и чюдесы лꙋчами просвѣщаеши въ сегда. вселенѣи исполненїе. нб҃ныи таебь инчи есидоре прп҃бне: ~ Стыꙗ мч҃нци, А҆га фїи. В к҃оу. самогласень. гл҃ и҃. Пресла вное чюдо бысть. Кѡ҃ гл҃а в҃ к вышнихь.

units.verbatim_book_heading: PART III: MENOLOGION :: Glory, and now, of the feast. At Matins: afterfeast and of the Cross to 6. Kontakion of the Cross, Tone 4
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *At Great Vespers: "Blessed is the man" [Kathisma 1]. Stichera on 8: 5 to the apostle, 3 to Arsenius; Glory: "Son of Thunder..."; Both now, of the feast, of the same tone. Entrance. Prokeimenon of the day. 3 Lections from the general epistle [1 Jn. 3:21–4:6; 4:11–16; 4:20–5:5]. At the Litiya: idiomela to the apostle 4, Tone 1: "The river of theology...", "The branch of purity...", "The disciple of the Savior...", "He who is ineffable..."; Tone 2: "A virgin...", "He who of the apostles, O Theologian..."; these are sung. Verse: "Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of His saints" [LXX Ps. 115:6]. 2nd [idiomelon]: Glory, Tone 6: "Venerable father..."; Verse: "Their sound is gone out into all the earth" [LXX Ps. 18:5]; Glory, Tone 4: "Thou didst lean..."; Both now, of the feast. At the Aposticha: after the Octoechos, to the apostle, Tone 6. Verses sung: "Their sound is gone out into all the earth" [LXX Ps. 18:5], "The heavens declare the glory of God" [LXX Ps. 18:2]. Glory, Tone 6: "Apostle of Christ and Evangelist..."; Both now, of the feast. Troparion, Tone 4: "O Virgin Theotokos" twice; and of the apostle once: "Beloved apostle...". Blessing of the Loaves. And a reading from the Apocalypse. At Matins: Troparion of the feast twice; Glory, of the apostle; Both now, of the feast. Customary Kathisma psalmody; Sessional hymns of the feast, and the Polyeleos... ...[Their sound is gone out into all the] earth. Tone 4, Prokeimenon: "Their sound is gone out into all the earth" [LXX Ps. 18:5]; Verse: "The heavens declare the glory of God" [LXX Ps. 18:2]. "Let every breath praise the Lord" [LXX Ps. 150:6]. units.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion of Venerable Arsenius the Great, Tone 3:* From Rome thou didst shine forth as a great sun, and didst reach the imperial city, O most blessed one, enlightening it with thy words and deeds, driving away all mist of ignorance; therefore we honor thee, O glory of fathers, venerable Arsenius!

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *Then Sessional hymn of the apostle; Glory, to Arsenius; Both now, of the feast. After Ode 6, Kontakion of the apostle, Tone 2. After Ode 9, Exapostilarion of the apostle and of the feast. At the Praises: stichera to the apostle on 4; Glory, Tone 8: "O evangelist John..."; Both now, of the feast. Great Doxology. Troparion of the apostle; Glory, and now, of the feast; litany; dismissal. And holy oil is given, while we sing the stichera... At the Divine Liturgy: canons of the apostle, Odes 3 and 6. Prokeimenon, Tone 8: "Their sound is gone out into all the earth" [LXX Ps. 18:5]; Verse: "The heavens declare the glory of God" [LXX Ps. 18:2]. Epistle: 1 John 1:1–7: "That which was from the beginning...". Alleluia, Tone 1: "The heavens shall confess Thy wonders, O Lord" [LXX Ps. 88:6]. Gospel from John [Jn. 19:25–27, 21:24–25]... ...[Gospel lection conclusion; Kinonikon:] "Their sound is gone out into all the earth" [LXX Ps. 18:5].*

At the Praises: stichera to the apostle on 4; Glory, Tone 8: "O evangelist John..."; Both now, of the feast. Great Doxology. Troparion of the apostle; Glory, and now, of the feast; litany; dismissal. And holy oil is given, while we sing the stichera... At the Divine Liturgy: canons of the apostle, Odes 3 and 6. Prokeimenon, Tone 8: "Their sound is gone out into all the earth" [LXX Ps. 18:5]; Verse: "The heavens declare the glory of God" [LXX Ps. 18:2]. Epistle: 1 John 1:1–7: "That which was from the beginning...". Alleluia, Tone 1: "The heavens shall confess Thy wonders, O Lord" [LXX Ps. 88:6]. Gospel from John [Jn. 19:25–27, 21:24–25]...*[^397]

units.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion of Venerable Pachomius the Great, Tone 2:* A radiant luminary thou didst appear at the ends [of the earth]... ...and didst make the deserts into cities by thy multitudes; thou didst crucify thyself, taking up thy cross upon thy shoulder, and by abstinence didst wear down the body, praying unceasingly for us all!*

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *At the Divine Liturgy: from the canon of the saint, Odes 3 and 6. Prokeimenon, Tone 7: "The venerable shall boast in glory" [LXX Ps. 149:5]; [Verse: "Sing unto the Lord a new song" [LXX Ps. 149:1]]. Epistle: lection 213 [or 233 / Gal. 5:22–6:2]. Alleluia: "Blessed is the man that fears the Lord" [LXX Ps. 111:1]. Gospel from Matthew, Thursday of the 3rd week [Mt. 11:27–30]: "The Lord said: All things are delivered unto Me...". Kinonikon: "In everlasting memory shall the righteous be" [LXX Ps. 111:6].*

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: блгочтиваго костантина и ны тро
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Бл҃гочтиваго костантїна . і҆ н҃ы . Тр҃о . пр҃о . гл҃ и҃ . Кр҃та твоего ѡ҆бразъ на нб҃си видѣвъ . и҆ ꙗ коже паоулъ званїе не ѿ чл҃къ прїемь . и҆же въ ца рехъ апл҃ъ твои г҃и . цр҃твоующїи градъ въ роу цѣ твои прѣложи . егоже сп҃саи всегда въ ми рѣ мл҃твами бц҃а . едине чл҃колꙋбче : ~ На оу҆р҃ни ка҃ ст҃ым на ѕ҃ . По ѕ҃ . пѣ кѡ҃ гл҃а г҃ .
units.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion of the Holy Equals-to-the-Apostles Constantine and Helena, Tone 8:* Having seen the image of Thy Cross in the heavens, and like Paul having received his calling not from men, Thine apostle among kings, O Lord, placed the imperial city into Thy hands; which save Thou ever in peace, through the prayers of the Theotokos, O Thou Who alone lovest mankind!

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *At the Aposticha: in the Octoechos; Glory, Tone 8: "The radiant light..."; Both now, Theotokion. At the Divine Liturgy: from the canon of the saint, Odes 3 and 6. Prokeimenon: "Sing praises to our God, sing praises" [LXX Ps. 46:7]; Verse: "O clap your hands, all ye nations" [LXX Ps. 46:2]. Epistle to the Galatians, lection 200 [Gal. 1:11–19]. But if it be Friday, it is read from Acts, Thursday of the 5th week after Pascha [Acts 15:5–34]. Alleluia... ...Tone 1: "I have exalted one chosen out of My people" [LXX Ps. 88:20]; Verse: "For My hand shall help him" [LXX Ps. 88:22]. Gospel from John, Thursday of the 5th week, from Mid-Pentecost [Jn. 10:1–9]: "The Lord said: He that enters not by the door...". Kinonikon: "In everlasting memory shall the righteous be" [LXX Ps. 111:6].*

Prokeimenon: "Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of His saints" [LXX Ps. 115:6]; Verse: "What shall I render unto the Lord for all that He hath rendered unto me?" [LXX Ps. 115:3]. "Let every breath praise the Lord" [LXX Ps. 150:6]. Gospel from Luke, Friday of the 2nd week [Lk. 6:17–23]. Psalm 50 [LXX Ps. 50:3]. Sticheron of the saint. Canons: of the Theotokos, Tone 8: "Holding fast amidst many temptations...", with heirmoi on 6; and of the saint on 8. After Ode 3, Sessional hymn of the saint. After Ode 6...*[^403]

units.slavonic_diplomatic: гл҃ в҃ . Бж҃твеную . і҆ н҃ б҃ тр҃о гл҃а , д҃ : ~ Ꙗко бж҃твеное скровище . скровено въ земи хс҃ ѿкрыль е҆ . главоу твою намъ пр҃рче . и҆ пр҃тче вси бо съшедшесѧ къ томоу ѡ҆брѣтенїе . и҆ единого гл҃ыиди сп҃саемь . сп҃сающаго насъ ѿ тлѧ мл҃твами твоими : ~ сл҃ і҆ н҃ . б҃ На оу҃ . Ѡ҆ бы стїсловие и҆ многомл҃тивыи . Сѣ пр҃тчи сте҃ гл҃ д҃ про҃ гл҃ д҃ . тоу възвращꙋ рогъ . ст҃ Помѧни г҃и дв҃да . Всѧкь ды . Еѵ҆лїие . ѿ Ма҃ въ кто . ѕ҃ , н҃е . ѱалѡ҃ н҃ . стра҃ прѣдътечи кано҃ въц҃ и҆ прѣтечи . на ѕ҃ . по ѕ҃ пѣ . кѡ҃ прѣтечи . д҃е к҃д . прр҃че бж҃ии . на хвалите побники , г҃ . прѣтечи на д҃ . сл҃а гл҃ ѕ҃ . все чт҃ную . і҆ н҃ б҃ . славословїе великое . тр҃о прѣ течи . слава . і҆ нн҃ѣ б҃ . сѡ҃ктеꙗ . ѿпоустъ .
units.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion of the Third Finding of the Head of the Forerunner, Tone 4:* As a divine treasure hidden in the earth... ...Christ hath revealed thy head unto us, O prophet and Forerunner; for all of us having gathered together at its finding, with harmonious voices hymn the Savior, Who saves us from corruption through thy prayers!*

побники , г҃ . прѣтечи на д҃ . сл҃а гл҃ ѕ҃ . все
чт҃ную . і҆ н҃ б҃ . славословїе великое . тр҃о прѣ
течи . слава . і҆ нн҃ѣ б҃ . сѡ҃ктеꙗ . ѿпоустъ .

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: иже о на бездноу учении бгословиа
units.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆же ѡ҆ на҃ . Бездноу ꙋченїи бг҃ословїа . и҆ сточилъ еси ꙗвѣ ѡ҆ источничь сп҃совь . е҆реси попалѧющи кириле . и҆ стадо неврежено тре волненїи избавлѧющи . странахъ ты еси прѣ подобне наставникъ . ꙗко бж҃твнаа ꙗвлꙗꙗ .
units.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion of St. Cyril of Alexandria, Tone 6, Podoben: "He Who fulfilled the dispensation for us..." (Иже о нас):* An abyss of teachings of theology thou didst openly pour forth from the springs of the Savior, burning up heresies, O Cyril, and preserving the flock unharmed, delivering it from tempests; thou art a guide unto lands, O venerable one, as one revealing divine things!
units.slavonic_text: И҆же ѡ҆ на҃ . Бездноу ꙋченїи бг҃ословїа . и҆ сточилъ еси ꙗвѣ ѡ҆ источничь сп҃совь . е҆реси попалѧющи кириле . и҆ стадо неврежено тре волненїи избавлѧющи . странахъ ты еси прѣ подобне наставникъ . ꙗко бж҃твнаа ꙗвлꙗꙗ .

units.slavonic_diplomatic: Дѣвьства твоего добротами . почтила е҆си дш҃ю . и҆ на высотоу мч҃нна въстече а҆килино всеславнаꙗ . любовїю жениха хс҃а оу҆ꙗзви вшисѧ . е҆моуже нн҃ѣ съ а҆гг҃лы прѣстоиши веселасѧ . съ нимиже непрестан молѧ ѡ҆ всѣхъ на҃ : ~ Ст҃го прр҃ка е҆лисеꙗ . и҆ ст҃го ѡ҆ц҃а нашего . меѳедїа . патриарха цр҃ꙗграда .
units.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion of the Holy Martyr Aquilina, Tone 2:* With the beauties of thy virginity thou didst honor thy soul, and didst ascend unto the height of martyrdom, O all-glorious Aquilina, being wounded with love for Christ the Bridegroom; unto Whom thou now standest before with the angels, rejoicing; together with them pray unceasingly for us all!

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: ко гла г мчтл обличил еси бесо
units.slavonic_diplomatic: кѡ҃ гл҃а г҃ . Мч҃тль ѡ҆бличилъ еси бѣсо вое коварьство . нелипо посрамилъ еси ꙗ҆ жноую лесть . възвеселилъ еси а҆гг҃льска ликостоꙗнїа . ꙗ҆вилъ еси бг҃оразоумїе въ чл҃кхъ . сего ради твою пама҃ почитаемь лю бовїю . мд҃ре леѡнтїе : ~ Ст҃го апл҃а июды брата гн҃а по плътїи . ве҃рь . стры . с҃тоу на ѕ҃ . сла҃ с҃то . і҆ нн҃ѣ б҃о . на сти ѡ҃ . сла҃ с҃то .
units.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion of the Holy Martyr Leontius, Tone 3:* *Troparion: "Thy martyr, O Lord..." [Tone 4]. Kontakion, Tone 3:* Thou didst denounce the tyrant, the craftiness of demons; thou didst put to shame false deceit; thou didst cause the angelic choirs to rejoice, and didst reveal divine wisdom among men; therefore with love we honor thy memory, O wise Leontius!

units.slavonic_diplomatic: на малѣи вечрни . стры прр҃тчи . на д҃ . сл҃ . Прѣ течи . і҆ н҃ б҃о На сти . сагласны г҃ . гл҃ в҃ . сл҃ і҆ н҃ Видѧщи е҆лисаве҃ . тр҃о гл҃ д҃ . Прр҃че , и҆ прѣ тече пришествїа хв҃а . достоино хвалити тѧ недооумѣемъі . нж любовїю чьтоуще и тѧ . неплодїе ибо рожши . и҆ ѡ҆ч҃е безгласье разрѣшаетсѧ . славныи и҆ чт҃ныи дь ти роже ство . и҆ въплъщенїе сн҃а бж҃їа мирови пропо вѣдаетсѧ : ~ На велїкои вечрни . Бл҃женъ мꙋж .

units.verbatim_book_heading: PART III: MENOLOGION :: At Matins: Canons in the Octoechos on 6, and of the saints on 8. After Ode 3, Kontakion of Barnabas, Tone 3, Podoben: "Today the Virgin" (Дѣва днесь)
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *At Great Vespers: "Blessed is the man" [Kathisma 1]. Stichera on 8: idiomela 4, doubled, Tone 4: "When the Word of God was pleased...", and 3 others; Glory, Tone 6: "The day of light..."; Both now, Tone 8: "Elizabeth conceived...". Entrance. 3 Lections. At the Litiya: idiomela 3, Tone 1; Glory, Tone 6: "Among the prophets..."; Both now, Theotokion. At the Aposticha: idiomela 3, Tone 2; and they say verses: "Blessed be the Lord God of Israel" [Lk. 1:68]; "And thou, child, shalt be called the prophet of the Highest" [Lk. 1:76]; Glory, Tone 8: "Isaiah..."; Both now: "In the days of Elizabeth...". Troparion: "O prophet and Forerunner...", is sung twice; "O Theotokos and Virgin...", once. Blessing of the loaves, and reading. At Matins: Troparion of the Forerunner twice... ...Glory, and now, Theotokion: "The mystery hidden from all eternity..." [Tone 4]. Customary Kathisma psalmody, and the Polyeleos. Sessional hymns of the Forerunner. Anabathmoi of the 4th Tone. Prokeimenon: "And thou, child, shalt be called the prophet of the Highest" [Lk. 1:76]; Verse: "Blessed be the Lord God of Israel" [Lk. 1:68]. "Let every breath praise the Lord" [LXX Ps. 150:6]. Gospel from Luke [Lk. 1:24–25, 57–68, 76, 80]: "At that time, Elizabeth conceived...", seek at the Liturgy, from the midpoint. Psalm 50 [LXX Ps. 50:3]. Sticheron of the Forerunner. Canons: of the Theotokos with heirmoi on 6; and two of the Forerunner: one in Tone 6 [in the Octoechos]: "An angel of God...", on 4; and the other in Tone 4, by John the Monk, on 4; or if they wish, let them sing the first on 8. After Ode 6, Kontakion, Tone 2:*

units.english_cohort_translation: *After Ode 6, Kontakion in the same tone, of the Forerunner...*[^416] *...Glory, and now, Theotokion. After Ode 6, Kontakion of the Forerunner; at the Aposticha: in the Octoechos; Glory: "It is meet to praise John..."; Both now, Theotokion. At the Divine Liturgy: of the Forerunner, Ode 3 on 4; and of the saint, Ode 6 on 4. Prokeimenon, Tone 4: "God is marvelous in His saints" [LXX Ps. 67:36]; Verse: "In the congregations bless ye God" [LXX Ps. 67:27]. Epistle: lection 16 [Gal. 3:23–4:5]. units.slavonic_stem_tier2: и иже питаеши на блгтию прпдо двде
units.slavonic_diplomatic: и҆ и҆же питаеши на блг҃тїю . прп҃до дв҃де все бл҃жне : ~ Прп҃бнаго ѡ҆ц҃а нашего самсона стра ннопрїемца . стр҃ . с҃ . на ѕ҃ . на ст҃ ѡ҃ . тр҃о і҆ н҃ б҃о терпенїи свое ноꙗ к҃ в҃і . На оу҃ ка҃ ѿ г҃ на ѕ҃ . кѡ҃ гл҃ и҃ по҃ га начато . Ꙗ҆ко врача прѣизрѧдна . и҆ лю телꙗ бг҃оприꙗтна . крацѣ твоемь бж҃твнѣи при тѣкающе . самсоне бг҃омд҃ре прп҃бне . съшедшесѧ любовїю къ ѱалмѣх . и҆ пѣнїихъ възрадоуемсѧ х҃а славѧще . и҆же таковоую тобѣ даша блг҃ть и҆сцѣленїемь : ~ Възвращенїе мо щемь . ст҃ы бесребрьникь . кира . и҆ і҆ѡанна .
units.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion of Venerable Samson the Hospitable, Tone 8, Podoben: "To thee, the championed leader" (Взбранной):* As unto an excellent physician and an acceptable intercessor, fleeing unto thy divine reliquary, O Samson, divinely wise and venerable one, coming together in love, with psalms and hymns let us rejoice... ...glorifying Christ Who gave Thee such grace of healings!*

units.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion of the Translation of the Relics of Cyrus and John, Tone 2:* The great remedy of the universe, the beloved pair of Christ, the shining luminaries, the beacons of healing, let us the faithful hymn with a loud voice, crying aloud within their temple: O Cyrus and John, granters of wonders, physicians of the sick, sanctify all lands!

units.slavonic_diplomatic: г҃ гл҃а а҃ . съ стиховьны . сл҃ гл҃а ѕ҃ . Празни къ радостень . і҆ н҃ б҃о . тр҃о гл҃ д҃ . И҆же а҆по столѡ҃ прѣкопрѣстолници . и҆ вселенѣнои оу҆чи телїе . вл҃кѣ всѣ молите . миръ вселенѣи да ровати . и҆ дш҃ам нашим велию мл҃ть : ~ На вели кои . ве҃рни . Бл҃женъ мꙋжь . Гн҃ възва҃ . во гл҃а в҃ . стры г҃ с҃ . на и҃ . гл҃а в҃ . два . по г҃ .

units.verbatim_book_heading: PART III: MENOLOGION :: Glory, and now, Theotokion. At Matins: Canon of the saints on 6. Kontakion, Tone 2
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *At Great Vespers: "Blessed is the man" [Kathisma 1]. At "Lord, I have cried...", Tone 2: stichera 3 of the saints, on 8: Tone 2, two stichera repeated thrice, and one repeated twice; Glory: "Thrice...", Tone 4; Both now, Dogmatikon 1. Entrance. 3 Lections. At the Litiya: stichera 4, Tone 4; Glory, Tone 3: "Of the heavenly..."; Both now, Theotokion. At the Aposticha: idiomela 3, Tone 1; and they say verses: "Their sound is gone out into all the earth" [LXX Ps. 18:5]; and "The heavens shall confess Thy wonders" [LXX Ps. 88:6]; Glory: "A joyful feast..."; Both now, Theotokion. Troparion: "O Theotokos and Virgin...", twice; and of the saints once: "Ye leaders of the apostles...". Blessing of the loaves, and reading of the interpretation... ...reading from the Lives of the saints.*

euchological_and_rubrical_metadata.structural_slot: At Matins: Troparion 3 times: [Troparion of the Apostles twice]; Glory, and now, Theotokion. Kathismata and Polyeleos; Antiphon of the Degrees in Tone 4 :: At Great Vespers: "Blessed is the man" [Kathisma 1]. At "Lord, I have cried...", Tone 2: stichera 3 of the saints, on 8: Tone 2, two stichera repeated thrice, and one repeated twice; Glory: "Thrice...", Tone 4; Both now, Dogmatikon 1. Entrance. 3 Lections. At the Litiya: stichera 4, Tone 4; Glory, Tone 3: "Of the heavenly..."; Both now, Theotokion. At the Aposticha: idiomela 3, Tone 1; and they say verses: "Their sound is gone out into all the earth" [LXX Ps. 18:5]; and "The heavens shall confess Thy wonders" [LXX Ps. 88:6]; Glory: "A joyful feast..."; Both now, Theotokion. Troparion: "O Theotokos and Virgin...", twice; and of the saints once: "Ye leaders of the apostles...". Blessing of the loaves, and reading of the interpretation... ...reading from the Lives of the saints.

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *At Vespers: No Kathisma psalmody. Stichera 3 to Peter and Paul, and 3 to the Synaxis; Glory, Tone 4: "Christ, willing first..."; Both now, Theotokion. At the Aposticha: prosomoia 3; Glory: "The all-honorable..."; Both now, Theotokion: "Thou art a vine blossoming...". The same troparion of the apostles is sung 4 times; Glory, and now, Theotokion. units.verbatim_book_heading: PART III: MENOLOGION :: At Matins: Troparion 3 times: [Troparion of the Apostles twice]; Glory, and now, Theotokion. Kathismata and Polyeleos; Antiphon of the Degrees in Tone 4
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *Then after Ode 3, the other sessional hymns; after Ode 6, Kontakion and another Kontakion. At the Praises: 3 stichera... Great Doxology. The same troparion of the Apostles; Glory, and now, Theotokion. Litany. Dismissal. At the Divine Liturgy: from the canon of the Synaxis, Odes 3 and 6. Prokeimenon, Tone 8: "Into all the earth..." [LXX Ps. 18:5]; Verse: "The heavens declare..." [LXX Ps. 18:2]... ...[The heavens] declare [LXX Ps. 18:2]. Gospel from Matthew [Mt. 9:36–10:8]: "At that time, Jesus went up into a mountain...". Kinonikon: "Into all the earth [their sound is gone out]" [LXX Ps. 18:5].*

units.slavonic_diplomatic: и҆ по́асъ прч҃таго ти тѣ́ла · держа́вное ѡ҆дѣ́- -нїе гра́дꙋ твоє́мꙋ дарова · безъсѣ́менны ро́- -жество́ ти нетлѣ́ннаа · пребы́вши · ѡ҆ тобѣ́ бо є҆́ство ѡ҆бнавла́етса · и҆ вре́ма · тѣ́мъ же мо́- -лита · миръ вселе́нѣи даровати · и҆ дꙋша́мъ на́- -шимъ велїю мл҃ть · То[же] б҃ъ г҃ь · На ᲂу҆[трени] ка[нонъ] б[ог]о[роди]цинъ на ѕ҃
units.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion of the Deposition of the Precious Robe, Tone 8:* O Theotokos, Ever-Virgin, protection of mankind, Thou hast granted the robe and the sash of Thy most pure body as a mighty vesting unto Thy city, having remained incorrupt in Thy seedless childbirth; for in Thee nature and time are renewed; therefore we entreat Thee to grant peace unto the universe and great mercy unto our souls!

units.slavonic_diplomatic: [...а҃] на и҃ · по ѕ҃ пѣ[сни] кѡ҃ · гл҃а , д҃ :- Ѡ҆дѣ́нїе всѣ́мъ вѣ́рнымъ нетлѣ́ннаа · бг҃о- -бл҃гтнаꙗ дв҃о чт҃аа · дарова́ла є҆си сщ҃енꙋю ри́зꙋ твою́ · є҆́юже сщ҃еное · и҆ чт҃ное свое́ тѣ́ло покрыва́ла є҆си · покро́ве всѣ́мъ чл҃кѡ[мъ] · є҆ꙗ́- -же положе́нїе пра́знꙋемъ любо́вїю · и҆ въ- -спѣва́юще зове́мъ чт҃аа · ра́дꙋисѧ дв҃о хрⷭ҇ть- -ꙗ́нѡмъ похвала́ :~
units.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion of the Deposition of the Precious Robe, Tone 4:* As an incorrupt vesture unto all the faithful, O divinely graced pure Virgin, Thou hast granted Thy sacred robe, wherewith Thou didst cover Thy sacred and honorable body, O protection of all men, whose deposition we celebrate with love; and singing we cry aloud: Pure one, rejoice, O Virgin, the boast of Christians!

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *At the Aposticha: Glory, and now, Tone 2. At the Divine Liturgy: Prokeimenon, Tone 3, Song of the Theotokos: "My soul doth magnify the Lord" [Lk. 1:46]; Verse: "For He hath regarded the lowliness of His handmaiden" [Lk. 1:48]. Epistle to the Hebrews, lection 320 [Heb. 9:1–7]: "The first covenant had also...". Alleluia: "Arise, O Lord, into Thy rest" [LXX Ps. 131:8]. Gospel from Luke [Lk. 1:39–49, 56]: "At that time, Mary arose...". Kinonikon: "I will take the cup of salvation" [LXX Ps. 115:4].*

units.verbatim_book_heading: PART III: MENOLOGION :: Glory, and now, Theotokion. At Matins: Canon in the Octoechos, and of the saint on 6. After Ode 6, Kontakion, Tone 8
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *At the Praises: Stichera on 4, written [as on September] 16; Glory, Tone 6: "Virgin-martyr..."; Both now, Theotokion. At the Aposticha: Glory, Tone 8: "Every tongue..."; Both now, Theotokion. At the Divine Liturgy: from the canon, Odes 3 and 6. Prokeimenon: "God is marvelous in His saints" [LXX Ps. 67:36]; Verse: "In the congregations bless ye God" [LXX Ps. 67:27]. Epistle: see September 16 [2 Cor. 6:1–10]. Alleluia: "With patience I waited for the Lord" [LXX Ps. 39:2]. Gospel from Luke [Lk. 7:36–50]: "At that time, one of the Pharisees desired Jesus...". Kinonikon: "Rejoice in the Lord, O ye righteous" [LXX Ps. 32:1].*

units.verbatim_book_heading: PART III: MENOLOGION :: At the Praises: Dismissal stichera; Glory, Tone 6: "Thine angels, O Lord..."; Both now, Theotokion. At the Divine Liturgy: see November 8
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *At the Praises: 4 idiomela: two Tone 2, and two Tone 4; Glory, Tone 2: "Come, ye faithful..."; Both now, Theotokion. At the Aposticha: Glory, Tone 4: "He makes glad..."; Both now, Theotokion. At the Divine Liturgy: from the canons, Odes 3 and 6. Prokeimenon: "Praise the Lord, O ye servants" [LXX Ps. 112:1]. Epistle to the Corinthians [1 Cor. 13:11–14:5]: "When I was a child...". Alleluia, Tone 8: "Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings" [LXX Ps. 8:3]. Gospel from Luke: see... Kinonikon: "Rejoice in the Lord, O ye righteous" [LXX Ps. 32:1].*

units.slavonic_diplomatic: многомл҃тиве сла́ва тебѣ́ :~ сл҃ і҆ н҃ б҃о · на оу҆́трьни · ка[нонъ] с[вятымъ] на ѕ҃ · по г҃ · пѣ[сни] сѣ́[даленъ] ст҃[ымъ] · по ѕ҃ ко[ндакъ] гл҃ и҃ · А҆пл҃ьское проповѣ́данїе · и҆ ѡ҆́тѣ- -скаꙗ преда́нїа · цр҃кви є҆ди́ною вѣ́рою запе- -чатлѣ́нна · и҆ ри́зꙋ носѧ́щеи и҆́стиннѣ · и҆стка́- -ноу ѡ҆́ свыше на бг҃ословїа · и҆справлѧ́еть · и҆ сла́вить бл҃гочт҃їа вели́кое та́иньство :~

units.english_cohort_translation: *Exapostilarion of the saints; Both now, Theotokion. At the Praises: 3 prosomoia of the Holy Fathers, on 6, Tone 6, Podoben: "Having set aside all hope..." (Все упованїе); Glory, Tone 8: "The choir of the Holy Fathers..."; Both now, Theotokion. At the Aposticha: Glory, Tone 3: "Apostolic traditions..."; Both now, Theotokion. At the Divine Liturgy: The Beatitudes in the Octoechos on 6, and of the Holy Fathers, Odes 3 and 6, on 6; Troparion and Kontakion of the Holy Fathers; Glory, and now, Theotokion: "Protection of Christians...". Prokeimenon, Tone 6: "The righteous shall be glad in the Lord" [LXX Ps. 63:11]; Verse: "Blessed are they whom Thou hast chosen" [LXX Ps. 64:5]. Epistle to Titus [Tit. 3:8–15]: "Child Titus, faithful is the saying, and concerning these things I desire that thou affirm...". Alleluia, Tone 4: "The righteous cried..."*[^431]

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *At the Praises: 3 prosomoia, Tone 8; and 3 idiomela, Tone 1; Glory, Tone 8: "Chief of the prophets..."; Both now, Theotokion. At the Aposticha: Glory, Tone 4: "Upon the chariot of fire..."; Both now, Theotokion. At the Divine Liturgy: to the prophet from the canon, Odes 3 and 6. Prokeimenon, Tone 4: "Thou art a priest forever after the order of Melchizedek" [LXX Ps. 109:4]; Verse: "The Lord said unto my Lord: Sit Thou at My right hand" [LXX Ps. 109:1]. Epistle of James [Jas. 5:10–20]: "Brethren, take as an example of suffering affliction...". Alleluia, Tone 4: "Moses and Aaron among His priests" [LXX Ps. 98:6]. Gospel from Luke [Lk. 4:22–30]: "At that time, the people wondered at the words of grace...". Kinonikon: "In everlasting memory shall the righteous be" [LXX Ps. 111:6].*

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *At the Aposticha: Glory, Tone 4: "From thy youth...", see [fol.] 22; Both now: "Unto Him Who willingly impoverished Himself...". At the Divine Liturgy: from the canon of Mary, Odes 3 and 6. Prokeimenon: "God is marvelous in His saints" [LXX Ps. 67:36]; Verse: "In the congregations bless ye God" [LXX Ps. 67:27]. Epistle: lection 16 [1 Cor. 9:2–12]. Alleluia: "With patience I waited for the Lord" [LXX Ps. 39:2]. Gospel from Luke [Lk. 8:1–3]. Kinonikon: "Rejoice in the Lord, O ye righteous" [LXX Ps. 32:1].*

units.verbatim_book_heading: PART III: MENOLOGION :: At Matins: Canons in the Octoechos, and of the saint on 6; after Ode 6, Kontakion, Tone 2
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *At Vespers: "Blessed is the man" [Kathisma 1]. Stichera of the saints on 6; Glory of the saint [Christina], Tone 2: "As an alabaster flask..."; Both now, Theotokion. Entrance. Prokeimenon. 3 Lections, see [September] 26, written for the Theologian. At the Aposticha: 3 prosomoia of the saint; then Verse: "Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of His venerable ones" [LXX Ps. 115:6]; and idiomelon, Tone 6: "Come, let us praise..."; Glory, Tone 2, of the saint: "Unto the named after Christ..."; Both now, Theotokion. Troparion of the Martyrs [Tone 4]: "Thy martyrs, O Lord...". At Matins: Troparion of the saints twice; Glory of the saint; Both now, Theotokion. Ordinary Kathisma psalmody... ...and the Polyeleos; Sessional hymns of the saints, Tone 4. Prokeimenon: "Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of His venerable ones" [LXX Ps. 115:6]; Verse: "What shall I render unto the Lord for all that He hath rendered unto me?" [LXX Ps. 115:3]. "Let every breath praise the Lord" [LXX Ps. 150:6]. Gospel from Luke [Lk. 12:2–12]. Psalm 50 [LXX Ps. 50:3]; Verse: "God is marvelous in His saints" [LXX Ps. 67:36]; and Idiomelon, Tone 8: "Despising bodily pleasures...". Canon of the saint [Christina] with the heirmos on 6, and of the saints [Boris and Gleb] on 8. After Ode 3, Kontakion of the saint [Christina], Tone 4:*

At the Aposticha: 3 prosomoia of the saint; then Verse: "Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of His venerable ones" [LXX Ps. 115:6]; and idiomelon, Tone 6: "Come, let us praise..."; Glory, Tone 2, of the saint: "Unto the named after Christ..."; Both now, Theotokion. Troparion of the Martyrs [Tone 4]: "Thy martyrs, O Lord...". At Matins: Troparion of the saints twice; Glory of the saint; Both now, Theotokion. Ordinary Kathisma psalmody... ...and the Polyeleos; Sessional hymns of the saints, Tone 4. Prokeimenon: "Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of His venerable ones" [LXX Ps. 115:6]; Verse: "What shall I render unto the Lord for all that He hath rendered unto me?" [LXX Ps. 115:3]. "Let every breath praise the Lord" [LXX Ps. 150:6]. Gospel from Luke [Lk. 12:2–12]. Psalm 50 [LXX Ps. 50:3]; Verse: "God is marvelous in His saints" [LXX Ps. 67:36]; and Idiomelon, Tone 8: "Despising bodily pleasures...". Canon of the saint [Christina] with the heirmos on 6, and of the saints [Boris and Gleb] on 8. After Ode 3, Kontakion of the saint [Christina], Tone 4:*

units.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion of the Holy Passion-bearers Boris and Gleb (Roman and David), Tone 3:* Today hath shone forth the all-glorious memory of you both, the martyrs of Christ, Roman and David, calling us together unto the praising of Christ our God; therefore running unto the shrine of your relics, we receive the gift of healing... ...for ye are divine physicians! Exapostilarion. At the Praises: 3 prosomoia of the saint [Christina], and 3 of the saints [Boris and Gleb]; then Verse: "God is marvelous in His saints" [LXX Ps. 67:36]; and Idiomelon of the saint, Tone 5: "Thy virginal..."; then another Verse: "Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of His venerable ones" [LXX Ps. 115:6]; and Idiomelon, Tone 6: "Today, ye faithful..."; Glory, Tone 8: "The first-newly-illumined [rulers]..."; Both now, Theotokion. Great Doxology. Troparion of the saints; Glory, and now, Theotokion. Litany, Dismissal, and the 1st Hour. At the Divine Liturgy: from the canon of the saints, Ode 3 on 4, and of the saint, Ode 6 on 4. Prokeimenon, Tone 4: "Unto the saints that are in His earth hath the Lord been marvelous" [LXX Ps. 15:3]; Verse: "I foresaw the Lord always before me" [LXX Ps. 15:8]. Epistle to the Romans [Rom. 8:28–39]: "Brethren, we know that to them that love God all things work together for good...". Alleluia: "The righteous cried, and the Lord heard them" [LXX Ps. 33:18]. Gospel from John [Jn. 15:17–16:2]: "The Lord said unto His disciples: These things I command you...". Kinonikon: "Rejoice in the Lord, O ye righteous" [LXX Ps. 32:1].*

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *At the Aposticha: Glory, and now: "Out of a barren womb...". At the Divine Liturgy: from the canon of the saints, Odes 3 and 6. Prokeimenon: "God is marvelous in His saints" [LXX Ps. 67:36]; Verse: "In the congregations bless ye God" [LXX Ps. 67:27]. Epistle: see [September] 9 [Heb. 9:1–7]: "Brethren, the first tabernacle had ordinances of divine service...". Alleluia: "The salvation of the righteous is of the Lord" [LXX Ps. 36:39]. Gospel from Luke [Lk. 1:39–49, 56 or Lk. 8:16–21]. Kinonikon: "In everlasting memory shall the righteous be" [LXX Ps. 111:6].*

units.verbatim_book_heading: PART III: MENOLOGION :: At Matins: Canons in the Octoechos, and of the saint on 6; after Ode 6, Kontakion, Tone 5, Idiomelon
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *At the Praises: stichera of the saint on 6; Glory, Tone 4: "Today hath shone forth..."; Both now, Theotokion. At the Aposticha: 3 verses: "The righteous shall flourish like a palm tree" [LXX Ps. 91:13]; idiomela, Tone 1: "A noble contest..."; Glory, Tone 5: "Come together, ye lovers of martyrs..."; Both now, Theotokion. At the Divine Liturgy: from the canon, Odes 3 and 6. Prokeimenon: "God is marvelous in His saints" [LXX Ps. 67:36]; Verse: "In the congregations bless ye God" [LXX Ps. 67:27]. Epistle: lection 25 [2 Tim. 2:1–10]. Alleluia, Tone 4: "The righteous shall flourish like a palm tree" [LXX Ps. 91:13]. Gospel from John, lection 52 [Jn. 15:17–16:2] after Pascha. Kinonikon: "In everlasting memory shall the righteous be" [LXX Ps. 111:6].*[^442]

units.verbatim_book_heading: PART III: MENOLOGION :: At the Aposticha: Glory, Tone 6, of the Cross: "The prophetic voice..."; Both now, Theotokion. At the Divine Liturgy: of the Cross, and of the saint
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *Before the ringing of the bells, the priest enters with the superior of the church and with the candle-bearer into the skeuophylakion, and taking up the Precious Wood with candles and with a censer, singing the Troparion: "Save, O Lord, Thy people", and they bring it into the church and place it upon the Holy Table, and they kindle a candle by the Precious Wood for the whole evening. The ordinary kathisma psalmody. At "Lord, I have cried": stichera 3 of the Cross, and 3 of the saint; Glory, Tone 8: "Holy Maccabees"; Both now, of the Cross, Tone 8: "He Whom of old...". At the Aposticha: Glory, Tone 8: "The souls of the righteous..."; Both now, of the Cross: "The voice of Thy Prophet...". Troparion: "By the sufferings of the Holy..."; (see fol. 24)[^448] Glory, Both now: "Save, O Lord, Thy people". At Matins: Troparion of the Cross... ...On that day is sung the office of Saint Maximus; stichera of both... Glory, Tone 6: "Venerable father..."; Both now, of the feast. At the Aposticha: all of the feast. Troparion... (see fol. 11);[^449] Glory, Both now, of the feast. At Matins: canons of the feast on 6, and two... After Ode 3, Kontakion of the saint, Tone 2:*

Kinonikon: "In everlasting memory shall the righteous be" [LXX Ps. 111:6].*

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: апле стыи ко гла в незаходимое
units.slavonic_diplomatic: ап҃ле ст҃ыи . кѡ҃ гл҃а в҃ . Незаходимое слъ нце ꙗвися . слн҃цю великомоу прилѣпьшеся тѣмь и просвѣтисѧ ищь въ тмѣ неразоу миꙗ . ѡгона недꙋгы ѿ дш҃ь . и тѣлесь на шихъ матъѳею таинны самовидче и слꙋжи телю въ истиноу хв҃ь . всегда моляся не престаи ѡ всѣхъ на[съ] :~ слꙋжба ап҃ло[мъ] ѡбщаꙗ .

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: словословие векое поющи же браи иереи
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Словословіе вѣкое . Поющи же браи . іереи сѡ блачит ся . въ вѣтинь священническыи . и при ходи с кадило[мъ] . и с лампадою . къ ст҃ѣи тра пезѣ . и кади ст҃ую трапезꙋ . и чт҃ное древо . и и ѡболченъ еерею . поюще тро҃ . сп҃си ги҃ люди своꙗ . въскращенне люще . Ст҃го первому в҃ ченника стефана : архидиакона . ве҃р по ѡки ст҃го . г҃ и҃ г҃ самогланки . гл҃ в҃ . сл҃ гл҃ ѕ҃ пръ воводі і҃ н҃ . ко҃ на сти҃ ѡ . сл҃ гл҃ и҃ . Раꙋися ѡ г҃ѣ і҃ ны . ко҃ тро҃ гл҃ д҃ . Цр҃скою діади мою вѣнча ся твои връхъ ѡ сїтра̄нии . ихже притръпѣ по хѣ бз҃ѣ . мч҃нко пръвостра̄лне ты бо іюдеемъ ѡбличилъ еси гнѣвъ . видѣ своего сп҃са ѡ десною ѡц҃а . того оу҃бо моли присно сп҃сти ся всѣмь намъ :~ на оу҃ кано҃ ѡ и ст҃го на ѕ҃ . по ѕ҃ . кѡ҃ гл҃а ѕ҃ . самогланъ .

Словословіе вѣкое . Поющи же браи . іереи сѡ
блачит ся . въ вѣтинь священническыи . и при
ходи с кадило[мъ] . и с лампадою . къ ст҃ѣи тра
пезѣ . и кади ст҃ую трапезꙋ . и чт҃ное древо . и

и ѡболченъ еерею . поюще тро҃ . сп҃си ги҃ люди
своꙗ . въскращенне люще . Ст҃го первому в҃
ченника стефана : архидиакона . ве҃р по ѡки
ст҃го . г҃ и҃ г҃ самогланки . гл҃ в҃ . сл҃ гл҃ ѕ҃ пръ
воводі і҃ н҃ . ко҃ на сти҃ ѡ . сл҃ гл҃ и҃ . Раꙋися
ѡ г҃ѣ і҃ ны . ко҃ тро҃ гл҃ д҃ . Цр҃скою діади
мою вѣнча ся твои връхъ ѡ сїтра̄нии . ихже
притръпѣ по хѣ бз҃ѣ . мч҃нко пръвостра̄лне

своего сп҃са ѡ десною ѡц҃а . того оу҃бо моли
присно сп҃сти ся всѣмь намъ :~ на оу҃ кано҃ ѡ
и ст҃го на ѕ҃ . по ѕ҃ . кѡ҃ гл҃а ѕ҃ . самогланъ .

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: иже в мире ко тленна пре ревши и
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Иже въ мїрѣ ꙗко тлѣнна преꙁрѣвши . и не тлѣнныꙗ дары приꙗсте . бестлѣнна пре бысте оумръше . ѿноудоуже и въскръноу сте . по мноꙃѣхъ лѣтѣхъ . вся погребше прелестникъ вѣрьсткныꙗ . ꙗже въ хвалахъ дн҃е вѣрнии въспѣвающе х҃а благодари[мъ]:~
units.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion of the Holy Seven Youths of Ephesus, Tone 4:* *Kontakion, Tone 4:* Having despised the corruptible things in the world and received incorruptible gifts, ye remained incorrupt after dying, wherefrom also ye arose after many years, having buried all the ferocious deceit of deceivers; therefore praising them today, we the faithful in hymns give thanks unto Christ![^458]

units.verbatim_book_heading: PART III: MENOLOGION :: At Matins
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *Troparion of the feast thrice. Ordinary psalmody [Kathismata]. At the Polyeleos: Sessional hymns of the feast, and reading from the books of St. John Chrysostom, Homilies 56 and 57.*[^464] *Gradual, Tone 4. Prokeimenon, Tone 4: "Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in Thy name" [Ps. 88:13]. Verse: "Thine are the heavens" [Ps. 88:12]. "Let every breath..." Gospel from Luke [9:28–36]: "At that time, Jesus took Peter [and John and James]..." And we kiss the Gospel. "Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ" we do not say. Two canons: of master Cosmas [Tone 4] and of master John [Tone 8]; heirmoi twice, and troparia four times. Katabasia: "Tracing the Cross," both choirs together. After Ode 3, Sessional hymn of the feast. After Ode 6, Kontakion, Tone 7, Idiomelon:*[^465]

units.verbatim_book_heading: PART III: MENOLOGION :: At Matins
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *At Ode 9, candles are given to the brethren. "More honorable" is not sung. Exapostilarion of the feast thrice. On the Praises, Stichera again 3... ...of the feast on 4, Tone 4: "Called from on high"; Glory, and now, Tone 8: "Christ took Peter..." Great Doxology. Troparion of the feast, litany, dismissal, and holy oil is given to the brethren. At the Hours: Troparion and Kontakion of the feast. At the Liturgy: from the canons, Ode 3 and Ode 6. Prokeimenon, Tone 4: "O Lord, how magnified are Thy works; in wisdom hast Thou made them all" [Ps. 103:24]. Epistle from the Catholic Epistle of Peter [2 Pet. 1:10–19]: "Brethren, give diligence to make your calling and election sure..." Alleluia, Tone 8: "Thine are the heavens, and Thine is the earth" [Ps. 88:12]; verse: "Blessed is the people that know the joyful sound" [Ps. 88:16]. Gospel from Matthew [17:1–9]: "At that time, Jesus takes Peter, James, and John His brother..." Communion Hymn: "O Lord, in the light of Thy countenance shall they walk, and in Thy name shall they rejoice unto ages [Ps. 88:16–17]. Alleluia."*[^466]

units.english_cohort_translation: *It is meet to know that according to tradition, on the celebrated feast of the Transfiguration it is appointed to eat grapes, which receiving blessing through prayer at the conclusion of the Divine Liturgy, and after the breaking of bread, that is, after the distribution of the antidoron, there is said: Troparion, "Thou wast transfigured..."; Glory, and now, Kontakion: "Thou wast transfigured upon the mountain..."; while this is being said, the priest censes. Then the priest [says]: "Let us pray to the Lord."*[^467]

units.english_cohort_translation: O Lord our God, Who didst formerly adorn the earth with beautiful flowers, and having enriched it with marvelous variety, didst beautify it in every aspect; and Who again, having established the earth by the four seasons, and by flowing streams of dew, dew-dropping and cooling it from the air, and by the warmth of the sun hast been well pleased to bring these fruits unto ripeness: do Thou Thyself bless these grapes with Thy grace, that they may be unto us for gladness, and for thanksgiving without physical excess, and for the strength of Thy dominion; and that for this cause we may offer praise unto the cleansing of our offenses, through the once-offered holy and life-creating Body and Blood of our Lord Jesus Christ, Thine Only-begotten Son, with Whom Thou art blessed, together with Thy Most-holy, Good, and Life-creating Spirit, now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.

units.english_cohort_translation: *And let this be known: If any of the brethren taste of the grapes prior to such feast... ...let him receive a penance, namely, by this penance not to taste grapes for the entire month of August, as a transgressor of the ordinance, that he may learn to observe these things. And let this tradition be kept always also by the vinedressers. And grapes at the refectory after the feast are served thrice in the week, the brethren tasting thereof at the noon meal; and likewise let it be done with other fruits in their proper season.*[^469]

On the Aposticha, Stichera again of the feast: "Thou hast ascended..."; Glory, and now: "Come, let us ascend..." Troparion: "Thy martyr..." Glory, and now, of the feast. units.verbatim_section_rubric: *After Ode 3, Sessional hymn of the feast twice; and after Ode 6, Kontakion and Ikos of the feast. At Ode 9, "More honorable" is not sung. Exapostilarion of the feast. On the Praises, Stichera of the feast, Tone 8: "From the darkness of the law..." on 4; Glory, and now: "Christ took Peter..." Great Doxology. units.verbatim_section_rubric: *At the Liturgy: the Beatitudes, Ode 3 on 4, and of the Cross, Ode 6 on 4; Troparion of the Cross, of the Saint; Glory, Kontakion of the Saint; and now, Kontakion of the Cross. Prokeimenon, Tone 2: "Save, O Lord, Thy people"; verse: "Unto Thee, O Lord..." And the other Prokeimenon for the Saints. Epistle for the Cross, lection 125 [1 Cor. 1:18–24]; and of the Saints, lection to All Saints [Heb. 11:33–40]. Alleluia, Tone 1: "Remember Thy congregation..." [Ps. 73:2]; verse: "God is our King..." [Ps. 73:12]; and the other: "The righteous cried..." [Ps. 33:18]. Gospel for the Cross, from John, lection 60 [John 19:6–11, 13–20, 25–28, 30–35]; and Gospel for the Saints, lection to All Saints [Matt. 10:32–33, 37–38; 19:27–30]. Communion Hymn: "The light of Thy countenance is signed upon us" [Ps. 4:7]; another: "Rejoice in the Lord, O ye righteous" [Ps. 32:1].*[^473] [^474]
