units.verbatim_section_rubric: *On Holy and Great Saturday, at about the 10th hour, he strikes the semantron;*[^608] *and the priest vests in purple vestments, and begins Vespers, without stichologia. "Lord, I have cried..." in Tone 1; Stichera on 8: 3 Resurrectional, and 1 Anatolian, and 3 Idiomela in Tone 8: "Today Hades groaning cries out...", on 4; Glory, Tone 6: "This present day mystically..."; Both now, Theotokion of the First Tone. Entrance with the Holy Gospel; "O Joyful Light..."; the Prokeimenon is not said, and immediately: "Wisdom"; and we begin the readings of the day in their order.*[^609] *After the readings, Little Litany; instead of the Trisagion, the Exclamation: "For holy art Thou, our God..."; "As many as have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ. Alleluia" [Gal. 3:27]; Prokeimenon: "Let all the earth worship Thee, and sing unto Thee..." (thrice) [Ps. 65:4]; Verse: "Shout with joy unto the Lord, all the earth" [Ps. 65:1]; Epistle to the Romans [6:3–11]: "Brethren, as many of us as were baptized into Jesus Christ..."; the Alleluia in Tone 7 and the Psalm of David are not said, and immediately... ..."Arise, O God, judge Thou the earth: for Thou shalt have an inheritance among all the nations" [Ps. 81:8].*

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: бает ведати еклисиархоу ко да буде
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Побает вѣдати е҆клисиа́рхоу · ꙗко да бꙋде̃ · ѡ҃ поулїꙋрги̃и · въ ,в҃ · ч҃с нощи · по ѡ҆пꙋстѣ же не исходимъ , и҆зъ цр҃кви · и҆ же сѣдить кождои̃ , въ своихъ мѣстѣхъ · и҆ раздаетъ келарь · бл҃женыꙗ хлѣбы · и҆ пити напоучиши · та̃ ч̑тсе · ѡ҃ дѣꙗнїи а҆пл҃ьскыхъ :~
units.english_cohort_translation: *And the priest divests himself of the purple phelonion and vests in white vestments; and he reads the Gospel according to Matthew [Matt. 28:1–20]; and the rest of the Divine Liturgy of Saint Basil the Great. Communion Hymn, Tone 4: "The Lord awoke as one out of sleep, and is risen, saving us. Alleluia" [cf. Ps. 77:65]. And a broken piece of the blessed bread is given by the priest, and there is a blessing of bread and drink.*

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: чтен блвившу иерею глем тртое
units.slavonic_diplomatic: По чт҃ен · бл҃вившꙋ і҃ерею г҃лемь · тр҃тое · г҃и помилоуи · в҃і · придѣте поклонимъсѧ г҃ , жды · ѱалѡмь , н҃ · та̃ канѡ̃ · великыꙗ сꙋботы гл̃а · ѕ҃ · і҃рм̃ по · в҃ · и҆ трорѣ по · д҃ ·
units.english_cohort_translation: *It is fitting that the Ecclesiarch know: so that the dismissal of the Liturgy shall be at the 2nd hour of the night.*[^610] *And after the dismissal, we do not go out from the church, but each sits in his own place; and the cellarer distributes the blessed bread, and drink, a cup of wine.*[^611] *Then the Acts of the Holy Apostles are read.*[^612]

units.verbatim_book_heading: SYNAXARION OF THE TRIODION AND PENTECOSTARION :: Litany, and Dismissal. And we do not join the First Hour.*[^600]
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the reading, the priest having given the blessing, we say the Trisagion; "Lord, have mercy" (12 times); "O come, let us worship..." (thrice); Psalm 50; then the Canon of Holy and Great Saturday, Tone 6: the heirmoi twice, and the troparia on 4... ...and again the heirmos once together. After Ode 3, Sessional hymn, and a reading; after Ode 6, Kontakion, Tone 2, and the Ikos of Saturday, and a reading. After the Canon, Trisagion; Troparion: "When Thou didst descend unto death, O Life Immortal..."; Little Litany, and Dismissal. And a reading.*

units.english_cohort_translation: *After the reading, the Ecclesiarch gives tapers unto the brethren.*[^613] *The candilaptis sounds the great semantron and the iron semantron.*[^614] *And we all go out into the narthex, except the candilaptis, for he lights all the candles and chandeliers, and prepares a vessel with fire, and sets it in the midst of the church, and places much incense near the Holy Doors; and he also suspends fire with incense in the sanctuary; and the church is censed.*[^615]

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: чтен дает еклисиарх свещи бран
units.slavonic_diplomatic: По чтен · дае́т е҆клисиа́рхъ свѣщи бран · кандилаптис же ѡ҆знаменаеть , въ великое , и҆ въ желѣ́зное · и҆́сходимъ вси въ притворꙑ · развѣ кандилаптисъ , въжнгаеть бо свѣщи въсѧ , и҆ пандикадила · и҆ оу҆строить съсꙋжецїль съ ѡ҆гнемь · и҆ поставить посрѣ̃ цр҃кве и҆ положить фимїама много , поблизоу с҃ты дверїи · ѡ҆бѣсит же и҆ въс̑ ѡ҆лтари ѡ҆гнь съ фимїа̃мѡ · и҆ кадить цр҃ковь ·
units.english_cohort_translation: *And the priest vests in radiant vestments, and goes out into the narthex through the northern door, with two candles preceding him. And the doors being shut, the priest censes all in the narthex; and standing before the church doors looking toward the east, he marks the sign of the cross thrice with the censer... ...saying with a loud voice: "Glory to the holy, consubstantial, life-creating, and undivided Trinity, alway, now and ever, and unto ages of ages!" And after "Amen", the priest begins in Tone 5: "Christ is risen from the dead, trampling down death by death, and upon those in the tombs bestowing life!" thrice; then the choir and the brethren chant it thrice.*[^616]

(thrice); Psalm 50; then the Canon of Holy and Great Saturday, Tone 6: the heirmoi twice, and the troparia on 4... ...and again the heirmos once together. After Ode 3, Sessional hymn, and a reading; after Ode 6, Kontakion, Tone 2, and the Ikos of Saturday, and a reading. After the Canon, Trisagion; Troparion: "When Thou didst descend unto death, O Life Immortal..."; Little Litany, and Dismissal. And a reading.*

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *And the priest at the beginning of the Canon censes. And there are sung the heirmoi on 4, and the troparia on 6, so that on whichever side the beginning shall be, the leader of that side begins, and then the choir of the right side... ...at the 3rd ode again both sides balance out according to their order. And after each ode there is a Little Litany on that holy feast.*

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *On the Praises: 4 Resurrectional Stichera, Tone 1. And the choirs having gathered together say the verses: "Let God arise, and let His enemies be scattered..."; and they sing the Stichera, Tone 5: "A holy Pascha hath been revealed unto us today...", and the rest, with their verses; Glory: "A delightful Pascha..."; Both now: "This is the day of the Resurrection..."; then "Christ is risen..." (thrice).*

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: въсприимлае иереи еие и стане
units.slavonic_diplomatic: въспрїимлае · і҃ереи · е҆ѵ̃е · и҆ стане̃ оу҆ ст҃ыі дверїи · и҆ цѣ́лꙋеть прѣстоѧщїа · е҆ѵ̃лїе · и҆ тако і҃ереи · въспрїимлѧ же прѣстоѧщїи , е҆ѵ̃е стане̃ ѡ҃ деснꙋю і҃ереа и҆ цѣ́лꙋю бран̃ е҆ѵ̃е и҆ прѣстоѧ щаго та̃ і҃ереа и҆ сами межю собою по чинꙋ скоє́моу · по цѣ́лованїи же гле́ть прѣстоѧщїи · въ слꙋ́хъ всеи братьи · а҆ ѡ҆ни стоѧще слꙋ́шають :~
units.english_cohort_translation: *And the Kiss of Peace takes place in this manner:*[^619] *The priest takes the Holy Gospel, and stands at the Holy Doors, and the presider kisses the Gospel, and likewise the priest; and having received the Gospel, the presider stands to the right of the priest; and the brethren kiss the Gospel and the presider... ...and then the priest, and each other among themselves, according to their rank. units.verbatim_section_rubric: *On the Praises: 4 Resurrectional Stichera, Tone 1. And the choirs having gathered together say the verses: "Let God arise, and let His enemies be scattered..."; and they sing the Stichera, Tone 5: "A holy Pascha hath been revealed unto us today...", and the rest, with their verses; Glory: "A delightful Pascha..."; Both now: "This is the day of the Resurrection..."; then "Christ is risen..." (thrice).*

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: иже аще кто блгочтив и бголюбив
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Иже а́ще кто , бл҃гочти́въ · и҆ бг҃олюбивъ · прїтенасладитсѧ , сего праздьньства · е҆лико раби блазїи , и҆ вѣ́рнїи · да внидꙋ́ весе́лѧщесѧ въ ра́дос҃ гд̃а своего · е҆лико трꙋдисте по́стѧще̃ · прїимѣ́те нн҃ѣ по пѣ́нѧзю , е҆лико ѡ҃ трꙋда дѣ́ласте · прїимѣ́те нн҃ѣ праве́дноую мъздꙋ · е҆лико по · г҃ · годинѣ прїидосте · с похвалою празньствꙋите · а҆ще е҆лико · ѕ҃ · ю , годинꙋ прїиде кто , не и҆мыи ничтоже да не сꙋ́дитсѧ ·
units.english_cohort_translation: If anyone has come after the sixth hour, having nothing, let him in no way be judged; for there shall be no loss. If anyone has tarried even unto the ninth hour, let him draw near, doubting nothing. If anyone has arrived only at the eleventh hour, let him not fear because of his delay; for the Lover of mankind with bounty receives the last even as the first: He gives rest unto him who came at the eleventh hour, even as unto him who worked from the morning; He has mercy upon the last, and consoles the first; and unto that one He gives, and unto this one He bestows; and He accepts the deeds, and cherishes the intention of him that delayed; He honors the work, and praises the haste of him that delayed!
units.slavonic_text: Иже а́ще кто , бл҃гочти́въ · и҆ бг҃олюбивъ · прїтенасладитсѧ , сего праздьньства · е҆лико раби блазїи , и҆ вѣ́рнїи · да внидꙋ́ весе́лѧщесѧ въ ра́дос҃ гд̃а своего · е҆лико трꙋдисте по́стѧще̃ · прїимѣ́те нн҃ѣ по пѣ́нѧзю , е҆лико ѡ҃ трꙋда дѣ́ласте · прїимѣ́те нн҃ѣ праве́дноую мъздꙋ · е҆лико по · г҃ · годинѣ прїидосте · с похвалою празньствꙋите · а҆ще е҆лико · ѕ҃ · ю , годинꙋ прїиде кто , не и҆мыи ничтоже да не сꙋ́дитсѧ ·

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: ибо никоея же тщеты будет аще кто
units.slavonic_diplomatic: и҆́бо никое́ѧ же тщеты бꙋдеть · а҆́ще кто медливъ е҆ · да и҆ · ѳ҃ · ю , годиноу · прїиди ничим же пекыисѧ токмѡ · а҆́ще кто постиглъ е҆ · въ , а҃і · годинꙋ , да не оу҆боитсѧ за медленїа · щедротою бо чл҃колюбець прїемлеть послѣ́днаго ꙗко и҆ пръваго · пока́заеть прише́шаго въ е҆диноуна̃ · і҃ · годинꙋ , ꙗко и҆ дѣ́лавшаго ѡ҃ оу҆́тра · послѣ́днꙗго милꙋ́еть и҆ пръваго оу҆вѣщева́еть · и҆ томꙋ даеть , и҆ семоу дарꙋ́еть , и҆ дѣ́ла прїемлеть · и҆ спѣ́оу҆медлившаго любить · дѣ́ло чт҃и , и҆ скорость оу҆медлившаго хвалить · тѣ́м же вънидѣ́те въ радость г҃а вашего , пръвїи · и҆ въторїи · и҆ послѣ́днїи · мъзꙋ прїимѣ́те , богатїи , и҆ оу҆бозїи · и҆ кꙋ́пно въсплещете · постившеисѧ , и҆ лѣнивїи дн҃ь почтѣ́те · а҆лкавшенсѧ , и҆ не а҆лкавшеи · възвеселитесѧ дн҃ь · трапеза цр҃ковнаꙗ и҆сплънена · насладитесѧ вьси · телець оу҆питеныи , и҆ сплъ нье̃ , никтоже не и҆зыди а҆́лченъ · вси насладитесѧ пира цр҃ковнаго · въси прїимѣ́те бг҃атство бл҃гти · развѣ́ : сквернитель · и҆́же своꙗ телеса ѡ҆сквернѧють блꙋдомь и҆ требамн · ти́ бо неприꙗзни слꙋжать · никтоже да не плачетсѧ нищетою · ꙗви бо сѧ ѡ҆бьщее цр҃ьство · никтоже да не рыдае́ть прегрѣшенїа · прощенїе бо ѡ҃ гроба въсиꙗ · никтоже да боитсѧ смерти · свободи бо на̃ с҃пса нашего : смр҃ть · дръзаите а҆́зъ побѣди́хъ миръ · и҆́миродръжителѧ · понесъ са́мъ грѣхы мира · сп҃слъ бо ны е҆ х҃съ , и҆ ѡ҃ ада и҆збавиль · и҆сторже бо ны · ѡ҃ дїа́вола насїлїа · и҆ ѡ҃ работы е҆го свободиль е҆ , ѡ҆горчи сѧ а҆́дъ · въкоусивъ чьстныа и҆ ст҃ыа плът̑и влч҃на · ꙗкоже и҆саиа проре̃ · ѡ҆горчи сѧ а҆́дъ оу҆срѣ́тъ тебе долꙋ · ѡ҆горчи сѧ оу҆́бо понеже оу҆празднисѧ · ѡ҆горчи сѧ оу҆́бо , понеже порꙋганъ бы̃ · ѡ҆горчисѧ понеже свѧзанъ бы · прїѧть тѣ́ло ,
units.english_cohort_translation: The church's table is laden; feast all of you! The fatted calf is set forth; let all be filled, let no one go forth hungry! Feast all of you upon the banquet of faith; receive all of you the riches of goodness!

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: и ба оусрете прият еже при
units.slavonic_diplomatic: и҆ б҃а оу҆срѣ́те · прїѧть е҆́же приꙗ · и҆ паде ѡ҆́нѫдꙋ же не сматрꙗ́ше · поглоти смр҃ть не видѧщи · и҆ поглотивъ позна̃ е҆го́же поглоти · поглоти живота и҆ пороуганъ бы животѡмь · поглоти ꙗко е҆диного съвѣдали , и҆ лишни же съквѣдали е҆диного · похыти ꙗко левь , и҆ съкрꙋши жꙋбы своꙗ · грѣ́ха ради съмръть прекъзложе · и҆ въ х҃ѣ грѣ́ха не ѡ҆врѣ́те , оу҆празни сѧ к томꙋ · жало бо съсмр҃ти грѣ̃ · грѣ́ха же х҃съ не сътвори , ни же ѡ҆врѣ́тесѧ лесть въ оу҆стѣ́хъ е҆го · подбно же времѧ е҆́рещи · гдѣ ти смр҃ти жало · гдѣ ти а҆де побѣ́да · въскрсе х҃съ , ты же низвръже сѧ · въскрсе х҃съ , и҆ радꙋ́ютсѧ а҆́гг҃ли · въскрсе х҃с , и҆ падоша бѣ́сове · въскре̃ х҃с , и҆ животъ пребыва́еть · въскрсе х҃с , и҆ мр҃твїи въздвигошасѧ · въскре̃ х҃с , и҆ ѡ҃ тлѧ и҆збавихомсѧ · въскрсе х҃с , и҆ ѡ҃ клѧтвы и҆збыхомь · въскрсе х҃с , и҆ мы съ нимь съвъскре

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: та тро гла и о
units.slavonic_diplomatic: та̃ тро · гла̃ · и҃ · ѡ҆ оу҆́стъ твоихъ ꙗко злато · ѡ҆кте̃а · и҆ ѡ҆поу̃ :~
units.english_cohort_translation: From thy mouth like a radiance of fire hath grace shone forth, enlightening the universe; it hath deposited in the world treasures of non-avarice, and hath shown us the height of humility. But by thy words instructing us, O father John Chrysostom, intercede with the Word, Christ God, that He may save our souls![^629]

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: въскресение хво видевше поклонимся стму гу исоу
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Въскресенїе х҃во видѣвше , поклонимсѧ ст҃мꙋ г҃у і҃соу · є҆диномꙋ безгрѣ́шномꙋ · крестꙋ твоє́мꙋ покланѧ́емсѧ х҃е · и҆ ст҃ое въскресенїе твое славимь · ты бо е҆си б҃ъ нашь развѣ́ тебе и҆ного не знае́мь · и҆́мѧ твое нарицае́мь · прїидѣ́те вьси вѣ́рнїи поклонимсѧ х҃воу ст҃моу въскрсенїю · се бо прииде кр҃та ради радость въсемꙋ мироу · въсегда бл҃вѧще г҃а , и҆ въскрсенїе е҆го поимь распѧтїе бо пострада и҆ съмръ́тїю съмръ́ть раздроуши :~ г҃ ·
units.english_cohort_translation: Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ, let us worship the Holy Lord Jesus, the only Sinless One. We venerate Thy Cross, O Christ, and Thy Holy Resurrection we praise and glorify. For Thou art our God, apart from Thee we know no other, we call upon Thy Name. Come, all ye faithful, let us venerate the Holy Resurrection of Christ! For behold, through the Cross joy hath come into all the world! Ever blessing the Lord, we sing His Resurrection; for having endured the Crucifixion, by death He hath destroyed death! *(thrice).*

units.slavonic_diplomatic: и҆́же въ свѣ́тѣ пр̃ноесꙋщїимь бы́лъ , с жи́выми съ мр҃твыими · не и҆́щите ꙗко чл҃ка · видите гро тныꙗ пелены тецѣ́те и҆ мироу проповѣ́дите ꙗ҆ко въскрсе г҃ь оу҆мр҃твивыи смр҃ть · ꙗко тѣ́ н҃е сн҃ь бж҃їи · сп҃сающаго ро́дъ чл҃чьскыи :~
units.english_cohort_translation: *The women with Mary came before dawn, and found the stone rolled away from the tomb; and they heard from the Angel: "Him Who exists in everlasting light, why seek ye Him with the dead as a man? units.slavonic_stem_tier2: в гробе плътскы в аде же с
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Въ гробѣ плътскы · въ а҆́дѣ же съ дꙋ́шею ꙗко б҃ъ · в раи же съ разбоиникѡ , на пр̃тлѣ бѣаше х҃е съ ѡ҃ц҃емь и҆ дх҃мь · всѧ́ и҆сплъна́ѧ неѡ҃писанныи :~
units.english_cohort_translation: In the tomb bodily, in Hades with the soul as God, in Paradise with the thief, and on the Throne with the Father and the Spirit wast Thou, O Christ, filling all things, Thou Who art uncircumscribed.[^633]

units.verbatim_book_heading: SYNAXARION OF THE TRIODION AND PENTECOSTARION :: The Order of the Hours on Holy Pascha; and in this manner is also sung Compline, and all through Saturday [of Bright Week]:*[^630]
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *"Christ is risen" (thrice); "Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ" (once); and "The women with Mary came before dawn"; Glory: "Though Thou didst descend into the tomb"; Both now: "Only-begotten Son"; then the Beatitudes, from the Canon, Ode 3 and Ode 6; Epistle; Gospel; then the commemorations; "The heavenly choir"; "I believe in one God"; "Our Father"; Kontakion: "Though Thou didst descend into the tomb"; "Lord, have mercy" (12); then "Christ is risen" (thrice); Glory, Both now; Lord, bless; then "Blessed be the Name of the Lord", unto "shall not lack any good thing" [Ps. 33:11]; and the Dismissal. In this manner we sing the Hours until Saturday of the 9th hour.*[^637]

на землю при · Е҆ѵе ѡ҃ і҃ѡа · И҆скони бѣ̀ сло
во · и҆ про̃ · Лѵтꙋргїа · Златоу́стаго · при
тѣ́ло х҃во · и҆ на трапезѣ оу҆тѣ́шенїе бра́тїе вели́
лїе · и҆ допѣ́лникое быва́е :~ Чинъ ѡ҃ панагїи ,
быва́емы · и҆́же ѡ҃ ѡ҃бы́ч , въ зластырѣ , на ст҃ꙋю
пасхꙋ · Въставаꙗ ѡ҃ трапезы · бра́ꙗ · рекꙋ́ ·

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: мы же въстава рече хс въскре
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Мы же въставаꙗ · рече · Х҃съ въскр̃е г҃ · г҃и помлꙋи г҃ · та̃ · і҃ереи рче · Бл҃венъ б҃гъ мл҃ лꙋꙗ и҆ питаꙗ на̃ · та̃ реть · Б҃ъ прости ты и҆ помлꙋеть послꙋживши на̃ · и҆ и҆де в келїа своꙗ · Сице творимь въ въсѧ ст҃ꙋю нѣлю ·
units.english_cohort_translation: *And we, rising, say:* "Christ is risen" *(thrice);* "Lord, have mercy" *(thrice); then the priest says:* "Blessed is God Who has mercy on us and nourishes us"; *then he says:* "May God forgive and have mercy on those who have served us"; *and each goes to his cell. In this manner we do throughout all Bright Week, kissing the prosphora in the refectory.*[^650]

units.slavonic_diplomatic: Въ сꙋботꙋ же , ѳ҃ , ѡ҃диноу · раздроблѧ́ ють , а҆́ртоусъ · и҆ раздавають · братїи :~
units.english_cohort_translation: *The priest vests in sacred vestments... ...and standing before the Holy Doors with the censer, he censes the Holy Doors in the form of a cross, saying:* "Blessed is our God..."; *and after "Amen", he begins: "Christ is risen" (thrice); then it is also sung by the brethren (thrice); and the priest says the verses: "Let God arise"; Verse: "As smoke vanishes"; Verse: "So let the wicked perish"; and after each verse the brethren sing: "Christ is risen"; Glory, Both now: "Christ is risen". Great Litany. At "Lord, I have cried", in Tone 2: Stichera, 3 Resurrectional and 3 Anatolian of Tone 2; Glory, Anatolian; Both now, Theotokion, Tone 1:* "The shadow of the Law hath passed away, now that grace hath come; for as the Bush was not consumed though on fire, so hast thou given birth as a virgin and remained a virgin. In place of the pillar of fire, the Sun of Righteousness hath shone forth; instead of Moses, Christ, the salvation of our souls."[^653] *Entrance with the Holy Gospel; "O Joyful Light"; then the Great Prokeimenon, Tone 7:* "Who is a god so great as our God? Thou art the God that doest wonders!" [Ps. 76:14–15][^654] *Verse 1: "Thou hast declared Thy power among the peoples" [Ps. 76:15]; Verse 2: "And I said: Now have I begun" [Ps. 76:11]; Verse 3: "I remembered the works of the Lord" [Ps. 76:12]; then the priest:* "And that we may be accounted worthy..."; *and he reads the Gospel according to John [20:19–25]: "The same day at evening..." ending with: "...I will not believe."*[^655] *Litany: "Let us all say..."; "Vouchsafe, O Lord..."; then the Litany: "Let us complete our evening prayer..."; Aposticha: Resurrectional:* "Thy Resurrection, O Christ Savior, hath enlightened the whole universe; and Thou hast recalled Thine own creation: O Almighty Lord, glory to Thee!"; *then 3 Stichera of Pascha...*[^656]

units.slavonic_diplomatic: и҆ пакы і҃рм̃ь а҃ · вкоу · Въ началѣ же кано на · і҃ереи кадить цр҃ковь · по г҃ · пѣ̃ ѵ҆па кои · та̃ · і҃рм̃ь · по ѕ҃ ко̃ і҃ико · та̃ въскръ сенїе х҃во , г҃ · и҆ въскресыи ѡ҃ гроба · безъ п҃ го · ѱалма · по ѳ҃ · пѣ̃ · свѣ́, г҃ · на хва́ ·
units.english_cohort_translation: *The priest puts on the epitrachelion, and taking the censer, censes the Holy Table thrice in the sign of the cross, saying:* "Glory to the holy, consubstantial..."; *and after "Amen", the priest begins: "Christ is risen" (thrice), and censes the altar, the brethren singing: "Christ is risen" (thrice); and the priest says 3 verses: "O give thanks unto the Lord" [Ps. 117:1]; "This is the day which the Lord hath made" [Ps. 117:24]; "Bind the sacrifice with cords" [Ps. 117:27]; at each verse: "Christ is risen"; and again the priest: "Christ is risen"; the brethren: "And upon those in the tombs bestowing life!" Great Litany. After the exclamation, we begin the Canon:* "This is the day of Resurrection..."; *the Heirmos twice, and the troparia on 4, and again the Heirmos once together. At the beginning of the Canon the priest censes the church. After Ode 3, the Hypakoe, then the Heirmos; after Ode 6, Kontakion and Ikos, then the Resurrectional hymn... ..."Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ" (thrice); and "Jesus having risen from the tomb", without the 50th Psalm.*[^660] *After Ode 9, the Exapostilarion (thrice); at the Praises: Stichera of the Octoechos of Tone 2 on 4; then the Paschal Stichera: "Pascha the sacred"; Glory, Both now:* "This is the day of Resurrection..."; *then "Christ is risen" (thrice); Litany, and Dismissal; and they process with crosses around the monastery. In this manner it is sung also at Matins throughout all the week.*[^661]

units.english_cohort_translation: *At "Lord, I have cried", in Tone 4, Stichera of the Octoechos: 3 Resurrectional and 3 Anatolian; Glory, Anatolian; Both now, Theotokion of Tone 1 [Tone 4 Dogmatikon]:* "David the Prophet, who through thee became the forefather of God, in song cried out concerning thee unto Him that did great things for thee: 'The Queen stood at Thy right hand...' [Ps. 44:10]. For God, Whose good pleasure it was to become incarnate from thee without a father, hath revealed thee as Mother and mediatress of life..."[^670] *Entrance; "O Joyful Light"; Great Prokeimenon, Tone 8:* With my voice have I cried unto the Lord, with my voice unto God, and He gave ear unto me! [Ps. 76:2][^671]

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: бе в стем пу твои на сти
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Б҃е въ ст҃ѣмь пꙋ̃ твои · На стї · въскр̃ны , Г҃ь въ́шед на кр̃тъ · и҆ пасцьѣ · ст҃ры · Пасха сщ҃еннаꙗ · Сла́ і҃ н҃ Въскресенїа дн҃ь · Х҃съ въ скрсе , г҃ · ѡ҃кте̃а · ѡ҃пꙋ̃ · Въ чере свѣ́тлыꙗ нѣли , на оу҆рн · поетсѧ ꙗкоже и҆ в пн҃е · и҆ ѡ҃би ходи манастырь · съ кр҃ты · На лѵ́ргїи , а҃нт · па̃ · Про Помѧноу и҆́мѧ твое · с҃ Слы ши дщи , а҆пл҃ь · р̃д · а҆́ллꙋ́ꙗ · Величить дꙋ ша · с҃ Ꙗ҆́ко призри · е҆ѵе р̃а · при Тѣ́ло х҃во

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: в сре вечер стры въскрсны
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Въ ср̃е вечерь · ст҃ры , въскр̃сны , г҃ · гл̃а е҃ · и҆ г҃ · въсто · сла́ въсто · і҃ н҃ б҃о · а҃ · гласоу ·
units.english_cohort_translation: *Stichera, 3 Resurrectional of Tone 5 and 3 Anatolian; Glory, Anatolian; Both now, Theotokion of the Tone [Tone 5 Dogmatikon]:* "In the Red Sea an image of the unwedded Bride was prefigured of old: there Moses divided the water, here Gabriel was the minister of the marvel; then the deep was trodden dry-shod by Israel, now Christ is born without seed of the Virgin; the sea after the passage of Israel remained impassable, the Immaculate One after the birth of Emmanuel remains undefiled..."[^677] *Entrance; Great Prokeimenon, Tone 7:* Give ear, O God, unto my prayer, and despise not my supplication! [Ps. 54:2][^678]

units.slavonic_diplomatic: а҆́ллꙋ́ꙗ · Г҃ь въцр̃исѧ · с҃ · и҆́бо оу҆твръди е҆ѵлїе рж҃ · при Тѣ́ло х҃во · На трапезѣ , сѣ́ кши бра̃и , раздробивъ келарь , а҆́ртоу и҆ дае ть бра̃и · Х҃с же въскрсе , възглашаетсѧ в конець трапезы · и҆ ѡ҃всегда · ѿ нн҃ѣ́ даже и҆ до възнесенїа · въ мѣ́стѣ́ , великомїа · Се моу же гл̃емомꙋ · ѿ келарѧ · мы гле̃мь ѡ҃ вѣ́щеваа · Въистинноу въскрсе · та̃ кела рь · прекрщ҃аѧ · панагыю · хлѣ́бомь речеть · Пр҃таа бц҃е помагаи намь · мы же ѡ҃вѣ́щаемь · Тоꙗ мл҃твами б҃е помилꙋи на̃ ·
units.english_cohort_translation: *At the Refectory [trapeza]: The brethren having sat down, the cellarer having broken the Artos, distributes it unto the brethren.*[^699] *"Christ is risen" is proclaimed at the end of the refectory, and always from now even unto the Ascension, in place of "Great is the Name [of the Holy Trinity]".*[^700] *And when this is said by the cellarer, we say responding:* "Truly He is risen!" *Then the cellarer, crossing the panagia with the bread, says:* "All-holy Theotokos, help us!" *And we... ...respond:* "By her prayers, O God, have mercy on us!"[^701] *Then:* "All generations call thee blessed", *and the rest of the customary order.*[^702]

*...respond:* "By her prayers, O God, have mercy on us!"[^701] *Then:* "All generations call thee blessed", *and the rest of the customary order.*[^702]

internal_coordinates.podoben_label_raw: With his searching right hand did Thomas explore Thy life-giving side, O Christ God; for when Thou didst enter, the doors being shut, he cried aloud with the rest of the Apostles: Thou art my Lord and my God![^711] *Ikos; after Ode 9:* "More honorable than the Cherubim" *is not sung, and we do not chant the verses of the Ninth Ode.*[^712] *Exapostilarion, Tone 3:* "With thy hand having probed the wounds of My members, Thomas, be not faithless unto Me..."[^713] *At the Praises, Stichera on 4, Tone 1, Podoben: "All-praised martyrs" (Всехвалніи мученицы):*[^714] *Glory, Tone 6:* "After eight days our Savior came unto the disciples..."; *Both now:* "Most blessed art thou, O Virgin Theotokos..."; *Great Doxology; Troparion of the feast, and Dismissal.

internal_coordinates.podoben_label_raw: With his searching right hand did Thomas explore Thy life-giving side, O Christ God; for when Thou didst enter, the doors being shut, he cried aloud with the rest of the Apostles: Thou art my Lord and my God![^711] *Ikos; after Ode 9:* "More honorable than the Cherubim" *is not sung, and we do not chant the verses of the Ninth Ode.*[^712] *Exapostilarion, Tone 3:* "With thy hand having probed the wounds of My members, Thomas, be not faithless unto Me..."[^713] *At the Praises, Stichera on 4, Tone 1, Podoben: "All-praised martyrs" (Всехвалніи мученицы):*[^714] *Glory, Tone 6:* "After eight days our Savior came unto the disciples..."; *Both now:* "Most blessed art thou, O Virgin Theotokos..."; *Great Doxology; Troparion of the feast, and Dismissal.

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: въскрны пока нны и дл сл
units.slavonic_diplomatic: въскр̃ны · покаꙗнны · и҆ дл҃ · сл̃ і҃ н҃ праз̃ · на стї ст҃ры праз̃ · и҆́же въ триѡ҃ · с҃ тї же гле̃ ды · въ всю зелю · с҃ · нб҃са повѣ́даю · сл̃а і҃ н҃ праз̃ · по тр҃тѣмь · тро̃ праз̃ · і҃ере̃и ѡ҃кте̃ю · та̃ і҃ереи · Сын бл̃агословень б҃ъ нашь · и҆ съвъкоуплꙗе̃ · а҃ ча̃ · по ѡ҃быю ·
units.english_cohort_translation: *On Monday of Antipascha [Second Monday after Pascha], at Matins: The usual Midnight Office. Then the priest having blessed, we begin:* "Christ is risen" *(thrice); then* "Glory to God in the highest", *and the Six Psalms. And at* "God is the Lord": *Troparion of the feast, thrice; and chant two Kathismata. After the 1st Kathisma: Sessional hymns from the Octoechos, Resurrectional and Penitential, and of the day; Glory, Both now. After the 2nd Kathisma: Sessional hymn of the feast;* "Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ"; *Psalm 50; but the Hymns [of repentance: "Open unto me the doors of repentance..."] are not said throughout the whole Fifty Days [Pentecostarion period]. And straightway we begin [the Canon]: the Heirmos twice, and troparia to 6, and of the Triodion/saint to 4. After Ode 3: Sessional hymn of the day; after Ode 6: Kontakion of the feast; after Ode 9: Exapostilarion of the feast. At the Praises: Resurrectional, Penitential, and of the day; Glory, Both now, of the feast. At the Aposticha: Stichera of the feast, which are in the Triodion; and we say the verses:* Their sound is gone out into all the earth, and their words unto the ends of the world! [Ps. 18:5][^722] *Verse:* The heavens declare the glory of God, and the firmament proclaims the work of His hands! [Ps. 18:2] *Glory, Both now, of the feast. After the Trisagion: Troparion of the feast. The priest says the Ektenia. Then the priest [gives the dismissal/blessing]:* "Blessed is the Son of God, our God", *and he joins the First Hour according to custom.*[^723]

units.slavonic_diplomatic: Вѣ́домо же бꙋди ꙗ҆́ко ѿ сеꙗ дн҃нны · начи наемь · пѣ́ти · ѱл҃тырь · по в҃ ка̃ · на оу҆рни а҃ третьꙗꙗ · на ве̃рни · нарѧдъ же · и҆ ѿ нн҃ѣ́ начинаемъ · пѣ́ти кано̃нь · ст҃ѣи бц҃и · на павечерници · въ триѡ҃ · дневнаꙗ · Въ начало же всѧкого пѣ́нїа · бл҃вившоу ·
units.english_cohort_translation: *Be it known that from this day we begin... ...to chant the Psalter: two Kathismata at Matins, and the third at Vespers in order.*[^724] *And from now on we begin to chant the Canon to the Most Holy Theotokos at Compline, the daily canons in the Triodion.*[^725] *At the beginning of every singing [office], the priest having blessed, we say:* "Christ is risen" *(thrice); then* "Glory, Both now", "All-holy Trinity", *and* "Our Father", *and the rest as usual.*[^726] *Likewise even until the Day of the Ascension, in the same manner. And at Matins, after the second litany is said:* "Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ", *even until the Ascension of the Lord.*[^727] *And this is to be known: Even as it hath been indicated on Sunday evening and on Monday at Matins, so it is done throughout all the weeks, even until the Ascension, with the stichera changing according to the Tones in the Octoechos, and the Sessional hymns according to custom.*[^728] *Be it known also that on Wednesday and on Friday, the Stichera of the Cross are sung first; thus: the Resurrectional are not first, because our Lord Jesus Christ was first crucified...*

units.slavonic_diplomatic: ти тако въскр̃се · и҆з мр҃твы · В пѧ̃ а҃нтипас схы · ве̃ · ст҃ры · на ѕ҃ · праз̃ · сагласны ·
units.english_cohort_translation: *On Friday of Antipascha [Second Friday of Paschaltide, Apodosis of Thomas Sunday], at Vespers: Stichera on 6: of the feast, idiomela 3 in Tone 1; and of the day, 3; Glory, Tone 6:* "When the doors were shut..."; *Both now, Dogmatikon Theotokion of Tone 1:* "The glory of all the world, who sprouted from mankind..."[^730] *At the Aposticha: 4 Resurrectional of Tone 1; and we say the verses:* The Lord is King, He is clothed with majesty! [Ps. 92:1a] *Verse:* For He hath established the world, which shall not be shaken! [Ps. 92:1c] *Verse:* Holiness becomes Thine house, O Lord, unto length of days! [Ps. 92:5b] *Glory, Both now, Tone 5:* "O Lover of mankind, great and unsearchable..."; *Troparion, Tone 7:* "Though the tomb was sealed..."; *the Canon for the Departed in the Octoechos of the current Tone.*[^731] *On all Saturdays of the Fifty Days is sung [the Canon for the Departed] on Friday at Compline. On Saturday at Matins: Troparion of the feast, thrice; Sessional hymns in the Triodion of the feast; Canon of the feast with the heirmoi on 6, and of the patron saint of the temple in Tone 1 on 4; or if there be no patronal service, then of the Prophets; or of the Saint [from the Menaion] on 4.*[^732] *At the Praises: 4 Resurrectional of Tone 1; Glory, Both now, of the feast. At the Liturgy: Prokeimenon of the feast; Alleluia, Communion verse of the feast; but the Epistle and Gospel of the day.*[^733]

units.english_cohort_translation: *Stichera: Resurrectional and of the Theotokos according to custom. Troparion:* "The noble Joseph..." *At Great Vespers: ...Stichera on 10: Resurrectional 3 from the Octoechos of Tone 2, and Anatolian 4; and of the Myrrh-Bearers, idiomela 3 in Tone 2; Glory, Tone 6:* "The Myrrh-bearing women, reaching Thy sepulchre early...";[^735] *Both now, Dogmatikon Theotokion of Tone 2:* "Passed away is the shadow of the law when grace arrived..."[^736] *At the Litiya: idiomela 3 in Tone 1; Glory, Tone 6:* "Joseph begged the Body of Jesus..."; *Both now, Theotokion of the same Tone [or Alphabetical Theotokion]. At the Aposticha: Resurrectional stichera and alphabetical; Glory, Both now, Tone 5:* "Thee Who clothest Thyself with light as with a garment, when Joseph took Thee down from the Tree with Nicodemus...";[^737] *after the Trisagion:* "O Theotokos Virgin, rejoice" *(thrice).*

units.slavonic_incipit: съ кр҃та съне̃ прч҃тое тѣ́ло твое
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: с крта съне прчтое тело твое плащяни
units.slavonic_diplomatic: съ кр҃та съне̃ прч҃тое тѣ́ло твое · плащѧни цею чт҃ою ѡ҃бвивъ · и҆ вонꙗми въ гробѣ новꙋ възакрывы положи · но въ третїи дн҃ь въ скре̃ ꙗ҆́ко б҃ъ · дарова всемоу мирови велїю ми ло̃ :~ і҆ны · Мироносицамь женамь · при гро бѣ ставь а҆́гг҃лъ гла̃ше миро мрт҃выимь е҆́ подо бно · х҃с же и҆стлѣ́нїю ꙗ҆́висѧ чюжь · но въ спите зовꙋще · въскре̃ г҃ь подаꙗ мирови ве лїю мл҃ть :~ и҆ про е҆ ѡ҃бычное · нѣ̃ · сꙋтенна ·
units.english_cohort_translation: *Another Troparion:* Unto the myrrh-bearing women standing by the sepulchre, the angel cried aloud: Myrrh is fitting for the dead, but Christ hath shown Himself a stranger to corruption; rather cry aloud, calling: The Lord is risen, granting unto the world great mercy![^740]

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: ко гл в радоватися мироносицам повелел еси
units.slavonic_diplomatic: кѡ̃ гл̃ в҃ · Радоватисѧ мироносицамъ повелѣ́лъ е҆си · и҆ плачь прама́трери е҆́вы · оу҆ ставилъ е҆си въскренїе̃ своимь · х҃е б҃е нашь а҆́пл҃ѡм же своимь проповѣ́дати повелѣ́ · сп҃съ въскре̃ ѡ҃ гроба :~
units.english_cohort_translation: Thou didst bid the myrrh-bearing women rejoice, and didst stay the weeping of the first-mother Eve by Thy Resurrection, O Christ our God; and Thou didst command Thine Apostles to proclaim: The Savior is risen from the tomb![^743]

units.slavonic_diplomatic: Празникꙋ законномꙋ препловнившюсѧ · въ- сѣхъ творче и вл҃ко · къ приходѧщи гл҃аше хє҃ бє҃ прїдете почерпите водꙋ бесмр҃тїꙗ · тѣ- м же ти припадаемь , и҆ вѣрою въпїемь , ще- дроты твоꙗ нам дароуи · ты бо еси источникъ животоу нашемꙋ: ~ по θ҃ · пѣ свѣ, на хва · на д҃ · гл҃а д҃ · поⷣ ꙗко добл҃ · сла҃ і҆н҃ глаⷵ д҃ · просвѣтивш · славословїе · троⷪ҇ ·
units.english_cohort_translation: The feast of the Law being at the midst, O Creator and Master of all, Thou didst say unto them that were present, O Christ God: Come and draw the water of immortality! Therefore do we fall down before Thee and cry aloud in faith: Grant unto us Thy compassions, for Thou art the Fountain of our life![^767]

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: и хва празнуем же о слепци
units.slavonic_diplomatic: и҆ хва · Празнꙋем же ѡ слѣпци · г҃ · дни · в п҃не в въто · в сереⷣ · В въто ѕ҃ нели · в еры не стислови · стры ѡ слѣпоⷨ на ѕ҃ · сла҃ і҆ н҃ · кто възгл҃еть , на стїх · стры · г҃ ьскыꙗ г҃ ла є҃ ·
units.english_cohort_translation: *On Tuesday of the 6th Week [Eve of the Apodosis of Pascha]:*[^792] *At Vespers we do not chant the Kathisma; Stichera of the Blind Man on 6; Glory, Both now:* "Who can tell..."; *at the Aposticha: Resurrectional stichera of Tone 5; and of Pascha: "Pascha the sacred..." with their verses;*[^793] *Glory:* "Pascha the lovely"; *Both now:* "The Day of Resurrection"; *Troparion, Tone 5:* "Word co-beginningless...";[^794] *and the office of the Saint of the day is chanted at Compline.*

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: сла пасха краснаа и ны
units.slavonic_diplomatic: сла҃ · пасха краснаа · і҆ ны · въскренїа днь тро · съ безнално · с҃тгоже · и҆ же вдн҃и · въ- слѣванїе поетьсѧ напавечерници · въ серⷣ ѕ н҃е , на ꙋ҃р , тро҃ · съ безналное слово · в҃ · сла҃ і҆ ны б҃о · ѡбыч , стїхсловие · сѣⷣ въскрⷵны въскренїе хв҃о · ѱл҃ѡ н҃ · кано҃ гл҃а а҃ · въ- скренїа днь · съ і҆ермⷵо на ѕ҃ · и҆ ѡ слѣпци · на д҃ · препразенствоу · гл҃ е҃ · на д҃ , катава҃ сп҃сителю б҃ꙋ · по · г҃ пѣ ѵпакои · прѣвари- ша оутро · по ѕ҃ коⷩ҇ · а҆ще и҆ въ гробъ сниде ·
units.english_cohort_translation: *On Wednesday of the 6th Week [Apodosis of Pascha], at Matins: Troparion:* "Word co-beginningless", *twice; Glory... ...Both now, Dogmatikon Theotokion; customary stichology [Kathismata]; Resurrectional Sessional hymns; "Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ"; Psalm 50; Canon, Tone 1: "The Day of Resurrection" with the heirmos on 6, and of the Blind Man on 4, and of the Forefeast [of Ascension], Tone 5 on 4; Katavasia:* "Unto God our Savior"; *after Ode 3: Hypakoe:* "Anticipating the morning..."; *after Ode 6: Kontakion:* "Though Thou didst descend into the tomb"; *Exapostilarion: "Having fallen asleep in the flesh".*[^795]

[Ps. 46:2]

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: егда съшед ыкы ра меси ра деляше племена вышнии
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Е҆гда съшедъ ꙗ҆ꙁыкы раꙁмѣси · раꙁдѣлѧше племена вышнии · є҆гда ѻ҆гнныꙗ ꙗ҆ꙁыкы раꙁдаꙗ · въ совъкꙋпленїе всѧ приꙁва · є҆ди ногласно славити въсес҃тыи дх҃ъ : ~ чⷵтнѣишоу не стїхословимъ · свѣ ·
units.english_cohort_translation: When the Most High descended and confused the tongues, He divided the nations; but when He distributed the tongues of fire, He called all to unity: therefore with one voice we glorify the all-holy Spirit![^823]

units.slavonic_incipit: ꙗ҆ко варилъ еси є҆го бл҃венїемь бл҃гостынны
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: ко варил еси его блвением блгостынны положил еси
units.slavonic_diplomatic: ꙗ҆ко варилъ еси є҆го бл҃венїемь бл҃гостынны положилъ еси на главѣ є҆го вѣнець ѿ каме не чⷵтнаго · бл҃венъ еси хє҃ бж҃е нашъ въхоⷣ въꙁнесисѧ г҃и силою твоею · поемь и҆ въспо емь силы твоꙗ · та бл҃гвенъ еси хє҃ бє҃ нашъ сл҃ і҆ н҃ · к҃ ѡ҃ · в҃ꙁ тр҃таго мѣсто · є҆лици въ хрⷵ про въ всю ꙁемлю · с҃ нб҃са повѣдаю а҆пл҃ъ г҃ · а҆ллна · словесемь гн҃имь · с҃ · с нб҃се приꙁрѣ · е҆ѵлне ѿ їѡа҃н · въ послѣⷣнїи дн҃ь ·
units.english_cohort_translation: *Then Troparion:* "Blessed art Thou, O Christ our God..."; *Glory, Both now, Kontakion.*
units.slavonic_text: ꙗ҆ко варилъ еси є҆го бл҃венїемь бл҃гостынны положилъ еси на главѣ є҆го вѣнець ѿ каме не чⷵтнаго · бл҃венъ еси хє҃ бж҃е нашъ въхоⷣ въꙁнесисѧ г҃и силою твоею · поемь и҆ въспо емь силы твоꙗ · та бл҃гвенъ еси хє҃ бє҃ нашъ сл҃ і҆ н҃ · к҃ ѡ҃ · в҃ꙁ тр҃таго мѣсто · є҆лици въ хрⷵ про въ всю ꙁемлю · с҃ нб҃са повѣдаю а҆пл҃ъ г҃ · а҆ллна · словесемь гн҃имь · с҃ · с нб҃се приꙁрѣ · е҆ѵлне ѿ їѡа҃н · въ послѣⷣнїи дн҃ь ·

не чⷵтнаго · бл҃венъ еси хє҃ бж҃е нашъ въхоⷣ
въꙁнесисѧ г҃и силою твоею · поемь и҆ въспо
емь силы твоꙗ · та бл҃гвенъ еси хє҃ бє҃ нашъ
сл҃ і҆ н҃ · к҃ ѡ҃ · в҃ꙁ тр҃таго мѣсто · є҆лици въ хрⷵ
про въ всю ꙁемлю · с҃ нб҃са повѣдаю а҆пл҃ъ
г҃ · а҆ллна · словесемь гн҃имь · с҃ · с нб҃се

units.english_cohort_translation: *On Friday in the evening [Eve of the Apodosis of Pentecost]:*[^835] *Stichera of the feast, Tone 1:* "Pentecost [let us celebrate]...", *on 6; Glory, Both now, Tone 8:* "Come, ye peoples [let us worship the three-hypostatic Godhead]..."; *at the Aposticha: of the feast:* "And understanding [the power of the cross]...", *Glory, Both now, Tone 8:* "Of old the tongues [were confounded]..."; *Troparion of the feast; and during the day at Compline: [the office of the day].*

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: гла и приидете людие на сти
units.slavonic_diplomatic: гла҃ и҃ · прїидѣте людие · на стї · праꙁн и҆ є҆раꙁоумѣюще · сл҃ · і҆ н҃ · гл҃ и҃ · ꙗ҆ꙁыци и҆ ногда · тро҃ праꙁ · в дн҃и же · на павечерни ци · в сꙋ҃ · на ꙋ҃трн · тро҃ праꙁ · г҃ · и҆ ѡ҃бычны е стїхо҃ · сѣⷣ праꙁ · канонї · два · праꙁн е҆динъ · с ъі҆рмосомь на ѕ҃ · катавасїа бж҃е ственои длъ · по г҃ · пѣⷵни сѣⷣ праꙁ · и҆ по ѕ҃ ко҃ и҆ и҆ко҃ · чⷵтнѣишоую не стїхословꙋ е · свѣ҃ праꙁ · на хвалї · на д҃ · прѣславнаꙗ дн҃ь · сл҃ і҆ н҃ · гл҃ ѕ҃ · ц҃рю нб҃ныи · славо словїе · тро҃ праꙁ · на лїꙋргїи · ѿ кано҃ ѡ҆бѣ пѣсни θ҃ · и҆ · с ъі҆рмо҃ · на и҃ · въхо҃ ·
units.english_cohort_translation: *At Matins: Troparion of the feast, thrice; the customary stichology [Kathismata]; Sessional hymns of the feast; Canons two: of the feast one, with the heirmos on 6; Katavasia:* "Covered by the divine darkness..." [Ode 1, Canon 2];[^837] *after Ode 3: Sessional hymn of the feast; and after Ode 6: Kontakion and Ikos.* "More honorable than the Cherubim" *is not stichologized;*[^838] *Exapostilarion of the feast. At the Praises: on 4:* "A marvel today..."; *Glory, Both now, Tone 6:* "O Heavenly King..."; *Great Doxology; Troparion of the feast.*

[Ode 1, Canon 2];[^837] *after Ode 3: Sessional hymn of the feast; and after Ode 6: Kontakion and Ikos.* "More honorable than the Cherubim" *is not stichologized;*[^838] *Exapostilarion of the feast. At the Praises: on 4:* "A marvel today..."; *Glory, Both now, Tone 6:* "O Heavenly King..."; *Great Doxology; Troparion of the feast.*

units.verbatim_book_heading: SYNAXARION OF THE TRIODION AND PENTECOSTARION :: At the Liturgy: The Beatitudes in the Octoechos on 6, and of the Saints Ode 6 on 4
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *Which rule is indicated according to the testament of the Holy Apostles, in which we are obligated strictly to fast. On the Monday after the commemoration of All Saints we begin it. If there is not a feast-day Saint, we chant "Alleluia" in the tone [of the Octoechos], and the Trinity Hymns, making prostrations according to the order of the Holy Forty Days [Great Lent];*[^851] *and at Matins we stichologize two Kathismata, and at Vespers the third; thus do we perform even unto the Exaltation of the Precious Cross. The Sessional hymns of the tone are recited after the Trinity Hymns.*

units.verbatim_book_heading: SYNAXARION OF THE TRIODION AND PENTECOSTARION :: At the Liturgy: The Beatitudes in the Octoechos on 6, and of the Saints Ode 6 on 4
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *It is proper to know with certainty that in these fasting days, whenever "Alleluia" occurs on Wednesday or on Friday, we make prostrations, and eat once a day; likewise also on Monday we fast until the ninth hour, and eat after Vespers.*[^852] *When "God is the Lord" [is chanted], on whichever day: on Tuesday, on Thursday, on Saturday, and on Sunday, we eat twice a day; moreover, all at the discretion of the superior; and what worldly inhabitants and benefactors... ...do in their own days according to their custom; but we, as on a fasting day: Even if among the Greeks on Monday, on Wednesday, and on Friday they eat twice a day,*[^853] *this rather the superior discerns and alters. When "God is the Lord" is on Wednesday, it is chanted in the evening, and on Monday likewise; thus also a feast day, likewise when "Alleluia" is in the daytime, by eating twice it is altered into a fasting day; thus every day is intertwined according to the order.*

*It is proper to know with certainty that in these fasting days, whenever "Alleluia" occurs on Wednesday or on Friday, we make prostrations, and eat once a day; likewise also on Monday we fast until the ninth hour, and eat after Vespers.*[^852] *When "God is the Lord" [is chanted], on whichever day: on Tuesday, on Thursday, on Saturday, and on Sunday, we eat twice a day; moreover, all at the discretion of the superior; and what worldly inhabitants and benefactors...*

=== LEAF p525 ===
*...do in their own days according to their custom; but we, as on a fasting day: Even if among the Greeks on Monday, on Wednesday, and on Friday they eat twice a day,*[^853] *this rather the superior discerns and alters. When "God is the Lord" is on Wednesday, it is chanted in the evening, and on Monday likewise; thus also a feast day, likewise when "Alleluia" is in the daytime, by eating twice it is altered into a fasting day; thus every day is intertwined according to the order.*

units.english_cohort_translation: *The Hours, when "Alleluia" is [chanted], are chanted thus:*[^855] *At the end of the 2nd hour, having gathered in the narthex, we chant the 3rd Hour: 3 Psalms; at "Glory": 3 prostrations; then:* "O Lord, Who didst send down Thy Most Holy Spirit at the third hour upon Thine Apostles, take Him not from us, O Good One, but renew Him within us who pray unto Thee", *recited simply without singing, with its verses; Glory, Both now:* "Blessed is the Lord God..."; *and Trisagion; and the customary troparia, and the prayer, and 15 prostrations.*

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *And following the Inter-Hours, then the 3rd, and 6th, and 9th; after this the Beatitudes are said; Epistle and Gospel of the day; and the rest of the service, and Dismissal.*[^856] *Having remained quiet for a little while in the cells, and the time having arrived, he strikes the great semantron; and having gathered into church, we chant Vespers: after the Kathisma, "Lord, I have cried" in the tone of the day; we chant stichera on 6; Glory, Both now, Theotokion; and if there is an idiomelon, it is chanted at Glory; Troparion of the Saint or of the day, and Theotokion, and Dismissal.*

units.english_cohort_translation: *In the morning at "God is the Lord" we chant the Troparion of the Saint and of that day; if he hath none, we recite a podoben unto him; and Kathismata 2; and Sessional hymns in the Octoechos; after Ode 3: Sessional hymn of the day; and after Ode 6: Martyrikon in the Octoechos and Kontakion; Canons 2 in the Octoechos, and of the day, making 14 troparia in all; and Reading 1 of the Praises; and stichera are not chanted, but after "Glory to God in the highest" [Doxology], at the Aposticha in the Octoechos, and we recite the verses; and* "We have been filled [in the morning with Thy mercy]" [Ps. 89:14], *and* "And let the brightness of the Lord our God be upon us" [Ps. 89:17]; *Trisagion; Glory, Both now, Kontakion... ...and the First Hour according to custom. units.slavonic_diplomatic: въ пн҃е бесплъ · въ в҃ то прⷵтчн · в ср҃е прⷵтѣи бц҃и · в четстыи а҆пл҃омь · в пѧ чт҃номоу кр҃тоу по ѡ҃поустѣ же ли҃ргїа · а҆ще бж҃де ꙗ҆сти в того дне · и҆ходно къ трапеꙁоу · и҆ ꙗ҆дмы чьто б҃ъ дарова · а҆ще е҆ по҃ и҆ поклоны · даеть на раꙁдробление їєрен · и҆ параклисїархь во доу теплоу · по ѡ҃поустѣ литоргиа посѣ дидлы мало · до потребленїа стыхь · и҆ по томь с ѡ҃ходндь в келиа своꙗ · моуколчи до времени · θ҃ · го часа · приспѣвшꙋ же вре мени є҆го · ѡ҃ударѧеть в малое древо · и҆ собра вшесѧ въ цр҃ковь · поє часы и҆ со прочидлы въ слѣдованїе того ча · и҆ споклоны е҃і · по се клеплє в великоє древо · и҆ поє в҃ерню · ка҃ р҃а
units.english_cohort_translation: *After the Dismissal of the Liturgy, if there is eating on that day, we go out unto the refectory, and eat whatever God hath granted. If there is a fast and prostrations, he gives a portion [antidoron] to the priest, and the paraklesiarches [gives] warm water.*[^860] *After the Dismissal of the Liturgy, having sat a little while, until the consumption of the Holy Gifts; and thereafter each departs unto his own cell, remaining silent until the time of the ninth hour. And the time having arrived... ...of it, he strikes the small semantron; and having gathered into church, we chant the [Ninth] Hour with the rest of the order of that hour, and with 15 prostrations.*[^861] *After this he strikes the great semantron, and we chant Vespers: Kathisma 18; stichera; and in place of the prokeimenon: "Alleluia" in Tone 6; if it is not "God is the Lord", at the Aposticha in the Octoechos; Troparia:* "Theotokos Virgin, rejoice..." *simply, and the rest; and Dismissal.*

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *...me, and [forgive] one another; and each departs unto his own cell in silence.*[^862] *This rule takes place on all fasting days, whenever "Alleluia" is [chanted]. But when it is "God is the Lord", prostrations are not made in the church; and of eating there is no distinction: on Tuesday and on Thursday if the superior wills, not only oil do we eat, but also fish; only let the superior observe strictly: even if it is not "God is the Lord", on Tuesday and on Thursday fish is not permitted to eat.*[^863]

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: стани в помощ мне и сежни ороу
units.slavonic_diplomatic: стани въ помощъ мнѣ · и҆ сєжни ѡ҃роу жїе ꙁакри прѣдъ гонѧщїимѧ · ꙁнаменасѧ на насъ свѣтъ лица твоего · г҃и далъ еси ꙁнаменїе бо ꙗ҆щїимсѧ тебе · въꙁшелъ еси на высотоу и҆ плѣ нили еси плѣнь · далъ еси наслѣдїе боꙗщїи сѧ тебе г҃и · да ꙁнаена ꙁемли пꙋть твои · въ всѣхъ ꙗ҆ꙁыцѣх сп҃сенїе твое · видѣша вси конци ꙁемлѧ сп҃сенїе б҃а нашего · и҆ поклонатсѧ на мѣ стѣ идеже стоꙗстѣ нозѣ его. И тогда възрадуютсѧ древеса дубравнаꙗ. Б̃ъ нашь цр̃ь прежде вѣкъ. съдѣла сп̃сение посредѣ землѧ. възнесесѧ въ ꙗзыцѣхъ. възнесенъ на земли. въспоите г̃а б̃а нашего. и кланѧитесѧ подножию ногоу его, ꙗко ст̃ь е̃. възнесесѧ на нб̃са б̃е. и по всеи земли слава твоꙗ. възнесоу тѧ г̃и б̃е мои. сп̃си г̃и люди своꙗ, и бл̃ви достоꙗние свое. оупаси ꙗ и въз̾ими ꙗ до вѣка: ~
units.english_cohort_translation: And they shall worship at the place where His feet stood! [Ps. 131:7b][^870]

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: аплом нбса исповедают славоу бжию творение же
units.slavonic_diplomatic: а̃пл̃ѡмъ: ~ Нб̃са исповѣдають славоу бж҃ію. творение же роукꙋ его възвѣщаеть твръдь. исповѣдѧть нб̃са чюдеса твоꙗ г̃и. въ о̃ц̃ь мѣсто быша сн̃ве твои. поставиши кнѧѕѧ по всеи земли. б̃ъ бг҃ѡвъ г̃ь приз̾ва землю. ѡсвѣтиша млънии его въселенꙋю. възвѣстѧть нб̃са правдоу его. въцр̃итсѧ б̃ъ над ꙗзыкы. б̃ъ прославлѣаꙗ въ ст̃ыхь его. дивна соудбы бысть. рцѣ... ...те въ ꙗзыцѣхъ ꙗко г̃ь въцр̃исѧ. ибо исправлена е̃ ꙗко же не подвижитсѧ. въсѧ землѧ вѣщаніа и въ конець въселеныꙗ гл̃и ихъ. д̃а на ны страны ꙗзыкы. трꙋд люди наслѣдиша. покориша ꙗзыкы под ногы наша. из̾бра г̃ь достоꙗние себѣ. велеи г̃ь нашь и велиꙗ крѣпость его. разоумоу нѣсть числа. въда силу и дръжавоу людемъ: ~
units.english_cohort_translation: Say among the nations that the Lord reigns! For He hath established the world, so that it shall not be moved! [Ps. 95:10][^878]

But when it is "God is the Lord", prostrations are not made in the church; and of eating there is no distinction: on Tuesday and on Thursday if the superior wills, not only oil do we eat, but also fish; only let the superior observe strictly: even if it is not "God is the Lord", on Tuesday and on Thursday fish is not permitted to eat.*[^863]

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: мчнком б нам прибежище и сила помошник
units.slavonic_diplomatic: мч̃нкомъ: ~ Б̃ъ намь прибѣжище и сила. помошникъ въ скорбех ѡбрѣтших ны ѕѣло. сего ради не оубоимсѧ егда съмоущаетсѧ землѧ. б̃е кто подобитсѧ тебѣ. не прѣмллчи ни оукроти б̃е. ꙗко се врази твои възшоумѣша. ненавидѧщеи тебе въздвигоша главоу. на люди твоꙗ лоукавноваша волею. и свѣщаша волею на свѧтыꙗ твоꙗ. ижерѣша придѣте потрѣбимь ꙗ ѡ ꙗзыкъ. положиша троупиꙗ ра... ...бъ твоихъ. брашно птицамъ нб̃ныимъ. п̃л̃ть прьп̃бныхъ твои. звѣремъ з̃лнымъ. пролиꙗша кровь ихъ ꙗко водоу. въмѣнихомсѧ ꙗко ѡвча на заколение. вънегда скръшахоусѧ кости моꙗ и поношаахꙋ ми врази мои. быхь в день весь дн̃ь къ болѣзни ꙗзвы мои приложиша днѣ. ꙗко искоусил ны еси б̃е. ражде ны ꙗкоже ражжаетсѧ сребро. проидохомь сквозѣ ѡгнь и водоу. изведе ны въ покои твои. въззваша праведнии и г̃ь слыша ихъ. ѡ всѣхъ искръбии ихъ сп̃се ть. многы скорби праведны. ѡ въсехъ избавить ꙗ г̃ь. възвеселитсѧ праведникъ ѡ г̃ѣ. исповѣдаите памѧть ст̃ынꙗ его. радоуитесѧ праведнии ѡ г̃ѣ. праведныимь подобаеть похвала въ памѧть вѣчноу боудеть праведникъ. ѡ слоуха зла не оубоитсѧ. ст̃ымь же сꙋть на земли его. оудиви г̃ь всѧ хотениꙗ своꙗ...
units.english_cohort_translation: They have laid the dead bodies of Thy servants to be food for the birds of heaven, the flesh of Thy holy ones for the wild beasts of the earth! [Ps. 78:2][^884]

units.verbatim_book_heading: SELECTED PSALMS FOR SOLEMN COMMEMORATIONS AND FEASTS OF THE LORD :: At the Liturgy: The Beatitudes in the Octoechos on 6, and of the Saints Ode 6 on 4
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *...me, and [forgive] one another; and each departs unto his own cell in silence.*[^862] *This rule takes place on all fasting days, whenever "Alleluia" is [chanted]. But when it is "God is the Lord", prostrations are not made in the church; and of eating there is no distinction: on Tuesday and on Thursday if the superior wills, not only oil do we eat, but also fish; only let the superior observe strictly: even if it is not "God is the Lord", on Tuesday and on Thursday fish is not permitted to eat.*[^863]

But when it is "God is the Lord", prostrations are not made in the church; and of eating there is no distinction: on Tuesday and on Thursday if the superior wills, not only oil do we eat, but also fish; only let the superior observe strictly: even if it is not "God is the Lord", on Tuesday and on Thursday fish is not permitted to eat.*[^863]

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: стителем оуслышите сиа въси зыци въноушите въси
units.slavonic_diplomatic: ст̃ителемь: ~ Оуслышите сіа въси ꙗзыци. въноушите въси живоущеи по въселенѣи. и̃ земнии и сн̃ве чл̃чьстии въкоупѣ богаты и оубогъ. оуста моꙗ възгл̃ють прѣмоудро поꙋчение ср̃дца моего разоумь. приидѣте чада полоушаите мене. страхоу г̃ню наоучю вы. бл̃говѣстихь правдоу твою въ цр̃кви велицѣ правды твоеꙗ не съкрыхъ въ ср̃ц̃и моемь. истиноу твою. сп̃сение реко̃. непотаихь мл̃ти твоеꙗ ѡ̃ сонма многа. исповѣдемѧ тебѣ въ цр̃кви велицѣ. ꙗзыкь мои пооучитсѧ правдѣ твоей. да исплънѧтсѧ оуста моꙗ похвалы. ꙗко да въспоемь славоу твою. г̃и възлюбихь бл̃голѣ... ...пие домоу твоего. не сѣдохь съ сонмомь соуетныи. съ законопрестꙋпныими не вънидꙋ. ирѣхь законопрѣстоупнико̃ не пристꙋпаите закона. възненавидѣхъ цр̃квь лоукавны съ нечестивыими не сѧдꙋ. и ѡбидоу и попожроу въ цр̃кви н̃его жертвой хвалениꙗ. а̃з же ꙗко маслина плодовита. оуповахъ на мл̃ть бж҃ию велика е̃. ꙗко съхранихъ пꙋти г̃ни и не нечьствова ѡ̃ б̃а моего. ꙗко въсѧ сꙋжьбы его прѣд мною. ѡправданіа его не ѡ̃стоупиша ѡ̃ мене. оуста правднаго пооучатсѧ премудрости. и ꙗзыкь его възг̃леть сꙋ̃. въ памѧть вѣчную бꙋдеть праведникь. ѡ̃ слоуха зла не оубоитсѧ. весь дн̃ь милоуеть его и къ заемь даеть праведныи. и сѣмѧ въ бл̃гвлении е̃. праведникь ꙗко фѵникь процвитеть, ꙗко кедръ иже въ ливанѣ оумножитсѧ. ꙗко ты бл̃виши праведника г̃и. възвеселитсѧ...
units.english_cohort_translation: Lord, I have loved the beauty of Thine house! [Ps. 25:8a][^892]

units.verbatim_book_heading: SELECTED PSALMS FOR SOLEMN COMMEMORATIONS AND FEASTS OF THE LORD :: At the Liturgy: The Beatitudes in the Octoechos on 6, and of the Saints Ode 6 on 4
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *...me, and [forgive] one another; and each departs unto his own cell in silence.*[^862] *This rule takes place on all fasting days, whenever "Alleluia" is [chanted]. But when it is "God is the Lord", prostrations are not made in the church; and of eating there is no distinction: on Tuesday and on Thursday if the superior wills, not only oil do we eat, but also fish; only let the superior observe strictly: even if it is not "God is the Lord", on Tuesday and on Thursday fish is not permitted to eat.*[^863]

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *...me, and [forgive] one another; and each departs unto his own cell in silence.*[^862] *This rule takes place on all fasting days, whenever "Alleluia" is [chanted]. But when it is "God is the Lord", prostrations are not made in the church; and of eating there is no distinction: on Tuesday and on Thursday if the superior wills, not only oil do we eat, but also fish; only let the superior observe strictly: even if it is not "God is the Lord", on Tuesday and on Thursday fish is not permitted to eat.*[^863]

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: прпбны тръпя потрепех га вънят ми постави
units.slavonic_diplomatic: прп̃бны: ~ Тръпѧ потрѣпѣхъ г̃а вънѧт ми. постави на камени ноѕѣ мои. и̃справи стопы моꙗ оуподобихсѧ неꙗсыти поустыннѣи. быхь ꙗко нощныи врань на нырищи. забвень быхъ, ꙗко птица ѡсобащисѧ на гнѣздѣ. быша слъзы моꙗ мнѣ хлѣбъ дн̃ь и нощь. съмѣри постом̃ дш̃ю мою. и колѣнѣ мои изнемогостѣ ѡ̃ поста. и питие мое съ плачемъ растворахъ. оутроудихсѧ въъздыханиемъ моимъ. измыю на въсакоую нощь ложе мое. ѡ гласа въздыханиꙗ моего прилпе плътъ моꙗ кости моей. чаꙗхъ бога спасающаго мѧ. ѡ̃ припелаганна доуша. за словеса оустенъ твоихъ. а̃зъ же съхранихъ поути жестокыꙗ... ...въжада тебе дш̃а моꙗ. и̃ колиножицею процвите плътъ моꙗ въ земли поустѣи. а̃з же вънегда ѡни стоужахоу ми, ѡ̃блачахоу мѧ въ врѣтище, и съсмѣрѧхъ постомъ дш̃оу мою. прѣзрѣхъ г̃а выноу. ꙗко ѡ̃десноую мене е̃ да сѧ не постыждꙋ. бы оутвръжение мое къзведе мѧ на широтоу. въси ꙗзыци ѡ̃быдоша мѧ. именемъ г̃нимь противлѧхсѧ имъ. бл̃венъ г̃ь иже не дасть насъ въ ловитвоу зоубомъ ихъ ѡ̃стоупиша ѡ̃ мене въси дѣлающеи беззаконие. съхранить г̃ь д̃ша прп̃бныхъ его. и въсхвалѧтсѧ прп̃бнии въ славѣ, възрадуютсѧ на ложехь своихъ чт̃на прѣ г̃мь см̃ерть прп̃бныи его. исповѣдаите памѧть его: ~
units.english_cohort_translation: My soul has thirsted for Thee: how manifoldly hath my flesh longed for Thee in a barren land! [Ps. 62:2b][^902]

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: арханглом и канло хвалите га с нбс
units.slavonic_diplomatic: арханг̃л̃ѡм и ка̃нл̃ѡ: ~ Хвалите г̃а съ нб̃съ. хвалите его оувышнихь его. хвалите его въси а̃г̃ли его. хвалите его въсѧ силы его... ...хвалите его въсѧ звѣзды и свѣть. ꙗко тъ̃ рече и быша. и̃ тъ̃ повелѣ и създашасѧ. бл̃ви дш̃е моꙗ г̃а. и̃ въсѧ въноутринѣꙗ моꙗ имѧ ст̃ое его. бл̃вите г̃а а̃г̃ли силніи крѣпостию его. творащен слово его. оуслышати гла̃словесь его. бл̃вите г̃а въсѧ слоугы его творащен во́лю его. твора а̃г̃лы своꙗ д̃хы. слоугы своꙗ ѡгнь палащь. възыде на хероувимы. лета и на крылꙋ вѣтрьнею. сѣдѧи на хероувимѣхъ ꙗви. исповѣдаꙗтѣ въсѣмь ср̃цем мои. прѣ а̃г̃лы въспою тебѣ поклонитесѧ емꙋ въси а̃г̃ли его б̃ъ сѣдить на пр̃т̃лѣ свое̃. г̃ь къ цр̃кви ст̃ѣи своеи г̃ь на нб̃си пр̃т̃лъ его. цр̃тво его въсѣми обладаеть. поите б̃оу въспоите имени его. възыде на нб̃о нб̃сное на въстокы ѡплъчитсѧ а̃г̃лъ г̃нь ѡкр̃ть боꙗщиисѧ его и избавит их. ꙗко а̃г̃лом своим̃ заповѣсть ѡ̃ тебѣ, съхранити тѧ въ всѣхъ поутѣх тво... [Кустод: их]

Хвалите г̃а съ нб̃съ. хвалите его оувышнихь его. хвалите его въси а̃г̃ли его. хвалите его въсѧ силы его...

...хвалите его въсѧ звѣзды и свѣть. ꙗко тъ̃ рече и быша. и̃ тъ̃ повелѣ и създашасѧ. бл̃ви дш̃е моꙗ г̃а. и̃ въсѧ въноутринѣꙗ моꙗ имѧ ст̃ое его. бл̃вите г̃а а̃г̃ли силніи крѣпостию его. творащен слово его. оуслышати гла̃словесь его. бл̃вите г̃а въсѧ слоугы его творащен во́лю его. твора а̃г̃лы своꙗ д̃хы. слоугы своꙗ ѡгнь палащь. възыде на хероувимы. лета и на крылꙋ вѣтрьнею. сѣдѧи на хероувимѣхъ ꙗви. исповѣдаꙗтѣ въсѣмь ср̃цем мои. прѣ а̃г̃лы въспою тебѣ поклонитесѧ емꙋ въси а̃г̃ли его б̃ъ сѣдить на пр̃т̃лѣ свое̃. г̃ь къ цр̃кви ст̃ѣи своеи г̃ь на нб̃си пр̃т̃лъ его. цр̃тво его въсѣми обладаеть. поите б̃оу въспоите имени его. възыде на нб̃о нб̃сное на въстокы ѡплъчитсѧ а̃г̃лъ г̃нь ѡкр̃ть боꙗщиисѧ его и избавит их. ꙗко а̃г̃лом своим̃ заповѣсть ѡ̃ тебѣ, съхранити тѧ въ всѣхъ поутѣх тво... [Кустод: их]

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *...me, and [forgive] one another; and each departs unto his own cell in silence.*[^862] *This rule takes place on all fasting days, whenever "Alleluia" is [chanted]. units.verbatim_section_rubric: *...me, and [forgive] one another; and each departs unto his own cell in silence.*[^862] *This rule takes place on all fasting days, whenever "Alleluia" is [chanted]. But when it is "God is the Lord", prostrations are not made in the church; and of eating there is no distinction: on Tuesday and on Thursday if the superior wills, not only oil do we eat, but also fish; only let the superior observe strictly: even if it is not "God is the Lord", on Tuesday and on Thursday fish is not permitted to eat.*[^863]

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: въведению велии г хвален зело в граде
units.slavonic_diplomatic: въведению: ~ Веліи г̃ь хваленъ ѕѣло. въ градѣ б̃а нашег̃о въ горѣ ст̃ѣи него. бл̃гокоренныи радованіе въсеꙗ землѧ. преславнаа г̃лашасѧ ѡ̃ тебе граде бж҃іи. б̃ъ въ тѧжесте̃ его знае̃ е̃,... ...е̃гда застꙋпление. ꙗкоже слышах̃о тако и видѣх̃о. къ градѣ г̃а силъ въ градѣ б̃а нашего г̃ь ѡсновавы и въ вѣкы. ѡ̃стиль е̃ село свое вышнии. г̃ь посредѣ его не подвижитсѧ. ст̃ыни н̃его велелѣпота въ ст̃лѣ его. сїꙗ врата г̃нꙗ правенникъ внидꙋть въ нꙗ. по имени твоемоу б̃е тако хвала твоꙗ въ концихь земли, ст̃аа цркы твоꙗ дивна въ правдоу, домоу твоемоу подобаеть ст̃ынни въ долготоу днии. дщери цр̃евы въ чти твоеи. прѣста цр̃ца ѡ̃ десноую тебе. въ ризахъ позлащеннахъ и прѣи̃спрьщренна е̃ дина прѣоукрашена. слыши дщи и виждь приклони оухо твое. забоуди люди твоꙗ, и̃ домъ ѡ̃ца твоего въжделѣ. въжделѣеть царь добротѣ твоеи. лицю твоемоу помолѧтьсѧ богатии людие. въсѧ слава дъщери цр̃евѣ, въноутерь оудоу.

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *...me, and [forgive] one another; and each departs unto his own cell in silence.*[^862] *This rule takes place on all fasting days, whenever "Alleluia" is [chanted]. But when it is "God is the Lord", prostrations are not made in the church; and of eating there is no distinction: on Tuesday and on Thursday if the superior wills, not only oil do we eat, but also fish; only let the superior observe strictly: even if it is not "God is the Lord", on Tuesday and on Thursday fish is not permitted to eat.*[^863]

units.slavonic_incipit: рѧсны златы. е̃дина прѣоукрашена. при ведоутсѧ
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: рясны златы едина преоукрашена при ведоутся црю двы
units.slavonic_diplomatic: рѧсны златы. е̃дина прѣоукрашена. при ведоутсѧ цр̃ю д̃вы въ слѣдъ еꙗ. ближь нꙗꙗ приведеноутсѧ по тебѣ, приведеноутсѧ въ веселии радости, приведꙋтсѧ въ цр̃ь ковь цр̃евоу. приꙗхомь бж̃е мл̃ть твою посрѣдѣ людии. помѣноу имѧ твоé б̃ъ въ сѣкомь ро́дѣ и̃ родѣ. сего ради людие твои и̃сповѣдѧтсѧ тобѣ въ вѣкы, и̃ въ вѣкъ вѣкоу: ~ рождествоу христовоу: ~ Въскликнѣте б̃оу въсѧ землѧ поите имени éго. дадите славоу хвалѣ éго. въ звеселатсѧ нб̃са и̃ радоуеть сѧ землѧ, и̃сповѣданне и̃ велелѣпота дѣ лѣ éго. мл̃тивъ г̃ь и̃збавление посла лю демъ своимь, ст̃о и̃ страшно имѧ éго. кра сень добротою паче сн̃овъ чл̃чьскыхь. б̃ъ нашь на нб̃си и̃ на земли. въсѣ éлика въсхо тѣ сътвори. завѣщахь завѣтъ и̃зьбран нымъ моимь. клѧхсѧ дв̃дꙋ рабꙋ моéмоу до вѣка оуготовансѧ мл̃ть твое. съзиждꙋ въ вѣкы пр̃т̃лъ твои. ꙗко сл̃нце прѣд тобою.
units.english_cohort_translation: ...in golden borders, all adorned![^918] Virgins shall be brought unto the King after her: her companions shall be brought unto thee; they shall be brought with gladness and rejoicing, they shall be brought into the King's temple.[^919] We have thought of Thy mercy, O God, in the midst of Thy people.[^920] I will remember Thy name from generation unto generation: therefore shall the people praise Thee forever, even unto ages of ages.[^921]

units.slavonic_incipit: б̃ъ славы възгрьмѣ г̃ь на вѡ́дахь.
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: б славы възгрьме г на водах река божиа
units.slavonic_diplomatic: б̃ъ славы възгрьмѣ г̃ь на вѡ́дахь. рѣка божиа наплънисѧ водъ. г̃ь потопь насы лаеть г̃ь царь въ вѣкы сѣдасть глась свои глась силы дадите б̃оу. въздвигоша рѣкы г̃и. въздвигоша рѣкы, гласы своꙗ възмоутърѣкы строугы своꙗ, ѡ̃ гласа воды многъ. рѣкы въсплещѣте роу ками въпоупѣ. сего ради помѧноухь тѧ ѡ̃ землѧ éрмоньскыꙗ ѡ̃ горы малы лы. беꙁдна беꙁдноу призываеть въ гла сѣ хлебитъ твои́хъ. оупиетьсѧ ѡ̃ ѡби лиа домоу твоéго. и̃ потоко́мь пи ща твоéꙗ напоиши ꙗ. ꙗко оу тебе é ст̃ь и̃сточникъ живо́тоу въ свѣтѣ твоé оузримь свѣт твои, море видѣ въ побѣже éрдань възвратиси въспать. ѡ̃ лица б̃а ꙗковла ѡ̃бращьшаго каменние въ éзе ра вѡ́днаꙗ. просвѣти лице свое и̃ спаси мѧ. въдръжаль éси силою свое́ю море.

But when it is "God is the Lord", prostrations are not made in the church; and of eating there is no distinction: on Tuesday and on Thursday if the superior wills, not only oil do we eat, but also fish; only let the superior observe strictly: even if it is not "God is the Lord", on Tuesday and on Thursday fish is not permitted to eat.*[^863]

units.verbatim_book_heading: SELECTED PSALMS FOR SOLEMN COMMEMORATIONS AND FEASTS OF THE LORD :: At the Liturgy: The Beatitudes in the Octoechos on 6, and of the Saints Ode 6 on 4
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *...me, and [forgive] one another; and each departs unto his own cell in silence.*[^862] *This rule takes place on all fasting days, whenever "Alleluia" is [chanted]. But when it is "God is the Lord", prostrations are not made in the church; and of eating there is no distinction: on Tuesday and on Thursday if the superior wills, not only oil do we eat, but also fish; only let the superior observe strictly: even if it is not "God is the Lord", on Tuesday and on Thursday fish is not permitted to eat.*[^863]

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: оригну срце мое блго гла а дела мо
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Ѡригнꙋ ср̃це мое бл̃го гла̃ а̃ꙁъ дѣла моꙗ цр̃еви. ꙗзыкь мои трость книжника скорописца. краснѣиши добротою паче сн̃ъ чл̃чьскы̃. сего ради бл̃вилъ тѧ б̃ъ ко вѣ кы. прѣпоꙗшисѧ ѡ̃роужиемь своимь по бедрѣ своеи силне. красотою твоéю и̃ до бротою твоею напрѧзи лоукь свои спѣи цр̃твоуи. и̃стины ради кротости и̃ пра вды, наставитъ тѧ дивно десница твоꙗ.

But when it is "God is the Lord", prostrations are not made in the church; and of eating there is no distinction: on Tuesday and on Thursday if the superior wills, not only oil do we eat, but also fish; only let the superior observe strictly: even if it is not "God is the Lord", on Tuesday and on Thursday fish is not permitted to eat.*[^863]

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *...me, and [forgive] one another; and each departs unto his own cell in silence.*[^862] *This rule takes place on all fasting days, whenever "Alleluia" is [chanted]. units.slavonic_incipit: ѡ̃ рѣкы до конци въселеныꙗ. чьстноимꙋ
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: о рекы до конци въселены чьстноиму го пре
units.slavonic_diplomatic: ѡ̃ рѣкы до конци въселеныꙗ. чьстноимꙋ éго прѣ дними живъ бꙋдеть. и̃ даéмоу ѡ̃ ꙁлата а̃равитеска. молатсѧ ѡ̃ немь выноу весь д̃нь бл̃квить. бꙋдé и̃мѧ éго бл̃квено въ вѣ кы. преже сл̃нца прибываеть и̃мѧ éго. въ ꙁбл̃г̃ватсѧ ѡ̃ немь въсꙗ колѣна земнаа въси ꙗꙁыци оубл̃жать и̃. бл̃квено славы и̃мѧ éго въ вѣкы. и̃ сплънитсѧ славы éго. бꙋ деть бꙋдеть: ~ вънецвѣтною: ~ Г̃и б̃е нашь ꙗко чюдно и̃мѧ твое по въсеи земли. ꙗко въꙁѧтсѧ велелѣпота твоꙗ прѣбвышенб̃съ. и̃ꙁ оусть младе нець сꙋщиине съвръшиль éси хвалꙋ. врагы твои ради. раздроушиши врага и̃ местни ка. въ сиѡ́нѣ великь высокь é на въсѣми людми. ꙗвитсѧ б̃ъ бг̃лвь въ сиѡ́нѣ. ꙗко оу крѣпи верѣꙗ врат твои. бл̃квеныи ты оу те бѣ. ѡ̃бидѣте сиѡ́на и̃ ѡ̃биимѣте éго. въ ꙁвѣстите въ сиѡ́нѣ и̃мѧ г̃не. и̃ хвала éго во іер̃л̃имѣ. поите г̃ви живꙋщимь въ сїѡ́нѣ. къ

But when it is "God is the Lord", prostrations are not made in the church; and of eating there is no distinction: on Tuesday and on Thursday if the superior wills, not only oil do we eat, but also fish; only let the superior observe strictly: even if it is not "God is the Lord", on Tuesday and on Thursday fish is not permitted to eat.*[^863]

units.slavonic_incipit: възвѣстите въ ꙗꙁыцѣхь начинаниа éго ꙗко
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: възвестите в ыцех начинаниа го ко б въсе
units.slavonic_diplomatic: възвѣстите въ ꙗꙁыцѣхь начинаниа éго ꙗко б̃ъ въсеꙗ землѧ. поите éмꙋ раꙁꙋмно въцр̃итсѧ б̃ъ надь ꙗꙁыкы. въскликнѣте прѣдь цр̃емъ г̃мь. ꙗко б̃ъ сп̃сеть сиѡ́на. и̃ со ꙁиждꙋтсѧ людии оудеистіи. тебѣ подоба éть пѣніе б̃же въ сиѡ́нѣ, и̃ тебѣ въꙁдасть сѧ мл̃тва въ іер̃л̃имѣ. бл̃квенъ грѧдыи въ и̃ мѧ г̃не. б̃ъ г̃ь ꙗвисѧ на̃мы. ꙗко да въꙁвѣс тѧть хвалоу твою. къ вратѣхь дщери сї ѡ́новы, и̃сповѣдаитесѧ éмоу хвалите и̃ мѧ éго въ градѣ г̃а силъ. къ градѣ б̃га наше го. въ дворѣхь домоу г̃нꙗ. посрѣдѣ тебе и̃ер̃л̃име, въцр̃итсѧ б̃гъ въ вѣкы. б̃ъ тво и̃ сиѡ́не въ ро́дь и̃ ро́дь, и̃ хвала éго прѣ бываéть въ вѣкы: ~ въ нéл̃и антипасхи

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *...me, and [forgive] one another; and each departs unto his own cell in silence.*[^862] *This rule takes place on all fasting days, whenever "Alleluia" is [chanted]. But when it is "God is the Lord", prostrations are not made in the church; and of eating there is no distinction: on Tuesday and on Thursday if the superior wills, not only oil do we eat, but also fish; only let the superior observe strictly: even if it is not "God is the Lord", on Tuesday and on Thursday fish is not permitted to eat.*[^863]

units.slavonic_incipit: ꙗ̃же не подвижитсѧ. го́товъ прѣстолъ твои
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: же не подвижится готов престол твои о века
units.slavonic_diplomatic: ꙗ̃же не подвижитсѧ. го́товъ прѣстолъ твои ѡ̃ вѣка ты éси . кто въꙁг̃лть силы г̃нꙗ оуслышаны . сътворити въсꙗ хва лы, да рекоутъ и̃ꙁбавленни г̃мь . éго же и̃ꙁбра ѡ̃ роукы врагъ . да и̃сповѣдѧтсѧ г̃ви мл̃ти éго . чюдеса сн̃ѡмъ чл̃чъскомъ ꙗко насытилъ éси д̃шю тщю и̃ д̃шю алчю щихъ и̃сплъни бл̃гъ . въꙁваша къ б̃оу , вънегда въскръбити и̃мъ . и̃ꙁведе ꙗ и̃ꙁ стѣни и̃ сѣни съмѣртныꙗ . ꙗко съкроуши врата мѣдѣнаꙗ и̃ верѣꙗ желѣꙁныꙗ сло ми и̃ꙁбавилъ ны éси ѡ̃ пагоубы и̃хъ . ꙋ̃ꙁы и̃хъ проторже . . пожрѫтъ éмоу жрътвꙋ хвалоу . въꙁвѣстѧтъ дѣла éго въ ра дости . въꙁнесꙋтсѧ въ цр̃кви людстѣи на сѣдалищи старець въсхвалѧтсѧ , ꙗко оуслыша нищаꙗ г̃ь . пораꙁи врагы и̃ въспѧть . хвали іер̃л̃ме г̃а похвали б̃а сиѡ́не . ꙗко оукрѣпи верѣꙗ врать твои .
units.english_cohort_translation: The Lord reigns, He is clothed with majesty; the Lord is clothed with strength, wherewith He hath girded Himself: for He hath established the world, so that it cannot be moved; Thy throne is prepared Thy throne is prepared of old: Thou art from everlasting.[^1026]

units.slavonic_incipit: Да въскр̃неть б̃ъ и̃ раꙁидꙋтсѧ вси
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: да въскрнет б и ра идутся вси вра и го
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Да въскр̃неть б̃ъ и̃ раꙁидꙋтсѧ вси враꙁи éго бѣжать ѡ̃ лица éго ненавидащеі éго . да въсхвалить нб̃са и̃ землꙗ . си д̃нь сътво ри г̃ь въꙁрадꙋютсѧ и̃ въꙁвелимсѧ ѡ̃ не . въ скр̃ни г̃и б̃е мои да въꙁн̃етсѧ роука твоꙗ, не ꙁабоуди нищиіхъ своихъ доконца . г̃и б̃е мои въ вѣкы и̃сповѣдѧтисѧ: ~ въ в̃ꙁнесéнию: ~
units.english_cohort_translation: Let God arise, and let all His enemies be scattered and let them that hate Him flee from before His face![^1041]

units.slavonic_incipit: Вьси ꙗꙁыци въсплещите роуками, въ скликнѣте
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: вьси ыци въсплещите роуками в скликнете боу глас
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Вьси ꙗꙁыци въсплещите роуками, въ скликнѣте б̃оу гла̃съ радости . ꙗко б̃ъ вышнии страшень ц̃рь велии по въ сеи земли . покори люди намъ и̃ ꙗꙁыкы по дъ ногы на̃ . и̃ꙁбра намъ достоꙗніе свое . въꙁынде б̃ъ въ скликновению . г̃ь въ гл̃сѣ троубнѣ мь . въꙁсѣде на хероувимѣхъ летя . пола гаꙗ ѡ̃блакы на въсхожденіе свое . въ ꙁмѣте врата кнѧꙁи ваша и̃ въꙁмѣтеся вра та вѣчнаꙗ . въниде ц̃рь славы . г̃ь силъ то é̃ ц̃рь славѣ . поклоните̃ éмꙋ вси а̃гг̃ли é̃ . г̃ь сѣ ди на пр̃тлѣ ст̃ѣмь своемь г̃и на нб̃си мл̃ть твоꙗ . и̃ и̃ стинна твоꙗ до ѡ̃бла̃ . пр̃тлъ твои въ вѣкъ вѣка . готовъ пр̃тлъ твои ѡ̃селѣ до вѣка ты éси , въшелъ éси на высотꙋ плѣнилъ éси плѣнь . ꙗко въꙁѧтсѧ велелѣпота твоꙗ .
units.english_cohort_translation: Thy throne [O God, is unto ages of ages] of ages; Thy throne is prepared from of old: Thou art from everlasting.[^1059]

сеи земли . покори люди намъ и̃ ꙗꙁыкы по
дъ ногы на̃ . и̃ꙁбра намъ достоꙗніе свое . въꙁынде

мь . въꙁсѣде на хероувимѣхъ летя . пола
гаꙗ ѡ̃блакы на въсхожденіе свое . въ
ꙁмѣте врата кнѧꙁи ваша и̃ въꙁмѣтеся вра
та вѣчнаꙗ . въниде ц̃рь славы . г̃ь силъ то é̃
ц̃рь славѣ . поклоните̃ éмꙋ вси а̃гг̃ли é̃ . г̃ь сѣ
ди на пр̃тлѣ ст̃ѣмь своемь г̃и на нб̃си мл̃ть твоꙗ . и̃ и̃
стинна твоꙗ до ѡ̃бла̃ . пр̃тлъ твои въ вѣкъ

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *...me, and [forgive] one another; and each departs unto his own cell in silence.*[^862] *This rule takes place on all fasting days, whenever "Alleluia" is [chanted]. But when it is "God is the Lord", prostrations are not made in the church; and of eating there is no distinction: on Tuesday and on Thursday if the superior wills, not only oil do we eat, but also fish; only let the superior observe strictly: even if it is not "God is the Lord", on Tuesday and on Thursday fish is not permitted to eat.*[^863]

units.slavonic_diplomatic: превыше нб̃сь въꙁнесѧ въ ꙗ̃ꙁыцѣхъ . въ ꙁнесñи на земли . въꙁнесисѧ на нб̃са б̃е по всеи земли слава твоꙗ . въꙁнесисѧ силою сво ею . въспоем поем силы твоꙗ . цр̃твіа земнаꙗ поите б̃оу . въспоите въшедшомꙋ на н̃бо нб̃се на въстокы , въꙁносите г̃а б̃а нашего и̃ кланѧитесѧ въ горѣ ст̃ѣи éго . ꙗко ст̃ъ é̃ г̃ь б̃ъ нашь: ~ пентнкостнію: ~ Нб̃са и̃сповѣдають славꙋ б̃жію . твар же рꙋкꙋ éго въꙁвѣщаеть твердь , словесе мь г̃нимь нб̃са оутвръдиша . и̃ д̃хомь оу сть éго въсѧ силы éго , съ нб̃се приꙁрѣ г̃ь и̃ приниче съ высоты ст̃ыꙗ своеꙗ . ѡ̃гнь прѣ нимь преидеть . ѡ̃кр̃тъ éго бꙋрꙗ велика нꙋ глие въꙁгорѣша ѡ̃ него . приклони нб̃са сони деть ѡ̃ сїѡ́на бл̃голѣпота красота éго по мѧноутся и̃ ѡ̃братѧтсѧ къ б̃оу въси ко нци землꙗ . поклонятсѧ прѣд нимь въсꙗ ѡ̃ч̃ьствїа ꙗ̃ꙁыкъ . свѣдениꙗ г̃нꙗ вѣрна оу моудрꙗеть младенца гла̃ г̃нь въ крѣпо сти . гла̃ г̃нь въ велелѣпотѣ ꙁемлꙗ оумо лче . нб̃са оуканоуша ѡ̃ лица б̃а іи̃левꙗ . въ ѡ̃ц̃ъ мѣсто быша сн̃ове твои . поставиша кнѧꙁꙗ по въсеи земли . въ всю землꙗ и̃ ꙁыде вѣщание въ конець въселеныꙗ гл̃ни послеши д̃хъ твои и̃ съꙁиждꙋтсѧ . ѡ̃ бновиши лице земли . камо и̃доу ѡ̃ д̃ха твоéго . ѡ̃ лица твоéго камо бѣжю . и̃ д̃ъ хъ твои бл̃гыи наставитъ мѧ на землꙗ пра воую . не ѡ̃връꙁи мене ѡ̃ лица твоего . д̃о ха ст̃го твоего , не ѡ̃и̃ми ѡ̃ мене . ср̃дце чи сто съꙁижди въ мнѣ б̃е , д̃хъ правыи ѡ̃бно ви въ оутробѣ моеи . въꙁдаждь ми радо сть сп̃сеніа твоего . д̃х̃омь вл̃д̃чьнымь оу твръди мѧ . въꙁдасть гла̃ бл̃говѣстоующи̃ и̃ꙁ
units.english_cohort_translation: Out of Zion is the magnificence of His beauty; [all the ends of the earth] shall remember shall remember and turn unto the Lord, all the ends of the earth![^1075]

units.verbatim_book_heading: SELECTED PSALMS FOR SOLEMN COMMEMORATIONS AND FEASTS OF THE LORD :: At the Liturgy: The Beatitudes in the Octoechos on 6, and of the Saints Ode 6 on 4
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *...me, and [forgive] one another; and each departs unto his own cell in silence.*[^862] *This rule takes place on all fasting days, whenever "Alleluia" is [chanted]. But when it is "God is the Lord", prostrations are not made in the church; and of eating there is no distinction: on Tuesday and on Thursday if the superior wills, not only oil do we eat, but also fish; only let the superior observe strictly: even if it is not "God is the Lord", on Tuesday and on Thursday fish is not permitted to eat.*[^863]

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *...me, and [forgive] one another; and each departs unto his own cell in silence.*[^862] *This rule takes place on all fasting days, whenever "Alleluia" is [chanted]. But when it is "God is the Lord", prostrations are not made in the church; and of eating there is no distinction: on Tuesday and on Thursday if the superior wills, not only oil do we eat, but also fish; only let the superior observe strictly: even if it is not "God is the Lord", on Tuesday and on Thursday fish is not permitted to eat.*[^863]

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: силоу многоую г крепост людем своим дает
units.slavonic_diplomatic: силоу многоую . г̃ь крѣпость людемъ своимъ даеть: ~ прѣѡ̃бражению: ~ Велики г̃ь хваленъ ꙁѣло . въ градѣ б̃а нашего . въ горѣ ст̃ѣи éго . въꙁмꙋти шѧ горы крѣпостию éго . ѡ̃дѣꙗсѧ свѣтомъ ꙗко и̃риꙁою . сповѣдание красо та прѣд нимь . горы въꙁыгражꙋтсѧ ѡ̃ ли ца г̃нꙗ . гора б̃жіа гора тꙋчна гора оу̃сы рена . кто въꙁыде на горꙋ г̃ню . и̃ли кт̃ѡ станеть на мѣстѣ ст̃ѣмь éго . гора ю̃же съꙁда десница éго . гора ю̃же бл̃говоли б̃ъ жити въ неи . оу̃пованиꙗ пл̃тъ сътво рить и̃ и̃ꙁведеть ꙗ̃ ꙗко правда твоꙗ , г̃и кт̃о ѡ̃битаеть въ жилищи твоéмь . и̃ли кто въселитсѧ въ ст̃ѣи горѣ твоéи . по шли мл̃ть твою и̃ и̃стинноу твою . та ꙗ̃ настависта . въведоста мѧ въ гороу ст̃ѫꙗ твою . просвѣщеши ты дивно ѡ̃ горы вѣчно . свѣтъ въсиꙗ праведникоу .
units.english_cohort_translation: Light is risen for the righteous and gladness for the upright in heart![^1104]

units.slavonic_diplomatic: ты сътвори въсꙗ горы ꙁемнаꙗ . лѣто и̃ весноу ты сътвори . помяни сию . твоꙗ соуть нб̃са твоꙗ é̃сть ꙁемлꙗ . въселе наꙗ и̃ сплънéние éꙗ ты ѡ̃снова . ѳаѡрь и̃ éрмонъ ѡ̃ и̃мени твоéмь въꙁрадоваста сѧ . г̃и въ свѣтѣ лица твоéго поидоу ть . и̃ ѡ̃ и̃мени твоéмь въꙁрадоуéмсѧ весь д̃нь . и̃ бꙋдеть свѣтлость г̃а б̃а на шего на на̃ . ѡ̃ ны̃нѣ и̃ до вѣка: ~ прѣдътечи въсѣмъ éго праꙁнико̃: ~ Се оудаліхсѧ бѣгаꙗ въдворихсѧ въ пꙋсты ню побихсѧ неꙗсыти пꙋстынн . бы ꙗко нощныи врань на нырищи . ꙁабвѣ бы ꙗко птица ѡ̃собаящи на гнѣꙁдѣ . и̃ простросѧ а̃ки прꙋжїе . и̃ колѣнѣ мои и̃ꙁнемогоста ѡ̃ поста въꙁыска тẽ лице мое лица твое г̃и въꙁыщꙋ . и̃ во беꙁаконіе теко и̃справисѧ . ходѧ бес порока дѣлаꙗ правдоу , правды твоéꙗ не съхра нихъ въ ср̃ци моéмь . рѣхъ беꙁаконнико мь не беꙁаконьствоуите . съгрѣшаю щимъ не въꙁносите рога се . оустнѣ мои не въꙁбрани . ты раꙁоумѣи . ꙗ̃ꙁыкъ мои пооучитсѧ правдѣ твоéи . и̃ весь д̃нь хвалоу твою . бл̃жень мꙋжь боꙗисѧ г̃а . въ ꙁаповѣдехь éго въсхощеть ꙁѣло силно на земли сѣмѧ éго . слава бога тьство въ домоу éго . правда éго прѣ бываеть въ вѣкы . въсиꙗ въ тмѣ свѣтъ пра вы . бл̃гъ мꙋжь милоуꙗ и̃ даꙗ . расмотрѧ ꙗ̃ словеса своꙗ на соудѣ . ꙗко въ вѣкы не по движитсѧ въ па́мѧть вѣчноу бꙋдẽ пра ведникъ . ѡ̃ слоуха ꙁла не оубоитсѧ . готово ср̃дце мое оуповаéть на г̃а: ~ А̃ се величаниа ст̃ы, и̃ праꙁнико̃ г̃дьскы . рж̃тво б̃ци .
units.english_cohort_translation: Without iniquity did I run and direct my steps: he that walks uprightly and works righteousness![^1118]

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *...me, and [forgive] one another; and each departs unto his own cell in silence.*[^862] *This rule takes place on all fasting days, whenever "Alleluia" is [chanted]. But when it is "God is the Lord", prostrations are not made in the church; and of eating there is no distinction: on Tuesday and on Thursday if the superior wills, not only oil do we eat, but also fish; only let the superior observe strictly: even if it is not "God is the Lord", on Tuesday and on Thursday fish is not permitted to eat.*[^863]

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: в движению п сло и бранныи велича
units.slavonic_diplomatic: въꙁдвиженїю . + П̃ с̃ло̃ и̃ꙁбранныи . Велича емъ тѧ живодавче х̃е . и̃ чтемъ кр̃тъ твои ч̃тныи и̃ преславноé слави̃ въꙁдвиженіе . Дрꙋгое вели чаéмъ тѧ живодавче х̃е . и̃ чтемъ кр̃тъ твои ч̃тныи . и̃мже сп̃слъ éси на̃ ѡ̃ работы вражіа въведению . + П̃ с̃ло̃ и̃ꙁбранныи . То и̃же ро жество б̃ци . Величаéмъ тѧ пр̃таꙗ д̃во б̃го и̃ꙁбраннаꙗ ѡ̃троковице . и̃ почитаé éже въ цр̃квъ г̃ню въхоженіе твое: ~ рж̃твоу х̃воу

units.verbatim_section_rubric: *...me, and [forgive] one another; and each departs unto his own cell in silence.*[^862] *This rule takes place on all fasting days, whenever "Alleluia" is [chanted]. units.slavonic_stem_tier2: стретению п сло и бранны
units.slavonic_diplomatic: Стрѣтенію . + П̃ с̃ло̃ . и̃ꙁбранны . Величае тѧ живодавче х̃е . и̃ чте̃ б̃ж̃тво твое ч̃тное и̃ преславноé слави̃ стрѣтеніе . Др̃оé . Вели чаéмъ тѧ живодавче х̃е . и̃ чте̃ прест̃оую м̃трь твою . éюже н̃нѣ по ꙁаконоу принесесѧ во ц̃р̃ко г̃ню . Бл̃говѣщенію . с̃ес̃т̃кои . Арханге лскии гла̃ вопиети ч̃таꙗ . ра̃уисѧ ѡ̃брадо ваннаꙗ г̃ь съ тобою . Вънелю цвѣтноую . Вел̃чае тѧ живодавче х̃е . и̃ чте̃ в̃хо̃ твои ч̃тныи и̃ преславныꙗ слави̃ срѣтити твоꙗ . Др̃оé . Ве личаéмъ тѧ живодавче х̃е . ѡ̃санна въ вышнии̃ ды ти вопиé . бл̃квено грѧдыи во и̃мѧ г̃не .

But when it is "God is the Lord", prostrations are not made in the church; and of eating there is no distinction: on Tuesday and on Thursday if the superior wills, not only oil do we eat, but also fish; only let the superior observe strictly: even if it is not "God is the Lord", on Tuesday and on Thursday fish is not permitted to eat.*[^863]

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: на силне статии на третеи славе
units.slavonic_diplomatic: на силне статїи . на третеи славѣ . роди вси пѣс̃ погребенїю твоемꙋ приноси̃ м̃тре . В̃ нелю ѳѡ̃миноу . Величаéмъ тѧ живодавче х̃е и̃ чте̃ б̃о ство твое ч̃тное . и̃ преславноé слави̃ воскр̃ніе твое . Др̃оé . Величаéтѧ жакодавче х̃е . на̃ ра ди въ а̃дъ съшéдшаго . и̃ съ собою въсѧ въскресн вшаго . На въꙁнесéніе . Величаéтѧ живодавче х̃е и̃ чте̃ б̃ж̃тво твое ч̃тное . и̃ преславноé сла ви въꙁнесéніе твое . Др̃оé . Величаéтѧ живода вче х̃е . и̃ почитаé éже на нб̃са непр̃ч̃тою плъ тию . и̃ въсеславноé слави̃ б̃ж̃твое въꙁнесéние твое . В̃ нелю . п̃ . ю . Величаéтѧ живодавче х̃е . и̃ чте̃ д̃хъ твои ч̃тныи и̃ ст̃ыи . и̃ преславноé слави̃ съшествіе твое . Др̃оé . Величаéмъ тѧ живодавче х̃е . и̃ чте̃ въсест̃ыи твои д̃хъ .
units.english_cohort_translation: *Another [refrain]:* We magnify Thee, O Christ Giver of life, and we honor Thine All-Holy Spirit, which Thou hast sent from the Father unto Thy divine disciples![^1164]

units.verbatim_book_heading: SELECTED PSALMS FOR SOLEMN COMMEMORATIONS AND FEASTS OF THE LORD :: At the Liturgy: The Beatitudes in the Octoechos on 6, and of the Saints Ode 6 on 4
units.verbatim_section_rubric: *...me, and [forgive] one another; and each departs unto his own cell in silence.*[^862] *This rule takes place on all fasting days, whenever "Alleluia" is [chanted]. But when it is "God is the Lord", prostrations are not made in the church; and of eating there is no distinction: on Tuesday and on Thursday if the superior wills, not only oil do we eat, but also fish; only let the superior observe strictly: even if it is not "God is the Lord", on Tuesday and on Thursday fish is not permitted to eat.*[^863]
